Berakhot 34a:14-34b:11: Tanu rabbanan: ellu berachot sheadam shoche bahen: beavot", techilla vasof. bahodaa", techilla vasof. veim ba lashuach besof kol beracha uveracha, uvitchillat kol beracha uveracha — melammedin oto shello yishche.
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: hedyot, kemo sheamarnu.
Kohen gadol, besof kol beracha uveracha. vehammelech, techillat kol beracha uveracha vesof kol beracha uveracha.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: hedyot, kemo sheamarnu. kohen gadol, techillat kol beracha uveracha. hammelech — kevan shekkara shuv eno zokef, shenneemar: "vayhi kechallot shelomo lehitpallel vegomer kam millifne mizbach Adonai mikkeroa al birkav".

Tanu rabbanan: kidda — al appayim, shenneemar: "vattikkod bat sheva appayim eretz". keria — al birkayim, shenneemar "mikkeroa al birkav". hishtachavaa — zo pishshut yadayim veraglayim, shenneemar: "havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachavot lecha artza".
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: chazena lehu leabbaye verava dematzlu atzloye.
Tane chada: hakkorea bahodaa — hare ze meshubbach. vetanya iddach: hare ze megunne!
La kashya: ha battechilla, ha levassof.
Rava kara behodaa techilla vasof. amri leh rabbanan: ammay ka aved mar hachi? amar lehu: chazena lerav nachman dechara vachazena leh lerav sheshet deka aved hachi.
Vehatanya hakkorea bahodaa — hare ze megunne!
Vehatanya: hakkorea bahodaa uvahodaa shel "hallel" — hare ze megunne.
Ki tanya hahi behodaa devirkat hammazon.
Chullin 133a:5-16: Amar rava: badak lan rav yosef, hay kahana dechatef mattenata – chabbove ka mechabbev mitzva, o zalzole ka mezalzel bemitzva? ufeshatna leh "venatan" – velo sheyyittol meatzmo.

Amar abbaye: meresh hava chatefna mattenata, amena: chabbove ka mechabbevna mitzva. kevan dishmana leha "venatan" – velo sheyyittol meatzmo, michtaf la chatefna, memar (amari) [amena]: havu li. vechevan dishmana leha detanya: "vayyittu achare habbatza", rabbi meir omer: bene shemuel chelkam shaalu befihem, memar name la amena, vei yahavu li – shakelna.
Kevan dishmana leha detanya: hatztzenuim moshchin et yedehem, vehaggargeranim cholkim – mishkal name la shakelna, levar mimmaale yoma dechippure, leachzoke nafshay bechahane.
Amar rav yosef: hay kahana deit leh tzureba merabbanan beshivavuteh, udechika leh milleta – lizakke leh mattenata, veaf al gav dela ate lideh, bemakkare kehunna uleviyya.

Rava verav safra ikkelau leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar adda, veamri la leve mar yochana bereh derav chana bar bizna. aved lehu igla tilta, amar leh rava leshammaeh: zakki lan mattenata, divena lemechal lishshana bechardela.
Zakki leh. rava achal, verav safra la achal. akreyu lerav safra bechelma: "maade beged beyom kara chometz al nater veshar bashshirim al lev ra".

Ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: dilma mishshum daavari ashshemata demar akreyuyn hachi? amar leh: ki amari ana – beacher, shammaa – beal kurcheh mezakke, vechi amari ana – leman dela efshar leh, ha efshar leh.
Veella may tama akreyuyn hachi? kelappe rava! velakreyu lerava? rava nazuf hava.
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: ufeshateh dikra bemay ketiv? amar leh: beshone letalmid sheeno hagun.

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun – nofel begehinnam, shenneemar "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teochlehu esh lo nuppach yera sarid beoholo", veen "sarid" ella talmid chacham, shenneemar "uvasseridim asher Adonai kore".
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun – kezorek even lemerkulis, shenneemar: "kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod", uchetiv: "lo nave lichsil taanug".
Gittin 35a:2-14: Nimneu millehashbiah: may tama? illema mishshum derav kahana – deamar rav kahana; veamri la amar rav yehuda, amar rav: maase beadam echad bishne vatztzoret, shehifkid dinar zahav etzel almana; vehinnichattu bechad shel kemach, vaafaattu befat, unetanattu leani;

Leyamim ba baal haddinar, vaamar la: havi li dinari. amra leh: yehanne sam hammavet beechad mibbaneha shel otah ishsha, im neheneti middinarcha kelum! amru: lo hayu yamim muatin ad shemmet echad mibbaneha; uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: ma mi shennishba beemet – kach, hannishba al sheker – al achat kamma vechamma.
May tama ianasha? deishtarash la mekom dinar.
Umay "mi shennishba beemet"? kemi shennishba beemet.
I mishshum ha, may irya almana? afillu gerusha name! allema amar rabbi zera, amar shemuel: lo shanu ella almana, aval gerusha mashbiin otah?
Almana shane; divhahi hanaa deka tarcha kamme deyatme, atya leoroye hettera.
Amar rav yehuda, amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu, lo shanu ella bevet din, aval chutz levet din – mashbiin otah. ini?! veha rav la magbe ketubba learmalta! kashya.
Besura matnu hachi. binhardea matnu hachi – amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bevet din, aval chutz levet din – mashbiin otah. verav amar: afillu chutz levet din name en mashbiin otah.
Rav letameh – derav la magbe ketubba learmalta. veliaddera velaygbeyay! bishne derav kili nidre.

Hahi daatay lekammeh derav huna, amar la: ma eeved lich, derav la magbe ketubba learmalta. amara leh: midde hu tama – ella dilma naketna midde mikketubbati, chay Adonai tzevaot im neheneti mikketubbati kelum! amar rav huna: mode rav bekofetzet.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabba bar rav huna, amar la: may eeved lich, derav la magbe ketubba learmalta, veabba mari la magbe ketubba learmalta.
Amara leh: hav li mezone. amar la: mezone name let lich; deamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din – en lah mezonot.
Amara leh: afchu lechuresye, keve tere avdat li! hafechu lechuresye vetartzu, vaafillu hachi la ipperak mechulesha.
Joshua 2:1-6: Vayyishlach yehoshua-bin-nun min-hashshittim shenayim-anashim meraggelim cheresh lemor lechu reu et-haaretz veet-yericho vayyelchu vayyavou bet-ishsha zona ushemah rachav vayyishkevu-shamma
Vayyeamar lemelech yericho lemor hinne anashim bau henna hallayla mibbene yisrael lachpor et-haaretz
Vayyishlach melech yericho el-rachav lemor hotzii haanashim habbaim elayich asher-bau levetech ki lachpor et-kol-haaretz bau
Vattikkach haishsha et-shene haanashim vattitzpeno vattomer ׀ ken bau elay haanashim velo yadati meayin hemma

Ki shamanu et asher-hovish Adonai et-me yam-suf mippenechem betzetchem mimmitzrayim vaasher asitem lishne malche haemori asher beever hayyarden lesichon uleog asher hecheramtem otam
Mishnah Eduyot 1:1-3:
Shammay omer, kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. vehillel omer, mippekida lifkida, afillu leyamim harebe. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet. kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. hameshammeshet beiddim, hare zo chifkida, memaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida: 
Shammay omer, mikkav lechalla. vehillel omer, mikkabbayim. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella kav umechetza chayyavim bechalla. umishshehigdilu hammiddot amru, chameshet revaim chayyavin. rabbi yose omer, chamishsha, peturin. chamishsha vaod, chayyavin: 
Hillel omer, melo hin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve, ella sheadam chayyav lomar bilshon rabbo. veshammay omer, tisha kabbin. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella ad shebbau shene gardiyyim mishshaar haashpot shebbirushalayim veheidu mishshum shemaya veavtalyon, sheloshet luggin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve, vekiyyemu chachamim et divrehem:
Mishnah Eduyot 1:4-7:
Velamma mazkirin et divre shammay vehillel levattala, lelammed laddorot habbaim shello yehe adam omed al devarav, shehare avot haolam lo amdu al divrehem: 
Velamma mazkirin divre hayyachid ben hamerubbin, hoil veen halacha ella chedivre hamerubbin. sheim yire vet din et divre hayyachid veyismoch alav, sheen bet din yachol levattel divre vet din chavero ad sheyyihye gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan. haya gadol mimmennu vechachma aval lo veminyan, beminyan aval lo vechachma, eno yachol levattel devarav, ad sheyyihye gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan: 
Amar rabbi yehuda, im ken lamma mazkirin divre hayyachid ben hamerubbin levattala. sheim yomar haadam kach ani mekubbal, yeamer lo, kedivre ish peloni shamata: 
Bet shammay omrim, rova atzamot min haatzamim, ben mishshenayim ben mishshelosha. uvet hillel omrim, rova atzamot min haggeviyya, merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan. shammay omer, afillu meetzem echad:
Mishnah Parah 6:2-5:
Haya kiddush tzaf al pene hammayim, rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, notel umekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, kol shennaga bammayim, en mekaddeshin bo. zalaf et hammayim venimtza kiddush millemattan, rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, menaggev umekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, kol shennaga bammayim, en mekaddeshin bo: 
Hamekaddesh bashshoket vehattefi vetochah, af al pi sheppiv tzar kol shehu, hammayim shebbetocho mekuddashin. im haya sefog, hammayim shebbetocho fesulim. ketzad yaase, yezallef ad shehu maggia lassefog. naga bassefog, af al pi shehammayim tzafin al gabbav kol shehen, pesulin: 
Natan yado o raglo o ale yerakot kede sheyyaavru hammayim lechavit, pesulim. ale kanim vaale egoz, kesherim. ze hakkelal, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, pasul. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, kasher: 
Hamefanne et hammayan letoch haggat, o letoch haggevim, pesulim lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh bahen me chattat, mippene shello nitmalleu vecheli:
Mishnah Parah 7:1-4:
Chamishsha shemmilu chamishsha chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, venimlechu lekaddeshan kiddush echad, o lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlechu lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, hare chullan kesherim. yachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, venimlach lekaddeshan kiddush echad, en kasher ella acharon. lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, en kasher ella ze shekkiddesh rishon. amar leechad, kaddesh lecha et ellu, en kasher ella rishon. kaddesh li et ellu, hare chullam kesherim: 
Hamemalle veachat yado veose melacha veachat yado, hamemalle lo uleacher, o shemmille lishnayim keachat, shenehen pesulin, shehammelacha foselet bammilluy, ben lo ben leacher: 
Hamekaddesh beachat yado veose melacha veachat yado, im lo, pasul. veim leacher, kasher. hamekaddesh lo uleacher, shello pasul, veshel acher kasher. hamekaddesh lishnayim keechad, shenehen kesherin: 
Kaddesh li vaakaddesh lach, harishon kasher. malle li vaamalle lach, haacharon kasher. kaddesh li vaamalle lach, shenehem kesherim. malle li vaakaddesh lach, shenehem pesulim:
Mishnah Parah 7:10-8:1:
Hammoser memav letame, pesulin. uletahor, kesherin. rabbi eliezer omer, af letame kesherin, im lo asu habbealim melacha: 
Shenayim shehayu memallein lechattat, vehigbihu ze al ze venatal ze laze kotzo, bekiddush echad, kasher. bishne kiddushin, pasul. rabbi yose omer, af bishne kiddushin kasher, im hitnu venehen: 
Happoretz al menat ligdor, kasher. veim gadar, pasul. haochel al menat liktzot, kasher. veim katza, pasul. haya ochel vehotir vezarak ma shebbeyado letachat hatteena o letoch hammuktze bishvil shello yovad, pasul: 
Shenayim shehayu shomrim et hashshoket, nitma achad mehem, kesherim, mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni. tahar, venitma sheni, kesherim, mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon. nitmeu shenehen keachat, pesulin. asa achad mehen melacha, kesherin, mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni. amad, veasa hashsheni melacha, kesherin, mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon. asu shenehen keechad, pesulin:
Mishnah Parah 7:5-9:
Hamemalle lo ulechattat, memalle et shello techilla vekoshro vaesel veachar kach memalle et shel chattat. veim mille shel chattat techilla veachar kach mille et shello, pasul. noten et shello laachorav veet shel chattat lefanav. veim natan et shel chattat laachorav, pasul. hayu shenehen shel chattat, noten echad lefanav veechad laachorav, vechasher, mippene shei efshar: 
Hammolich et hachevel beyado ledarko, kasher. veshello ledarko, pasul. ze halach leyavne shelosha moadot, uvemoed shelishi hichshiru lo horaat shaa: 
Hamechannen et hachevel al yad al yad, kasher. veim kinneno vaacharona, pasul. amar rabbi yose, laze hichshiru horaat shaa: 
Hammatznia et hechavit shello tishshaver, o shekkefaah al piha al menat lenaggevah lemallot bah, kasher. leholich bah et hakkiddush, pasul. hamefanne charasin mittoch hashshoket bishvil shettachazik mayim harebe, kesherin. veim bishvil shello yihyu meakkevin oto veshaa shehu zolef et hammayim, pasul: 
Mi shehayu memav al ketefo vehora horaa, vehera laacherim et hadderech, veharag nachash veakrav, venatal ochalim lehatzeniam, pasul. ochalin leachlan, kasher. hannachash vehaakrav shehayu meakkevim oto, kasher. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, kol davar shehu mishshum melacha, ben amad ben lo amad, pasul. davar sheeno mishshum melacha, amad, pasul. veim lo amad, kasher:
Mishnah Parah 8:2-5:
Hamekaddesh me chattat, lo yinol et hassandal. sheim naflu mashkin al hassandal, nitma vetimmeahu. hare hu omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani. naflu mashkin al besaro, tahor. naflu al kesuto, nitmet vetimmeattu. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani: 
Hassoref para, ufarim, vehameshalleach et hassair, metamme vegadim. para ufarim vesair hammishtalleach atzman en metammein begadim. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani: 
Haochel minnivlat haof hattahor vehi bevet habbelia, metamme vegadim. hannevela atzmah enah metammea vegadim. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni, veatta timmetani: 
Kol velad hattumot eno metamme chelim, ella mashke. nitma mashke, timmean. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
Mishnah Parah 8:6-10:
En keli cheres metamme chavero, ella mashke. nitma mashke, timmeattu. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani: 
Kol happosel et hatteruma, metamme et hammashkin lihyot techilla letamme echad velifsol echad, chutz mittevul yom. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani: 
Kol hayyammim kemikve, shenneemar (Bereshit 1), ulemikve hammayim kara yammim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, hayyam haggadol kemikve, lo neemar yammim, ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harebe. rabbi yose omer, kol hayyammim metaharin bezochalin, ufesulin lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh mehen me chattat: 
Hammayim hammukkim, pesulim. ellu hen hammukkim, hammeluchim vehapposhrim. hammayim hamechazzevim, pesulin. ellu hem hammayim hamechazzevim, hamechazzevim echad bashshavua. hamechazzevim befulmesayot uvishne vitztzaron, kesherim. rabbi yehuda fosel: 
Me karmeyon ume fuga, pesulin, mippene shehem me vitztzim. me hayyarden ume yarmuch, pesulim, mippene shehem me taarovot. veelu hen me taarovot, echad kasher veechad pasul, shennitarvu. shenehen kesherin venitarvu, kesherin. rabbi yehuda fosel:
Mishnah Pesachim 5:10-6:3:
Kerao vehotzi emurav, netano vemagis vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. yatzta chat rishona veyashva lah behar habbayit, sheniyya bachel, vehashshelishit bimkomah omedet. chashecha, yatzu vetzalu et pischehen: 
Ellu devarim bappesach dochin et hashshabbat, shechitato uzerikat damo umichuy keravav vehekter chalavav. aval tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin et hashshabbat. harekavato vahavaato michutz lattechum, vachatichat yabbalto, en dochin et hashshabbat. rabbi eliezer omer, dochin: 
Amar rabbi eliezer, vahalo din hu, ma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha docha et hashshabbat, ellu shehen mishshum shevut lo yidchu et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, yom tov yochiach, shehittiru vo mishshum melacha, veasur bo mishshum shevut. amar lo rabbi eliezer, ma ze, yehoshua, ma reaya reshut lemitzva. heshiv rabbi akiva veamar, hazzaa tochiach, shehi mitzva vehi mishshum shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat, af atta al titma al ellu, sheaf al pi shehen mitzva vehen mishshum shevut, lo yidchu et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vealeha ani dan, uma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha, docha et hashshabbat, hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut, eno din sheddocha et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi akiva, o chilluf, ma im hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut, enah docha et hashshabbat, shechita shehi mishshum melacha, eno din shello tidche et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, akiva, akarta ma shekkatuv battora, ben haarbayim bemoado (Bamidbar 9), ben bechol ben beshabbat. amar lo, rabbi, have li moed laellu kammoed lashshechita. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat, enah docha et hashshabbat. shechita shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat, docha et hashshabbat: 
Ematay mevi chagiga immo, bizman shehu va bechol, betohora uvemuat. uvizman shehu va beshabbat, bimrubbe uvetuma, en meviin immo chagiga:
Mishnah Pesachim 6:4-7:2:
Chagiga hayta vaa min hatztzon, min habbakar, min hakkevasim umin haizzim, min hazzecharim umin hannekevot. veneechelet lishne yamim velayla echad: 
Happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo veshabbat, chayyav alav chattat. ushear kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum pesach, im enan reuyin, chayyav. veim reuyin hen, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im happesach shehu muttar lishmo, kesheshshinna et shemo, chayyav, zevachim shehen asurin lishman, kesheshshinna et sheman, eno din sheyyehe chayyav. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta bappesach, sheshshinnahu ledavar asur, tomar bazzevachim, sheshshinnan ledavar hammuttar. amar lo rabbi eliezer, emure tzibbur yochichu, shehen muttarin lishman, vehashshochet lishman, chayyav. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta veemure tzibbur sheyyesh lahen kitzba, tomar bappesach sheen lo kitzba. rabbi meir omer, af hashshochet leshem emure tzibbur, patur: 
Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav, laarelin velitmein, chayyav. leochlav veshello leochlav, limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulin velaarelin, lithorim velitmeim, patur. shechato venimtza vaal mum, chayyav. shechato venimtza terefa vasseter, patur. shechato venoda shemmashchu habbealim et yadam, o shemmetu o shennitmeu, patur, mippene sheshshachat birshut: 
Ketzad tzolin et happesach, meviin shappud shel rimmon, tochavo mittoch piv ad bet nekuvato, venoten et keraav veet bene meav letocho, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, kemin bishshul hu ze, ella tolin chutza lo: 
En tzolin et happesach lo al hashshappud velo al haaskela. amar rabbi tzadok, maase berabban gamliel sheamar letavi avdo, tze utzele lanu et happesach al haaskela. naga becharso shel tannur, yiklof et mekomo. nataf meratbo al hacheres vechazar alav, yittol et mekomo. nataf meratbo al hassolet, yikmotz et mekomo:
Mishnah Pesachim 7:11-8:2:
Kol hanneechol beshor haggadol, yeachel bigdi harach, verashe chenafayim vehassechusim. hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor, hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame, eno loke et haarbaim: 
Evar sheyyatza miktzato, chotech ad shemmaggia laetzem, vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek, vechotech. uvammukdashin kotzetz bakkofitz, sheen bo mishshum shevirat haetzem. min haagaf velifnim kelifnim, min haagaf velachutz kelachutz. hachallonot veovi hachoma, kelifnim: 
Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad, ellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, veellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, vehammecham baemtza. ucheshehashshammash omed limzog, kofetz et piv umachazir et panav ad shemmaggia etzel chavurato veochel. vehakkalla, hofechet paneha veochelet: 
Haishsha bizman shehi bevet balah, shachat aleha balah veshachat aleha aviha, tochal mishshel balah. halcha regel rishon laasot bevet aviha, shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah, tochal bimkom shehi rotza. yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin, yochal bimkom shehu rotze. eved shel shene shuttafin, lo yochal mishshel shenehen. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, lo yochal mishshel rabbo: 
Haomer leavdo, tze ushechot alay et happesach, shachat gedi, yochal. shachat tale, yochal. shachat gedi vetale, yochal min harishon. shachach ma amar lo rabbo, ketzad yaase, yishchat tale ugedi veyomar, im gedi amar li rabbi, gedi shello vetale shelli. veim tale amar li rabbi, hattale shello ugedi shelli. shachach rabbo ma amar lo, shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni:
Mishnah Pesachim 7:3-6:
Sacho veshemen teruma, im chavurat kohanim, yochelu. im yisrael, im chay hu, yedichennu. veim tzali hu, yiklof et hachitzon. sacho veshemen shel maaser sheni, lo yaasennu damim al bene chavura, sheen podin maaser sheni virushalayim: 
Chamishsha devarim bain betuma veenan neechalin betuma. haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, vezivche shalme tzibbur, useire rashe chodashim. happesach shebba vetuma, neechol betuma, shello va mittechillato ella laachila: 
Nitma habbasar vehachelev kayyam, eno zorek et haddam. nitma hachelev vehabbasar kayyam, zorek et haddam. uvammukdashin eno chen, ella af al pi shennitma habbasar vehachelev kayyam, zorek et haddam: 
Nitma kahal o rubbo, o shehayu hakkohanim temeim vehakkahal tehorim, yease vetuma. nitma miut hakkahal, hattehorin osin et harishon, vehattemein osin et hashsheni:
Mishnah Pesachim 7:7-10:
Happesach shennizrak damo, veachar kach noda shehu tame, hatztzitz meratztze. nitma hagguf, en hatztzitz meratztze, mippene sheamru, hannazir veose fesach, hatztzitz meratztze al tumat haddam, veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf. nitma tumat hattehom, hatztzitz meratztze: 
Nitma shalem o rubbo, sorfin oto lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha. nitma miuto, vehannotar, sorfin oto vechatzrotehen o al gaggotehen meatze atzman. hatztzaykanin sorfin oto lifne habbira, bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha: 
Happesach sheyyatza o shennitma, yissaref miyyad. nitmeu habbealim o shemmetu, teubbar tzurato veyissaref beshishsha asar. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af ze yissaref miyyad, lefi sheen lo ochlin: 
Haatzamot, vehaggidin, vehannotar, yissarfu veshishsha asar. chal shishsha asar lihyot beshabbat, yissarfu beshiva asar, lefi sheenan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:
Mishnah Pesachim 8:3-6:
Haomer levanav, hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim, kevan shehichnis harishon rosho verubbo, zacha vechelko umezakke et echav immo. leolam nimnin alav ad sheyyehe vo chazzayit lechol echad veechad. nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyizrok alav et haddam: 
Hammamne immo acherim bechelko, rashshain bene chavura litten lo et shello, vehu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen: 
Zav sheraa shete reiyyot, shochatin alav bashshevii. raa shalosh, shochatin alav bashshemini shello. shomeret yom keneged yom, shochatin aleha vashsheni shellah. raata shene yamim, shochatin aleha vashshelishi. vehazzava, shochatin aleha vashshemini: 
Haonen, vehamefakkeach et haggal, vechen mi shehivtichuhu lehotzio mibbet haasurim, vehachole vehazzaken shehen yecholin leechol kazzayit, shochatin alehen. al kullan en shochatin alehen bifne atzman, shemma yaviu et happesach lide fesul. lefichach im era bahen pesul, peturin millaasot pesach sheni, chutz min hamefakkeach baggal, shehu tame mittechillato:
Mishnah Shevuot 6:3-7:
Litra zahav yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella litra chesef, patur. dinar zahav yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella dinar kesef, uterisit ufundeyon uferuta, chayyav, shehakkol min matbea achat. kor tevua yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella letech kitnit, patur. kor perot yesh li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella letech kitnit, chayyav, shehakkitnit bichlal perot. teano chittin, vehoda lo visorim, patur. verabban gamliel mechayyev. hattoen lachavero vechadde shemen vehoda lo vakkankannim, admon omer, hoil vehoda lo miktzat mimmin hattaana, yishshavea. vachachamim omrim, en hahodaa mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon. teano chelim vekarkaot, vehoda vakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, bakkarkaot vechafar bakkelim, patur. hoda vemiktzat hakkarkaot, patur. bemiktzat hakkelim, chayyav, shehannechasim sheen lahem acharayut zokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut lishshava alehen: 
En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan, veen mashbiin et hakkatan, aval nishbaim lakkatan velahekdesh: 
Veellu devarim sheen nishbain alehen, haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot. en bahen tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. shomer chinnam eno nishba. nose sachar eno meshallem. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shechayyav beacharayutan, nishbain alehen. vesheeno chayyav beacharayutan, en nishbain alehem: 
Rabbi meir omer, yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad, eser gefanim teunot masarti lach, vehalla omer enan ella chamesh, rabbi meir mechayyev shevua. vachachamim omrim, kol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu chakkarka. en nishbain ella al davar shebbammidda veshebbammishkal veshebbamminyan. ketzad, bayit male masarti lach vechis male masarti lach, vehalla omer eni yodea ella ma shehinnachta atta notel, patur. ze omer ad hazziz veze omer ad hachallon, chayyav: 
Hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon, amar lo sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav vesela haya shave, patur. sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilvitani alav ushelosha dinarim haya shave, chayyav. sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vesela haya shave, patur. sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave, vehalla omer lo chi ella sela hilviticha alav vachamishsha dinarim haya shave, chayyav. umi nishba, mi shehappikkadon etzlo, shemma yishshava ze veyotzi halla et happikkadon:
Mishnah Shevuot 7:1-4:
Kol hannishbain shebbattora, nishbain velo meshallemin. veellu nishbain venotlin, hassachir, vehannigzal, vehannechbal, veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, vehachenvani al pinkaso. hassachir ketzad, amar lo ten li sechari sheyyesh li veyadecha, hu omer natatti, vehalla omer lo natalti, hu nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li veyadecha, vehu omer hitkabbalta dinar zahav: 
Hannigzal ketzad, hayu meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno shello virshut, hu omer kelay natalta, vehu omer lo natalti, hare ze nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo shene chelim natalta, vehu omer lo natalti ella echad: 
Hannechbal ketzad, hayu meidim oto shennichnas tachat yado shalem veyatza chavul, veamar lo chavalta bi, vehu omer lo chavalti, hare ze nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer, ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad, amar lo chavalta bi shetayim, vehalla omer lo chavalti vecha ella echat: 
Veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua ketzad, achat shevuat haedut veachat shevuat happikkadon, vaafillu shevuat shav. haya echad mehen mesachek bekuvya, umalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, shekkenegdo nishba venotel. hayu shenehen chashudin, chazra hashshevua limkomah, divre rabbi yose. rabbi meir omer, yachaloku:
Mishnah Shevuot 7:5-8:
Vehachenvani al pinkaso ketzad, lo sheyyomar lo katuv al pinkasi sheatta chayyav li matayim zuz, ella amar lo ten livni satayim chittin, ten lefoali besela maot, hu omer natatti vehen omrim lo natalnu, (shenehen nishbaim), hu nishba venotel vehen nishbain venotlin. amar ben nannas, ketzad ellu vain lide shevuat shav veellu vain lide shevuat shav, ella hu notel shello vishvua vehen notlin shello vishvua: 
Amar lachenvani ten li vedinar perot venatan lo, amar lo ten li haddinar, amar lo netattiv lecha unetatto vaonpali, yishshava baal habbayit. natan lo et haddinar, amar lo ten li et happerot, amar lo netattim lecha veholachtan letoch betecha, yishshava chenvani. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehapperot beyado, yado al haelyona. amar lashshulchani ten li vedinar maot venatan lo, amar lo ten li et haddinar, amar lo netattiv lecha unetatto vaonpali, yishshava baal habbayit. natan lo et haddinar, amar lo ten li et hammaot, amar lo netattim lecha vehishlachtam letoch kisecha, yishshava shulchani. rabbi yehuda omer, en derech shulchani litten issar ad sheyyittol dinaro: 
Keshem sheamru, happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella vishvua, veed echad meidah shehi ferua, lo tippara ella vishvua. minnechasim meshubadim uminnichse yetomim, lo tippara ella vishvua. vehannifraat shello befanav, lo tippara ella vishvua. vechen hayetomim lo yipparu ella vishvua, shevua shello fekadanu abba, velo amar lanu abba, veshello matzinu ven shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze farua. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, afillu nolad habben leachar mitat haav, hare ze nishba venotel. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, im yesh edim sheamar haav bishat mitato shetar ze eno farua, hu notel shello vishvua: 
Veellu nishbaim shello vetaana, hashshuttafin, vehaarisin, vehaappotroppin, vehaishsha hannoset vehannotenet betoch habbayit, uven habbayit. amar lo ma atta toaneni, retzoni shettishshava li, chayyav. chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin, en yachol lehashebio. nitgalgela lo shevua mimmakom acher, megalgelin alav et hakkol. vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua:
Mishnah Shevuot 8:1-5:
Arbaa shomrin hen, shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher. shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol. vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol. nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemim et haaveda veet haggeneva: 
Amar leshomer chinnam, hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad. nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad. avad, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur: 
Hechan shori, amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. hechan shori, amar lo avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheachalo, meshallem et hakkeren. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vechomesh veasham. hechan shori, amar lo nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vechomesh veasham: 
Amar leechad bashshuk hechan shori shegganavta, vehu omer lo ganavti, vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain, amar ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti, eno meshallem ella keren: 
Amar lashshoel hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad. nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad. avad, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur:
Mishnah Shevuot 8:6: Hechan shori, amar lo eni yodea ma atta sach, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. amar lannose sachar vehassocher hechan shori, amar lo met, vehu shennishbar o nishba. nishbar, vehu shemmet o nishba. nishba, vehu shemmet o nishbar. nignav, vehu sheavad. avad, vehu shennignav. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. met o nishbar o nishba, vehu shennignav o avad. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. avad, o nignav, vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. ze hakkelal, kol hameshanne mechova lechova umippetor liftor umippetor lechova, patur. mechova liftor, chayyav. ze hakkelal, kol hannishba lehakel al atzmo, chayyav. lehachemir al atzmo, patur:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: En memannin sheliach tzibbur ella gadol shebbatztzibbur bechachmato uvemaasav. veim haya zaken hare ze meshubbach beyoter. umishtaddelin lihyot sheliach tzibbur adam shekkolo arev veragil likrot. umi shello nitmalle zekano af al pi shehu chacham gadol lo yehe shatz mippene kevod tzibbur. aval pores hu al shema mishsheyyavi shete searot achar shelosh esre shanim:

Vechen hailleg kegon mi shekkore lealef ayin o leayin alef vechol mi sheeno yachol lehotzi et haotiyyot ketikkunan en memannin oto sheliach tzibbur. veharav memanne echad mittalmidav lehitpallel lefanav betzibbur. hassuma pores al shema venaase sheliach tzibbur. aval mi shekketefav megullot af al pi shehu pores al shema eno naase sheliach tzibbur litfilla ad sheyyihye atuf:

Seder tefillot hatztzibbur kach hu. bashshachar kol haam yoshvim usheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva veomed beemtza haam umatchil veomer kaddish vechol haam onim amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach lealam ulealme almayya bechol kochan. veonin amen besof kaddish. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vehem onim baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil ufores al shema bekol ram vehem onim amen achar kol beracha uveracha. vehayyodea levarech velikrot immo kore ad shemmevarech gaal yisrael:

Vehakkol omdin miyyad umitpallelim belachash. umi sheeno yodea lehitpallel omed veshotek ad sheyyitpallel sheliach tzibbur belachash im shear haam. vechol mi sheyyigmor tefillato im hatztzibbur yafsia shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod bammakom shehiggia elav beet sheyyafsia:

Veachar sheyyafsia sheliach tzibbur shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod matchil umitpallel bekol ram mittechillat habberachot lehotzi et mi shello hitpallel. vehakkol omdim veshomim veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha. ben ellu shello yatzu yede chovatan ben ellu shekkevar yatzu yede chovatan:

Veomer kedushsha bivracha shelishit. vechevan shehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yesh reshut lechol echad veechad lachazor bammakom sheamad bo battefilla. uchesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lemodim vechorea kol haam shochin meat velo yishchu yoter midday. veomrim modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu velohe chol basar yotzrenu yotzer bereshit berachot vehodaot leshimcha haggadol vehakkadosh al shehecheyitanu vekiyyamtanu ken techayyenu utechanenu veteesof galuyyotenu lechatzrot kadshecha lishmor chukkecha uleavdecha beemet velaasot retzoncha belevav shalem al sheanu modim lach. vechol haomer modim modim meshattekin oto:

Veachar sheyyashlim kol hattefilla yeshev veyippol al panav veyitte meat hu vechol hatztzibbur veyitchannen vehu nofel. veyeshev veyagbiah rosho hu ushear haam umitchannen meat bekol ram meyushshav. veachar kach yaamod sheliach tzibbur levaddo veomer kaddish paam sheniyya vehem onim kederech sheonin battechilla. veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 lach)</small> "vehu rachum" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla" vechulei. hu omed vehem yoshvim vehem korim immo. veachar kach omer <small>(yeshaya 59 20)</small> "uva letziyyon goel" vechulei <small>(yeshaya 59 21)</small> "vaani zot" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 22 4)</small> "veatta kadosh" <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh" vegomer hakkedushsha vehem onin <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "kadosh kadosh" shalosh peamim. vechozer vekore hakkedushsha targum veomer <small>(yechezkel 3 12)</small> "vattissaeni ruach" vechulei vekore oto targum veomer <small>(Shemot 15 18)</small> "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed" vekorehu targum kede lehavin haam:

Veellu happesukim shellifne hakkedushsha veshel achareha im targuman hem hannikrain seder kedushsha. veachar kach mitchannen bedivre tachanunim uvifsuke rachamim veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin:

Mi sheamar betachanunim mi sherichem al kan tzippor shello likkach haem al habbanim o shello lishchot oto veet beno beyom echad yerachem alenu vechayyotze beinyan ze meshattekin oto. mippene shemmitzvot ellu gezerat hakkatuv hen veenan rachamim. sheillu hayu mippene rachamim lo haya mattir lanu shechita kol ikkar. vechen lo yarbe bechinnuyim shel shem veyomar <small>(Devarim 10 17)</small> "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora" vehechazak vehaammitz vehaizzuz. sheen koach baadam lehaggia besof shevachav. ella omer ma sheamar moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom:

Bemincha omer sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve betecha" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei kore hu vehaam meyushshav veomed sheliach tzibbur veomer kaddish vehem omdim acharav veonin kedarkan umitpallelin kullam belachash. veachar kach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit ad sheyyashlim kol hattefilla. venoflim al penehem umitchannen umagbiah rosho hu vehem. umitchannen meat meyushshav kederech sheasa beshacharit veomed veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin lemaasehem:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:6-7:
Hammattich echad mimmine mattachot kol shehu o hamechammem et hammattachot ad shettease gachelet hare ze toledet mevashshel. vechen hamemasses et haddonag o et hachelev o et hazzefet vehakkofer vehaggafrit vechayyotze bahem hare ze toledet mevashshel vechayyav. vechen hamevashshel kele adama ad sheyyeasu cheres chayyav mishshum mevashshel. kelalo shel davar ben sherippa guf kashe baesh o shehiksha guf rach hare ze chayyav mishshum mevashshel: 
Haggozez tzemer o sear ben min habbehema ben min hachayya ben min hachay ben min hammet afillu min hashshelach shellahen chayyav. kamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut shearko kerochav hassit kaful. vechamma rochav hassit kede limtoach min bohen shel yad ad haetzba harishona kesheyyiftach benehen bechol kocho vehu karov lishne shelishe zeret. hattolesh kanaf min haof hare ze toledet gozez. hattove et hatztzemer min hachay patur sheen derech geziza bechach veen derech nipputz bechach veen derech teviyya bechach:
Niddah 22a:12-22b:5: Bea minneh rabbi yose berabbi chanina merabbi elazar: dam yavesh mahu? "ki yazuv zov damah" amar rachamana — ad demedav dayev leh, lach — in, yavesh — la, o dilma: hay "ki yazuv zav dama" orcha demilleta hi, uleolam afillu yavesh name?
Amar leh: tenetuha, dam hannidda uvesar hammet metammein lachim viveshim. amar leh: lach venaasa yavesh — la ka mibbaya li, ki mibbaya li — yavesh meikkara.
Ha name tenetuha: hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin searah, kemin afar, kemin yavchushin adummin — tatil lammayim,
Im nimmochu temea. i hachi, belo nimmochu name? amar rabba: ki lo nimmochu — beriyya bifne atzmah hi.
Umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, vehatanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: shene maasim heela abba mittivin leyavne.

Maase beishsha shehayta mappelet kemin kelippot adummot, uvau veshaalu et abba, veabba shaal lachachamim, vachachamim shaalu larofim, veamru lahem: ishsha zo makka yesh lah betoch meeha, shemmimmenna mappelet kemin kelippot. tatil lammayim, im nimmochu — temea.

Veshuv maase beishsha shehayta mappelet kemin searot adummot, uvaa veshaala et abba, veabba shaal lachachamim, vachachamim larofim, veamru lahem: shuma yesh lah betoch meeha, shemmimmenna mappelet kemin searot adummot. tatil lammayim, im nimmochu — temea.

Amar resh lakish: uvefoshrin. tanya name hachi: tatil lemayim, uvefoshrin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: memaachto berok al gabbe hatztzipporen. may benayyhu? amar ravina: mauch al yede haddechak ikka venayyhu.
Pesachim 49a:11-22: Tanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol seuda sheenah shel mitzva — en talmid chacham rashshay lehanot mimmenna.
Kegon may? amar rabbi yochanan: kegon bat kohen leyisrael, uvat talmid chacham leam haaretz. deamar rabbi yochanan: bat kohen leyisrael — en ziuugan ole yafe.
May hi? amar rav chisda: o "almana", o "gerusha", o "zera en lah". bematnita tana: kovrah o kovarto, o meviato lide aniyyut.
Ini?! veha amar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyitashsher yidbak bezaro shel aharon, kol shekken shettora uchehunna maashartan. la kashya: ha — betalmid chacham, ha — beam haaretz.
Rabbi yehoshua nesev kahenta, chalash. amar: la nicha leh leaharon deedbak bezareh, dehave leh chatna ki ana.
Rav idi bar avin nasev kahenta, nefaku minneh tere bene semichi: rav sheshet bereh derav idi, verabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi. amar rav pappa: i la nasevna kahenta, la iattari.
Amar rav kahana: i la nasevna kahenta, la gelay. amaru leh: veha limkom tora gelet! la gelay kidgale inashe.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannehene misseudat harshut lesof gole, shenneemar: "veochlim karim mitztzon vaagalim mittoch marbek", uchetiv: "lachen atta yiglu berosh golim".

Tanu rabbanan: kol talmid chacham hammarbe seuddato bechol makom, sof machariv et beto, umealmen et ishto, umeyaytem et gozalav, vetalmudo mishtakkeach mimmennu, umachlokot rabbot baot alav, udevarav enam nishmaim, umechallel shem shamayim veshem rabbo veshem aviv, vegorem shem ra lo ulevanav velivne vanav ad sof kol haddorot.
May hi? amar abbaye: karu leh bar machem tannure. rava amar: bar merakked be chubbe. rav pappa amar: bar melachech pinche. rav shemaya amar: bar mach rava.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham, sheim met o gole — muvetach lo shebbanav talmide chachamim. veal yissa bat am haaretz, sheim met o gole — banav amme haaretz.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham, veyassi bitto letalmid chacham, mashal leinve haggefen beinve haggefen, davar nae umitkabbel. velo yissa bat am haaretz, mashal leinve haggefen beinve hassene, davar kaur

Sanhedrin 58b:17-59a:5: Amar rabbi chanina: goy shehikka et yisrael chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish [vayyach et hammitzri] vegomer".
Veamar rabbi chanina: hassoter loo shel yisrael keillu soter loo shel shechina, shenneemar: "mokesh adam yala kodesh".

Magbiah, avdo, shavat – siman. amar resh lakish: hammagbiah yado al chavero, af al pi shello hikkahu, nikra rasha, shenneemar: "vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha". "lamma hikkita" lo neemar, ella "lamma takke" – af al pi shello hikkahu nikra rasha.
Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: nikra chote, shenneemar: "veim lo lakachti vechozka", uchetiv: "vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod".
Rav huna amar: tikkatzetz yado, shenneemar: "uzeroa rama tishshaver". rav huna katz yeda.
Rabbi elazar omer: en lo takkana ella kevura, shenneemar: "veish zeroa lo haaretz".
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo nittena karka ella levaale zeroot, shenneemar: "veish zeroa lo haaretz".
Veamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "oved admato yisba lachem"? im ose adam atzmo keeved laadama – yisba lechem, veim lav – lo yisba lechem.
Veamar resh lakish: nochri sheshshavat chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "veyom valayla lo yishbotu". veamar mar: azhara shellahen zo hi mitatan. amar ravina: afillu sheni bashshabbat.
Velichsheva gabbe sheva mitzvot? ki ka chashev – shev veal taase, kum ase la ka chashev.
Veha dinin kum ase hu, veka chashev? kum ase veshev al taase ninhu.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: goy sheosek battora chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha", lanu morasha velo lahem.
Velichsheva gabbe sheva mitzvot? man deamar "morasha" – migzal ka gazel la. man deamar "meorasa" – dino kenaara hameorasa, deviskila.

Metivi, haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol? shenneemar: "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem". "kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim" lo neemar, ella "haadam". ha lamadta sheafillu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol.
Zohar, Korach 1: Vayyikkach korach ben yitzhar ben kehat ben levi vegomer. ribbi abba patach (Tehillim 19:11) hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav umetukim middevash venofet tzufim. kama illain pitgame orayyta, kama yakkirin innun, teivin innun leella, teivin innun lecholla. begin deinnun shema kaddisha. vechol man deishtedal beorayyta, ishtedal bishma kaddisha, veishteziv mikkolla, ishteziv bealma den, veishteziv bealma deate. ta chaze, kol man deishtedal beorayyta, achid beilana dechayye. kevan deachid beh, becholla achid, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vegomer.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kol man deyishtedal beorayyta, cheru it leh mikkolla, cheru mimmita, kema deamaran. begin decheru aleh sharya, veachid beh. illu yisrael mitatterin beorayyta, yishtezivu mikkolla, vela yishtechachu begaluta, veda hu dichtiv (sefer acher illu yisrael manetareyn orayyta, ishtezvu mikkolla, velo ishtechachu begaluta ketiv) (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot, al tikre charut ella cherut. vecherut da (ukemuha) beorayyta ishtechach, orayyta ihi chela dimina, kema deat amer (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo, usemala itkelil bimina, man deavid yemina semala, usemala yemina, ha ihu keillu chariv alma.

Ta chaze, aharon yemina. levae semala, korach bae lemebad chillufa dimina lismala, begin kach itannash. vela od ella deishtechach beh lishana bisha, veitanash becholla. ribbi yehuda amar, semala itkelil tadir bimina, korach baa leachlefa tikkuna dilella vetatta, begin kach itavid meella vetatta.

Vayyikkach korach, may vayyikkach. nasiv eta bisha legarmeh, kol deradaf batar delav dileh, ihu arik mikkammeh. velo od, ella ma deit beh itavid minneh. korach radif batar delav dileh, dileh avid, veachara la ravavch.

Korach azil bemachloket. may machaloket. pelugeta. pelugeta dilella vetatta. uman devae leaflega tikkuna dealma, yitavid mekullehu almin. machaloket, pelugeta deshalom. uman defalig al shalom, palig al shema kaddisha, begin dishma kaddisha, shalom ikre.

Ta chaze, let alma kaim ella al shalom, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, la yachil leitkayyeyma, ad deata veshara alayyhu shalom. umay hu. shabbat, deihu shelama deillae vetattae, ucheden itkayyaym alma. uman defalig aleh, yitavid mealma.

Tzelafchad palig al shabbat, dehava mekoshesh etzim. uman innun etzim. innun ilanin acharanin (157 amud alef) kidamaran. veinnun millin (sefer acher ilanin) dechol, vechol bakkodesh la sharyay, (mikkan vahala mile dechol beshabbat asir vadday) defalig al shelama dealma.

Ribbi yose amar, ketiv (Tehillim 119:165) shalom rav leohave toratecha vegomer. orayyta hu shalom, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:17) vechol netivoteha shalom. vekorach ata leafgama shalom dilella vetatta, begin kach itanish hu meella vetattaa.
Zohar, Sh'lach 11: Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu bar nash bealma, atkin leh kegavvna illaa (yakkira), veyahav leh cheleh vetukepeh beemtzaita degufa, detamman sharya libba. dehu (mezona) tukepa dechol gufa, umittamman ittezan kol gufa. (vechol inun shayyfe degufa mittamman ittezanu) veha libba achid veittakaf baatar illaa dilella. deihu mocha deresha, deshari leella (veachid beh), veda itkeshar beda.

Uvegavvna deda, atkin kudesha berich hu alma. veavad (leh) chad gufa, veatkin shayyfe degufa sacharaneh delibba, velibba share beemtzaita dechol gufa. vechol innun shayyfin ittezanu mehahu libba, dehu tukepa decholla, vecholla beh talyayn. vehahu libba, itkeshar veitachad bemocha illaa desharya leella.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, ashra (sefer acher asdar) leyamma deokyanus deaschar kol yishshuva dealma. veyishshuva dechol shivin umin kolla aschar liyrushalam. viyrushalam beemtzaita dechol yishshuva sharya. vehi aschara lehar habbayit. vehar habbayit aschar laazarot deyisrael. veinnun azarot sacharan lelishkat haggazit, detamman sanheddere gedola yatvin. vetanenan, let yeshiva baazara, ella lemalche bet david bilchodayyhu.

Velishkat haggazit aschar lammizbeach. vehammizbeach aschar levet haulam. vehaulam lahechol. vehechol levet kodesh hakodashim, detamman shechina sharya, vechapporet ucheruvim vearon. vehacha hu libba, dechol ara vealma. umehacha ittezanu kol innun atre deyishshuva, deinnun shayyfi degufa. velibba da ittezan mimmocha deresha, veitachid da beda, hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 15:17) machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai. kegavvna da leella leella, veihu beraza demalka illaa, beraza yakkira setimaa.

Yamma illaa lokovel da. deit yamma leella min yamma, veyamma min yamma. ta chaze, nehar dinur aschar lechamma mashiryayn. mikovleh shivin sitrin, gelifin mishshiva delikin, veinnun sacharan, leinnun shammashe dilgo minnayyhu. veinnun sacharin learba retichin. veinnun sacharan lehahi karta dekaddisha dirvia alayyhu.

Vetana, tamman azarot lego meazarot. velet yeshiva baazara detamman, ella lemalkehon devet david bilchodayyhu, vetamman mishtachche veyatve. vesahnedre gedola, mishtakkeche tamman belishkat haggazit. vehahu be dina alayyhu, dimshammesh laatar dimshammesh. vedina ityehiv mittamman, lekaddishin elyonin, ad demata laatar deikre kodesh hakodashim, deveh kolla, vetamman hu libba sharyay, veda ittezan min mocha dilella, veitachid da beda.

Kegavvna da leella leella, veihu beraza demalka illaa, beraza yakkira setimaa. ad deishtechach, decholla ittezan mimmocha illaa, setimaa decholla. vechad yistakkelun mille, kolla itkeshar da beda veda beda.

Ta chaze, kad anhir attika setima bemocha, umocha anhir lelibba, bederech noam Adonai. veha okimna, veda hu koach Adonai. hahu chela deate meattika kaddisha. setima dechol setimin. yigdal na, deyyitrebe veyisge leella leella. veyitnegid veyitmeshach letatta. kaasher dibbarta, kema deukemuha. lemor, lemelaf mehacha kol darin batrain, lealam ulealme almin. lemor, lememar leda beshaata deakta. lememar da, beshaata dirvavcha. umay hu. Adonai erech appayim vegomer, veha okimna mille.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, emet amay salik mikkan. amar ribbi chiyyay, innun garmu leh deistalik mikkan, deha beshikru dibberu garmayyhu behahu midda debar nash moded bah, moddin leh. vechen shear ochore istelaku, dela yachil moshe lememrinhu, begin deinnun garmu. salachti kidvarecha, kidvarecha mammash, veha attearu chavrayyay, veha ittemar. (amar hamegayh kach matzati baheatekavet asher lifne umittoch hallashon nire shechasar hatechalat hammaamar vegam bimkomot acherim mimmennu chaser veim kol ze lo ratziti laheshameytev min hassefer lehagedil tora valehaadayr)
Zohar, Sh'lach 42: Kol maale shabbeta, kad mekaddeshin yisrael yoma letatta, karoza kariz learba sitre alma, itkenashu mashiryayn kaddishin, attekanu kurseyayn (kaddishin). man chame chedva, bitlat mea vetishin rekiin, kamma memanan, kamma shiltonin, mitkanneshin leatrayyhu. kevan deyisrael letatta mekaddeshin (lekudesha berich hu), keden ittear ilana dechayye, veakish beinnun tarpin dileh, ruach neshivu chad miggo alma deate, veinun anafin deilana mitnanean, vesallekin rechin dealma deate.
Hahu ilana dechayye ittear, veappik nishmatin kaddishin, ufaris al alma. veim kol da, nishmatin nafkin, venishmatin alin, illen mitare illen, illen nafkin veillen alin, veilana dechayye bechedva.

Ucheden, yisrael kullehu mitatterin beitrin deinnun nishmatin kaddishin, kullehu bechedva benayycha. vechol hashshabbat, it lon hahu chedva, vehahu nayycha, vechol tzaddikayyay di beginta, kullehu sallekin umitannegin beinnuga illaa, dealma deate. kevan denafik shabbata, kullehu nishmatin parchin vesallekin.

Ta chaze, kad ayel shabbeta nishmatin nachtin lesharyay al amma kaddisha. venishmatin detzaddikayyay sallekin leella. kad nafik shabbeta, nishmatin sallekin, innun desharu alayyhu deyisrael. venishmatin nachtin, innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay.

Kevan desallekin kullehu nishmatin desharu alayyhu deyisrael. salke vekayymin bediyyukena kamme malka kaddisha, vekudesha berich hu shail lechullehu, may chiddusha hava lechu behahu alma beorayyta. zakkaa ihu man dechidusha deorayyta amrat kammeh. kamma chedva avid kudesha berich hu, kanish lefamalya dileh, veamar, shimu chiddusha deorayyta, deamrat nishmeta da difloni, vechullehu mukeme hahi milla bitre metivte. innun letatta, vekudesha berich hu leella, chatim lehahi milla.

Ta chaze, kad milla itchaddash beorayyta, venishmeta denachta beshabbeta itassekat beinnun millin chadtin, vesalke leella. kol pamalya dilella, tzayytin lehahu milla, vechayyot hakkodesh mitravin begadpin, umitlabbeshan begadpin. vechad shail lon kudesha berich hu, vela tavin veshatkin, keden chayot hakkodesh ma ketiv, (yechezkel 1:24) beamdam terappena chanfehen, kema deat amer (iyyov 32:16) ki amdu lo anu od. (nechemya 8:Adonai) uchefitcho amdu kol haam.

Vei tema, shetika amay karu leh amida. ella, bedibbura it 7 shayyfin demitnaanan bahadeh, libba. rea. kane. lashon. shinnayim. sifvavn. basar. uvishtika kayymu bekiyyumayyhu, bela ninua. veal da kare lashtika amida.

Deha rav hamenuna sava amar, (nusach acher rav metivta) (Tehillim 20:3) yishlach ezrecha mikodesh vegomer. mikodesh, da kiddush yadayim. umitziyyon yisadecha, da hammotzi, deihu said libba devar nash. yizkor kol minchotecha, kol leasgaa milla achara, da nettilat yadayim batrayyta. veolatcha yedashshene sela, da birkat hammazon bezimmun. vei at avid ken, yitten lecha chilvavecha vechol atzatcha yemalle. uveshabbat mekaddesh, da kedushsha rabba. veal milla da, itattaru tzaddikayyay began eden, mishshabbat leshabbat achara.
Zohar, Sh'lach 46: (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol, may ka chama, dehava kaim kame malacha, umitlebash bilvushin meluchelachin, ad decharoza nafik, veamar hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav. amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv hacha veomed lifne hammalach, may lifne hammalach. dehava dain dinoy, hahu dichtiv beh, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) veal tomar lifne hammalach ki shegaga hi. may ka mashma lan. dechol bar nash dela zache behay alma, leitattefa beittufa demitzva, uleitlabbesha bilvusha demitzva. kad ayel behahu alma, kaim bilvusha tinnufa, dela itzterich, vekaim bedina aleh.

Ta chaze, kama levushin mizdammenin behahu alma, vehahu bar nash dela zache behay alma bilvushin demitzva, kad ayel lehahu alma, melabbeshin leh bechad levusha deishtemoda legabbe marehon degehinnam, vehahu levusha, vavy leman deitlebash beh. deha kamma gardine nimusin, zeminin leachada beh, veayyle leh laggehinam. ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar (Kohelet 9:8) bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim.
Tana beraza desifra ditzniuta, arba malchin nafkin lekadmut arba. behu talyayn kaanavim beitkela, tzeriran behu 7 rehitin, sahadin sahaduta. vela kayymin beduchetayyhu.
Raya mehemna tzitztzit pikkuda da ihu leadkara kol pikkude orayyta veginah kema deat amer ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitztzevot Adonai vaasitem otam da ihu simana demalikka leadkara ulemaabbeda.
Ketoyv (Shemot 28:36) veasita tzitz zahav, veha okimna raza detztzitz leitatra beh kahana rabba. veda ihu tzitz, leistakkela beh ayynin, deihu siman dealma illaa, deitatar beh kahana rabba.
Uvegin kach istakkeluta dileh mechappera al azzut panim, dela kayyeyma lekammeh, ella panim dekshot, raza dechol innun panim illain, deinnun panim dikshot, panim deemet. dichlilan beemet deyaakov.
Tzitztzit ihu nukeva, raza dealma tattaa. istakkeluta leadkera. tzitz dechar, tzitztzit nukeva, veda lechol var nash. tzitz lechahana.

Vetanenan, asur leistakkela bishchinta, begin kach it techela, begin ditchelet, ihu kurseyay levet david, vetikkuna dileh. veda ihu dachala min kodam Adonai ledachala mehahu atar. veal da ureitem oto uzzechartem et kol mitztzevot Adonai, veda kurseyay dedayynin bah dine nefashot, kema deokmuha, dechol gavvnin tavin lechelma, bar techela, deihu kurseyay desalik bedina dinfashot.
Ketiv venatnu al tzitztzit hakkanaf petil techelet. venatnu al hakkanaf la ketiv, ella venatnu al tzitztzit. deda ihu dechafe al shear chutin.

Ureitem oto uzzechartem, uchetiv, (Devarim 25:17) zachor et asher asa lecha amalek. may tama da. ella livra defaritz gidra, uneshacheh kalba. kol zimna daavoy bae leochacha livreh, hava amar havi dachir kad nashich lach kalva. uf hacha ureitem oto uzzechartem, deda ihu atar desallekin nishmatin lemedan.

Kegavvna da, (Bamidbar 21:8) vehaya kol hannashuch veraa oto vachay, amay. ella kad salik leenoy, vechame diyyukena dehahu denashich leh, hava dachil, vetztzalle kodam Adonai, vahava yada deihu onsha dechayyayvayya. kol zeman divra chame retztzua daavoy, dachil meavoy. ishteziv mirtztzua, ishteziv mikkolla. man garim leh leishtezava. hahu dechame beenoy hahu retztzua, hahu retztzua garim leh leishtazva. veal da veraa oto vachay, chame retztzua dealke leh, veihu avid leh leishtezava. uf hacha ureitem oto uzzechartem, vaasitem vadday. vei lav, ha retztzua, dehay yigrom lechon, lemehevi tavin lefulechana dili tadir, ucheden vaasitem.

Velo taturu achare levavchem, yimna minnechon bishin orchin acharanin, vadday, lo taturu, vela taavdu bishin. veal da salleka gon techela. da techelet, damya lekisse hakkavod, ma kisse hakkavod, avid levar nash lemehach learcha demeshar, ledakkea leh. uf hay techelet, avid lebar nash lemehach beorach meshar, vadday decholla it ledachala mehay atar, lemehach bemeshar.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 24:16) mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzadik vaomar razi li vegomer. mikkenaf haaretz, da kanaf detztzitztzit, deihu kanaf haaretz. zemirot shamanu, illen shear chutin, denafkin vetalyayn meatar illaa, go innun shevilin illain, denafkin mechachma illaa. tzevi latztzaddik, da tzaddik chay haolamim, deinnun chutin innun shepiru dileh, deha minneh nafkin, vechol chuta kelila bitren sitrin. vechad istakkalna, amena razi li razi li, deha miggo raza illaa dechol mehemnuta nafkin. vechad istakkalna bitchelet, vachamena retztzua lealkaa, atar dechilu lemidchal, amena oy li, divne nasha la yade leashgecha uleistakkela al ma mitanshin leshakra, behay bogdim bagadu, deha korin keriat shema bela tzitztzit, vesahadin sahaduta deshikra, veillen innun bogdim debagadu, meshakkere degarmayyhu.

Uveged bogdim bagadu, levusha dilhon bela tzitztzit, ikre beged bogdim. levusha deinnun bogdim devagdu, dimshakre vesahadin sahaduta deshikra bechol yoma. vavy lon, vavy lenafshehon, desalke behahu kurseyay detichla lemedan. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay, hahu beged dilhon ishtemoda legabbe kol marehon dedinin. vavy lon, delet lon chulaka bealma deate. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demalbushehon vetikkunehon ishtemodan leella, leotava lon behay alma uvealma deate. (ad kan) (Shemot 43 amud alef vehaya leot vechulei)

Pikkuda da mitzvat tzitzit, kalil techelet velavan, dina verachame benura. eshsha chivvavra la achil, techela achil veshatze. (divre hayamim b 7:1) vattochal haola, chivvavr mimina, techelet missemala. ammuda deemtzaita yichud ben tarvayyhu, yarok. uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, meematay korin et shema beshacharit, mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. uvegin da takkinu parashat tzitzit lemikre lah beyichuda.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kamma sahade avid kudesha berich hu leashada behu bivne nasha, vechullehu beeta uvesahaduta kayymin lokovleh. kam betzafra oshit ragloy lemehach, sahadayyay kayymin lokovleh, machrizin veamrin, (Shmuel 1 2:9) ragle chasidav yishmor vegomer. (Kohelet 4:17) shemor raglecha kaasher telech. (Mishlei 4:26) palles magal raglecha. aftach enoy leistakkela bealma, sahadayyay amre, (Mishlei 4:25) enecha lenochach yabbitu. kam lemallela, sahadayyay amre (Tehillim 34:14) netzor leshoncha mera vegomer. oshit yedoy bemille alma, sahadayyay amre (Tehillim 34:15) sur mera vaase tov.

I tzayit lehu, yaut. vei la, ketiv (zecharya 3:1) vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. kullehu sahadin aleh bechovoy leella. i bae bar nash leishtaddela befulechana dekudesha berich hu, kullehu sahadin sannegorin kammeh, vekayymin leashada aleh tavan, beshaata deitzterich leh.

Kam betzafra, mevarech kama birchan. anach tefilin beresheh ben enoy. bae lezakfa resheh, chame shema kaddisha illaa, achid verashim al resheh. uretzuin talyayn mehay gisa umehay gisa al libbeh. ha estakkal bikara demareh. oshit yedoy, chame yeda achara, mitkashshera bekishshura dishma kaddisha. ahdar yedeh veistakkal bikareh demareh. itattaf beittufa demitzva, bearba zivyayn dichsuteh, arba malchin nafkin lekadmut arba. arba sahade keshot demalka, talyay mearba zivyayn, vetalyayn behu kaanavim beitkela.

Ma atkela, deihu chad, vetalyayn beh kama anavim, mehay setar umehay setar. kach hay, mitzva chada, vetalyayn beh kama anavim, vezagin uzemorin tzeririn behu, shiva rehitin illen innun shiva tzeririn ditchelta, devae lecharcha beh bechol chad vechad, o leasgaa ad telesar, man deyosif, la yosif alayyhu al telesar. man deyimat, la yimat mishshiva.
Vetana, hay techelet, hu raza dedavid malka. veda chuta deavraham, dezacha beh livnoy batroy. may techelet. tachlit decholla. (vadday) ribbi yehuda omer, kisse hakkavod ikre.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, shiva kerichan deihi shechinta sheviata decholla vadday. deha hi mitbarcha mishitta acharanin, al yeda detzaddik. vei telat asar, telat asar innun, kema deukemuha bitlat asar mechilan. vehay hi pitcha dechullehu.

Vehi chuta chad, ureshima bigvavnaha, ugevavna dilah nafik, mechad nuna deazil beyam kinneret. vechinneret al shemah itkere. veal da, kinnor hava taluy leella mearsa dedavid, deha (dedavid) vadday ihu kinnor dedavid menaggen meelav, lemalka kaddisha illaa. uvegin kach, gevavnoy ayel ad rekia, umerkia ad kuresyay.

Vehacha ketiv mitzva, kema deat amer (Melachim b 18:36) mitzvat hammelech hi. (Ester 3:3) madua atta over et mitzvat hammelech. (nechemya 11:23) ki mitzvat hammelech. vetana, yesoda vesharsha bemalka mitatterin kachada. vehay hu kitra ufitcha lechol shear kitrin. dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:19) ze hashshaar laAdonai. veal da ketiv, ureitem oto uzzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai, leachlela behay kol shear kitrin. veal da innun sahade sahaduta, vela kayyme beduchetayyhu begin deihi mitzvat.
Vetanenan, tashmishe mitzva, nizrakin. vei tema, ha lulav vaarava vechulei, tashmishe kedushsha innun, amay nizrakin. ella tashmishe kedushsha, begin dirshimin bakketiva dishma kaddisha.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, innun chutin, leachazaa hech talyayn mikkan umikkan, led sitre alma, mehay atar. veihi shalta al kolla. beraza delev, deihi libba dechol hay alma, velibba deillae, vetalya ballev illaa. vecholla hu ballev, denafak mechachma illaa. amar ribbi yitzchak, shiura dehay, (sefer acher veureka) dehay, ittemar beatvavn gelifan deribbi elazar.

Amar ribbi yehuda, amar kudesha berich hu, man devae lemehach batar dachalti, yehach batar libba da, uvatar ayynin dekayymin alah. man innun ayynin. kema deat amer, (tehillim lo) ene Adonai el tzaddikim aval attem lo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem. may tama begin deattem zonim acharehem.

Amar ribbi chiyay, may taama hacha yetziat mitzrayim, dichtiv asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim. ella, begin dechad nafku mimmitzrayim, behay chulaka al. uvehay, katil kudesha berich hu katula demitzrayim. veal da beatreh itdechar, uveatreh izdehar lehu beda. may beatreh. begin dehay mitzva, hi atar dilah.

Tane ribbi yesa, ketiv (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot. kime, kayyom mibbae leh, deha bechad zimna nafku vela itakkevu. ella keinnun yomin illain, deitbarcha behu keneset yisrael. kach zammin kudesha berich hu leappaka lehu leyisrael min galuta, ucheden ketiv (Yeshayahu 12:4) vaamartem bayom hahu hodu laAdonai kiru vegomer, zammeru Adonai ki geut asa mudaat zot bechol haaretz. may mudaat zot. begin dehashta ishtemoda zot beittufa demitzva. behahu zimna ishtemoda zot, bechamma nimusin dilah, deyaaved kudesha berich hu atin venissin bealma, keden ketiv (zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
Zohar, Sh'lach 8: Ta chaze, let reshu livne alma lememar millin setimin ulefarsha lon, bar butzina kaddisha rabbi shimon, deha kudesha berich hu istakkam al yedoy. uvegin dedara dileh reshima hu leella vetatta, veal da millin ittemaru beitgalyay al yedoy, vela yehe dara kedara da deihu share begavih, ad deyete malka meshicha.

Aval ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto (becholla hu keen dugema deella ta chaze) raza demilla, telat almin it leh lekudesha berich hu, deihu ganiz begavavyyhu. alma kadmaa, hahu illaa temira decholla, dela istakkal beh, vela ityeda beh, bar ihu, deihu ganiz begavvivy.
Alma tinyayna, deihu kashir behahu dilella, veda hu dekudesha berich hu ishtemoda minneh, kema dichtiv (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek, ze hashshaar laAdonai. veda hu alma tinyayna.

Alma telitaa, hahu alma tattaa minnayyhu, deishtechach beh piruda, veda hu alma, demalache illae sharyayn begavvivy, vekudesha berich hu ishtechach beh, vela ishtechach. ishtechach beh hasheta, kad baan leistakkela uleminda leh, istallak minnayyhu, vela itchaze, ad dechullehu shaale ayye mekom kevodo. (yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. vehay hu alma dela ishtechach beh tedira.

Kegavvna da, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam. keden it leh telat almin. alma kadmaa: hay alma deikre alma defiruda, ubbar nash ishtechach beh vela ishtechach. kad baan leistakkela beh, istallak minnayyhu vela itchaze.
Alma tinyayna, alma deihu kashir behahu alma illaa, veda hu gan eden di beara, deda hu kashir bealma achara illaa, umehay ityeda veishtemoda alma achara.

Alma telitaa, alma illaa temira, ganiz vesatim, delet man deyeda leh, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. vecholla kegavvna illaa, (kadmaa daamena vabekashevat) dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam.

(Ta chaze vadday) al da ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem vegomer, kema deukemuha. veillen innun betzelem elohim, veillen yartin yeruta illaa kegavvna dileh. veal da azhar beorayyta, (Devarim 14:1) lo titgoddu velo tashimu karcha. deha la itavid, veha shechiach bealmin tavin illain veyakkirin, lehevon chaddan kad istalak (tzaddika) mehay alma.

Veta chaze, ilmale la chav adam, la yitam taama demota behay alma, bezimna deayil lealmin acharanin. aval begin dechav, taam taama demota, ad la yeul leinnun almin, veitpashshat rucha mehay gufa, veashar leh behay alma, verucha istachya binhar dinur lekabbela onsha. ulevatar ayyla legan eden divara, veizdammena leh mana achara dinhora, kehay partzufa degufa dehay alma mammash. veitlabbash veittakkan beh. vetamman hu madora dileh tadir. veitkeshar beresh yarche veshabbatte benishmeta. vesalik veitattar leella leella, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho vegomer.

Midde chodesh bechadsho amay. ella raza demilla, begin chadtute desihara, deitattera (ateravey) leanhara min shimsha behahu zimna. vechen midde shabbat beshabbatto, midde shabbat da sihara. beshabbatto da shimsha. dinhora atya lah min tamman. veal da kolla chad milla. veda hu berira demilla, bar lechayyayvayya dichtiv behu mita lechullehu almin, karet mikkullehu almin. veishtatzyayn mikkolla, kad la ayyle bitshuva. amar ribbi yehuda, berich rachamana, deshailna veravavchna millin illen, vekaimna alayyhu.
Zohar, Vayakhel 13: Ta chaze, kevan deal shabbeta, veittammar hahu maddura, kol eshshin deeshsha kashya ittemaru veitkafyayn, vaafillu eshsha degehinnam, vechayyayvin degehinnam, it lon nayycha. vecholla tatta veella it lehu nayycha. kad nafak shabbeta, umevarchin yisrael al nura, keden nafkin kol eshshin demittammeran, kol chad vechad leatreh. uvegin dela leitteara eshsha achara, ketiv (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, eshsha demadbecha amay.

Ella kad al shabbeta, karoza kare bechullehu rekiin, ittekanu retichin, ittekanu mashiryayn, lekadmut marechon. keden nafik chad rucha missitra dedarom, vehahu rucha itperash al kol innun chelin umashiryayn delistar yemina, veitlabbeshan beh, vehahu rucha ikre levusha dikar deshabbeta. keden patore dehay alma, mittakkenan bechad hechala. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, desiddura defatoreh itchaze tamman kedka yaut, vekayyeyma kolla mittakkena, bela kissufa, inish kefum cheleh.

Kad al shabbeta, itzterichu innun amma kaddisha leaschaa garmayyhu (136 amud bet) mishshimusha dechol, may taama. begin divchol, rucha achara azla veshatya veshara al amma. vechad bae bar nash lenafka min hahu rucha, uleaala berucha achara kaddisha illaa, bae leaschaa garmeh, lemishre aleh hahu rucha illaa kaddisha.

Ta chaze raza illaa demilla, kol innun shit yomin, (keyama milla decholla) itachadan beraza dechad nekuda kaddisha, vechullehu yomin itachadan beh. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin levar besitra achara. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin lego (hakedama Adonai amud bet) meiggula kaddisha, veitachadan binkuda kaddisha.

Veyisrael kaddishin, vechol innun demitassekin bikdushsha, kol yoma deshabbeta, itachadan kol innun shit yomin, beinnun shit yomin dilgo deitachadan behahi nekuda, itachadan behay, begin lenatra lon. vechol innun shit yomin (davar acher veinnun shit yomin dilgo) deshabbeta, hahi nekuda temira ihi. kevan deal shabbeta, keden salleka hahi nekuda, veitattera veitachada leella, vechullehu temirin begavvah.

Ta chaze, it yamim veit yamim. yeme chol, kema deittemar, veillen kayyeymin levar leammin. yeme hashshabbat, deinnun yeme hashavua, kayyeymin leyisrael. vechad salleka hay nekuda, kolla itgeniz, veihi salleka, kevan deihi salleka, ikre shabbat.

Mahu shabbat. i tema begin shevita, dichtiv ki vo shavat, yaut hu. aval raza demilla, kevan desalleka hay nekuda, unehora nahir, keden mitattera ihi baavahan, kevan demitattera ihi baavahan, keden itchabberat veitachadat behu, lemehve chad, veikre kolla shabbat. shabbat: 300 bat. 300 ha ukemuha, raza ditlat avahan, demitachadan bevat yechida, veihi mitattera behu, veinnun bealma deate. vecholla ihu chad. veda ihu 300 bat, lemeheve kolla chad.

Vei tema, shabbat haggadol, veihu leella, amay ikre shabbat. ella vadday hachi hu. veraza demilla, bechol atar nekuda deihi ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:8) shamreni keishon bat ayin, begin deihi (nekuda) ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat.

Alma deate, ihu (180 amud alef) hechala lehahi nekuda illaa, vechad ihi kayyeyma, venatla begadpaha laavahan, leitattera leella ikre kolla shabbat. vechad avahan mitatteran leella, bego nekuda illaa, ikre shabbat. nekuda tattaa (70 amud bet) kad mitattera baavahan ikre shabbat.

rashi: Vaani nasachti malki. lamma regashtem, vaani minniti li et ze linsoch velimloch al tziyyon har kadshi?
targum: Vaana rabbiti malki umaniteh al tur makdeshi:

ohc: Im chafetz banu Adonai. nitchakkemu ledabber bilshon safek, kede sheyyannichu lahem ligmor haddevarim, ki yomru sheen divrehem ella legeder haefsharut velo bivchinat hahechlet, velaze hinnichum lomar kol haddevarim uvegamran amru lirgom. vechan habben shoel: lamma lo ragmu al techillatan shel devarim, shehare en bedivrehem haacharonim tosefet veshinnuy mittechillat divrehem? ella letzad shebbitchillat divrehem amru "im", hayu yoshvim umetzappim gamran shel devarim, uchesheamdu bahen amru lirgom.
Eretz asher vegomer. kan gezerat maamar "im chafetz".

Hi zavat chalav udevash. perush hi velo acheret kayyotze bah, vehammeraggelim amru "zavat chalav udevash hi", en tevat "hi" mufeleget mehaaretz sholelet metziut kayyotze bah, ella lezikkaron asher alav ba maamar "zavat chalav udevash".

Vechol haam vegomer. perush, veaf al pi chen ochaltam haaretz. o yirtze bedikduk amro betochah, lomar kol shennitkayyemu betochah hem anshe middot uvaze yuchelu chayot, aval kol sheenam anshe middot omdim chutza lah leval tochal otam haaretz:

Ki tavou el eretz moshvotechem vegomer. letzad sheraa Adonai madve libbam bigzerat tiltulam bammidbar arbaim shana, muflagim mibbiat haaretz, laze saad libbam bemitzvot hatteluyot baaretz lechonen rucham ki yaalu veyirshu et admatam, vehafelagat hazzeman lo tarea ledavar hammuchzak lavo. vedikdek lomar asher ani noten lachem, hagam shehaddor hahu pigrehem yippelu bammidbar kol haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim ben esrim, ba lomar ki maase banim yityaches gam lehaavot ki et benehem hekim tachtam.

Od nire lomar ki amro noten lachem, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 90:) minnayin litchiyyat hammetim min hattora? dichtiv "asher nishba Adonai laavotechem latet lahem" (Shemot 6:4), lachem lo neemar ella lahem vegomer ad kan. kemo chen hivticham sheyyakumu bitchiyyat hammetim veyirshu et admatam.

Vannehi vegomer vechen hayinu beenehem. hodiu baze ki afillu shear haanashim hargilim sham enam domim lahem, veharaya ki hitpalleu bahem shehem kachagavim letzad hafelaat miut gufam, ha lamadta sheotam hargilim immahem enam bedimyon ze.

Vayyomru vegomer lirgom vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo nirgeshu bemaamar rishon sheamar kalev "alo naale veyarashnu vegomer nuchal lah". venire ki ledivre kalev lo chashshu, lefi sheddevarav betelim meatzman, sheen edut yachid omedet legabbe edut rabbim, dichtiv (Devarim 19:15) "al pi shene edim yakum davar", laze lo chashu lidvarav. ma sheen ken keshebbau yachad divre yehoshua vechalev, meatta hurea edut hameraggelim, ki din shene edim kedin mea edim (makkot 5.), veedut shekula hi zot, veen kan edut lo shel meraggelim velo shel yehoshua vechalev, vechazar haddin lema shehaya kodem shilluach hameraggelim, laze chashu lahem veamru lirgom otam.

Vetzarich ladaat lamma lo hiskilu ladun al pi mishpat hattora lehachechish divre haasara bedivre hashshenayim, kevan sheddin haedut hu tere kemea umea kitre. veefshar sheddanu bihoshua shehu pasul leedut bema shennogea lemoshe, ki haya mesharto mibbechurav:

rashi: Lachen anakatmo gaava. baavur ze sheen yissurin bain alehem, heenikatam haggaava laalot al tzavvaram gassut haruach:
Yaataf shit chamas lamo. hechamas sheosin, ose otam shemenim veotef et shetotehem vaagavotehem beovi shuman uvasar:
targum: Lechach ken atartinun gevtanuta kelila dimshavyan bereshehon hi min chatof dilhon:

rashi: Ki chalinu veappecha vegomer. veal kol zot:
targum: Arum ishtetzana min tukefach umin rugezach itbahelna:

ohc: Mibbilti yecholet Adonai vegomer. perush, o sheen bo koach chas veshalom keneged yoshve haaretz, o al derech amro (Tehillim 14:1) "amar naval belibbo en elohim", perush, sheafes hayyecholet shehaya kodem laze chas veshalom, veyesh baze chillul hashshem gadol.

Haam. ba maamar ze listor taanat hachenasat zaro shel moshe, veamar ki chillul hashshem yihye gam baze, kol shello machnis haam hazze, uchemo shekkatavti befasuk "veshamu mitzrayim" (bammidbar 14:13). vechoach taanat moshe hi shehagam shehem menaatzim oto, im yahargem bevat achat yesh chillul hashshem gadol bechol haolam. veulay ki hu ze sheramaz hakkatuv bitchillat divre moshe sheamar vayyomer moshe el Adonai, perush amira zo hayta lesibbat devarim hannogim el Adonai kede shello yitchallel shemo chas veshalom.

Vayyishchatem bammidbar. taam sheddibber belashon ze, lirmoz et asher yagshimu haddevarim belohe olam, vehattaam ki keshettihye hassibba ki chas veshalom hugbal bechoach hinne hu begeder haggeshem chas veshalom.

Vayyihyu vene yisrael bammidbar vegomer. kashe, ma ba hakkatuv lehashemienu shehayu yisrael bammidbar? veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat (shabbat tzav:) veze leshonam: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mekoshesh maavir arba ammot birshut harabbim haya, ad kan. gam amru bemassechet shabbat perek 1 (shabbat 6:) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan: seratya ufelatya vechulei zo hi reshut harabbim, vehikshu bashshas: velichshov nammi midbar, deha tanya ezehu reshut harabbim seratya vechulei vehammidbar, veteretz abbaye: la kashya, kan bizman shehayu yisrael sheruyim bammidbar, kan bazzeman hazze. uferesh Rashi veze leshono: bazzeman hahu chashuv reshut harabbim, bazzeman hazze eno mekom hilluch larabbim, perush, uvarayta dekatane "vehammidbar", ha ka mashma lan dei ikka rabbim metzuyim achshav bammidbar tadir, gam ken hu bichlal reshut harabbim.

Vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv, kesheratza lehodia avon hammekoshesh shehu maavir arba ammot lisvarat rav yehuda, hikdim lomar "vayyihyu vene yisrael bammidbar", perush, uvaze hu shennechshav lo chillul hashshabbat lehitchayyev mita, aval im lo hayu yisrael bammidbar, hagam shehaya maavir arba ammot sham eno chayyav, sheen lo din reshut harabbim.

Ulefi sevarat rambam (hilchot shabbat 94), kefi ma shennishma middevarav mimma shemmana hammidbar bichlal reshut harabbim velo chillek im metzuyim yisrael lesheenam metzuyim, uferashti bo bechibburi "chefetz Adonai" shechibbarti bime charpi, sheharambam mefaresh divre abbaye al ze hadderech: "kan bizman shehayu yisrael" – perush, tanna shehizkir hammidbar medabber al oto zeman, laze menao gam ken, vetanna shello hizkir eno medabber ella bazzeman hazze, uzeman hazze enan metzuyim holche midbarot, uletzad sheenam metzuyim lo tarach lehashemienu dino. vein hache namme sheafillu bazzeman hazze hammidbar reshut harabbim, im ken nachzor lekushyatenu lederech ze: lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lomar "vayyihyu vene yisrael bammidbar"?

Veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru od sham (shabbat tzav:) veze leshonam: bematnita tana mekoshesh tolesh hava, ad kan. uletzad shettakshe ledivre hattanna, vahalo amru rabbotenu (chullin pach.) bedine kissuy dam chayya vaof en mechassin baafar hammidbar mippene shehi melecha veenah matzmachat, ad kan. im ken minnayin yatzu tzemachim bammidbar shettelasham mekoshesh? laze hikdim lomar vayyihyu vene yisrael bammidbar, veamru zichronam livracha (bammidbar Rabba 99) shebbeerah shel miryam haya mashke vehaya maale gannot ufardesim, veim ken hayu gedelim tzemachim bammidbar litlosh. gam lisvarat rav acha bar yaakov sheamar (shabbat sham) meammer haya, yityashshev gam ken hakkatuv bederech ze.

Vayyimtzeu ish vegomer. amar leshon metzia, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni) sheamar lahem moshe: tzeu ureu im yesh adam shechillel et hashshabbat vechulei ad kan. laze amar "vayyimtzeu" al derech amro (Ester 2:23) "vayvukkash haddavar vayyimmatze".

Mekoshesh etzim beyom hashshabbat. hikdim zichron hammaase kodem zichron hayyom, velo amar "beyom hashshabbat mekoshesh etzim", lomar shello nitallem mimmennu shabbat kesheasa maasav. veim haya makdim zichron shabbat, haya nishma shemmetzauhu beyom hashshabbat, perush hayyadua etzlam, aval meamro "mekoshesh etzim beyom hashshabbat" chozer zichron hashshabbat el hammekoshesh, sheyyodea ki shabbat hu. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) nitchakkemu lehotzi davar ze sheyyodea haya shehu shabbat mimma shekkafal lomar bappasuk sheachar ze "mekoshesh etzim", shebba lomar sheachar shehodiuhu shabbat hu chazar lekoshesh. uledarkenu taam shekkafal lomar paam sheniyya "mekoshesh" lehodienu shello hayta lo shiggat melacha, ella hodiuhu ki hi melacha shechayyav aleha, vehu amro "oto mekoshesh", perush hu haya yodea ki ose melacha, uvaze hayu lo zedon shabbat uzedon melacha.

rashi: Panu veevratecha. ufanu venivaru vehalchu lahem beevratecha:
Kemo hege. kedibbur hammemaher lichlot:
targum: Arum kol yomana itpeniu kodamach berugezach shetzena yome chayana hech havel puma desitva:

ohc: Vattissa vegomer vayyivku haam. amro haam, velo hispik bema shezzachar hannosim kolam, lomar ki lo kol haeda bachu ballayla hahu ella chelek mehem, hagam shebbichlalut kullam nasu kolam ledivre hammeraggelim asher hifliu lehafechid.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sota la.; taanit 29.) sheamru veze leshonam: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, attem bechitem bechiyya shel chinnam, ani ekba lachem bechiyya ledorot, ad kan. vehu maamar hakkatuv vattissa kol haeda vegomer, perush shehayta az, veze garam laam bechiyya ballayla hahu ledorot, veim amar hakkatuv "vayyivku ballayla" hayu chozrim haddevarim laeda hannizkeret asher shamu divre hammeraggelim.

Vayyishlach otam vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ken achar shekkevar zachar hashshelichut shete peamim "vayyishlach otam" vegomer (Bamidbar 13:3), "asher shalach moshe" (Bamidbar 13:16)? veulay sheyyodia hakkatuv sheasa lahem levaya, venatan hakkatuv taam hallevaya veamar latur vegomer, shehutzrechu lishmira lefi shehalchu lederech sakkana. od yirtze shennitkavven ballevaya ladderech asher yaturu shekken mishpat hallevaya.

rashi: Mi yodea oz appecha. beyamim muatim kaelle mi yikne lo lev ladaat et oz appecha leyira otcha, veatta cheyiratcha evratecha. keshem sheatta yarauy ken evratcha kasha, venifra min hachotim:
targum: Man hu deyada leatva ushena detukefach elahen tzadikaya dedachalin minach meshadchin rugezach:

ohc: Veavdi chalev ekev vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir ella kalev velo yehoshua. gam kavvanat amro hayta ruach acheret immo, gam amro vaymalle acharay, gam amro vahaviotiv betosefet vav bigzerat hakkatuv.
