Achen perush hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: veavdi chalev, vetaam sheani kore oto avdi hu ekev, perush sachar asher hayta ruach acheret immo, shehagam sheyyehoshua gam ken lo nietz Adonai im hammeraggelim, af al pi chen ze haya lo sibba tefillat moshe hitztzilato miyyetzer hara umikkochotav shehem hammeraggelim leval yatuhu, ma sheen ken kalev shennichnas begeder sakkanat yetzer hara vechevrato harshaa vattachel ruach raa lefaamo, veharaya shehalach venishtattach al kivrot haavot. vehu amro ruach acheret immo, veaf al pi chen vaymalle acharay, perush hishlim achar retzono yitbarach. vedikdek lomar bederech ze letzad sheyyesh baadam shene yoatzin: yoetz ra veyoetz tov lalechet achare Adonai, vehu hishlim umille achare chelek Adonai. veze hu al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) mi shebbaa avera leyado venitztzol mimmenna notnin lo sachar keose mitzva. veze eno bihoshua ki lo hayta ruach acheret immo lehateoto midderech hassechel ki moshe menao, veyesh koach bitfillat hatztzaddikim gam livchina zo besod (Shmuel 2 23:3) "tzaddik moshel yirat elohim", vehaven. asher al ken zacha kalev sheyyikkare eved Adonai kemoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom.

Vehosif od lomar, millevad hammaala hannizkar, od "vahaviotiv el haaretz asher ba shamma", perush lehitpallel al atzmo. vechan ramaz hitatztzemuto ad shemmille achare Adonai, vechavvanat hatava zo hi shello bilvad shello nichnas begeder haggezera, ella hivticho bachayyim, shehagam shehaya ben arbaim shana az vegazar Adonai sheyyeshvu arbaim shana bammidbar, hivticho sheyyichye ad boo shamma. vehu amro vahaviotiv, hare huvtach bechayyav arbaim shana ma shello naasa leshum tzaddik baolam.

Veulay ki laze hikdim likroto avdo, lomar shehagam sheyyodiehu havetachat hachayyim arbaim shana lo yazur achor meavodat Adonai letzad shearach yom kitztzo. uchevar perashti (shabbat 30.) bemaase chizkiyya shehosif lo Adonai chamesh esre shana, shennishalti yishshuv maamaram zichronam livracha sheheshiv Adonai ledavid kesheshshaal mimmennu "hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay" vegomer, veamar lo gezera hi millefanay sheen modiin lo laadam kitztzo vechulei, ad kan, velamma hodia Adonai lechizkiyya? veheshavti ki davka ketz shehaadam mevi immo hecharutz, dichtiv (Iyov 14:5) "im charutzim yamav", aval tosfot yamim lo nichlal bichlal gezera zo. vechafetz Adonai lehodia al derech amram baggemara (shabbat 10.) bappasuk "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem", shehannoten mattana lachavero tzarich lehodio, laze modia Adonai chasdo keshemmosif yamim al yeme adam. vehu maamar "vahaviotiv" vegomer, vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv bihoshua siman 14 "vayyomer elav kalev" vegomer "veatta hinne hecheya Adonai oti kaasher dibber", vehem devarenu atzmam. veamar od vezaro yorishenna, lomar ki asa Adonai chesed ze gam lezaro.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "ekev" asher asa shene devarim tovim. echad, "hayta ruach acheret immo" – perush, shello halach achar atzat hammeraggelim, vehashsheni – "vaymalle acharay" shehishtik haam vesatar divre hammeraggelim. ushetayim shillem lo Adonai: echad – "vahaviotiv" vegomer, 2 – "yorishenna". vetaam shello hizkir yehoshua, letzad shehu zacha mitztzad tefillat moshe velo hutzrach lehitatztzem mikkocho.
Vehaanashim vegomer. perush, heshivu ledivre kalev veamru "lo nuchal" vegomer, vehosifu lomar dibba baaretz lomar shehagam shehayu yecholin lirash otah, meusa hi letzad sheochelet yoshveha vegomer:

Shelach lecha anashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro lecha, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota lod.): ledatecha, ani eni metzavvecha vechulei, vekashe lamma yaskim Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot leammo veyofia maamaro al atzat reshaim. ulehavin hainyan air baddavar, mibbeten mi yatza hakkerach haraa haggedola hannisbevet mehameraggelim, im mitztzad hammaase, en bo ra, ki halo matzinu (Yehoshua 2:1) shekkemo chen shalach yehoshua shenayim anashim meraggelim vayraggelu haaretz, im ken en haddavar mechoar mitztzad atzmo, veim mitztzad haanashim hameraggelim shehayu reshaim, halo matzinu shennivcharu al pi Adonai habbochen levavot uchelayot, veheid hakkatuv alehem "kullam anashim", shehem tzaddikim:

Achen yitbaer haddavar al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (yalkut shemauni 742) veze leshonam: bitchilla nitkabbetzu etzel moshe lishloach hameraggelim velo ratza, veamar lahem kevar hivtichanu Adonai, veamru lo ki haamamim yodim banu sheanu baim lirash otam vehem matminim et mamonam, uchesheyyaggiu yisrael lo yimtzeu kelum venimtza divre Adonai batel chas veshalom, veaz "vayyitav haddavar beene moshe" ma sheamru (Devarim 1:22) "veyachperu lanu et haaretz", perush hachafirot shemmatminim bahem mamonam vechulei, kevan sheshshama moshe kach nilkad beyadam, ad kan. hinne mimma sheddikdeku bemaamaram zichronam livracha veamru "nilkad beyadam" yore shebbemirma dibberu ulechaduhu bearma, veen yadua ma hi mirma sheddibberu befihem shebbah nilkad.

Achen shene mine riggul hem: haechad hu riggul ladaat derech asher yaalu vah, gam ladaat im yatrichu kol yisrael laalot o chelek echad mehem, uchemaamar meraggele haay sheheshivu lihoshua (Yehoshua 7:3): "al yaal kol haam, kealpayim ish o kishloshet alafim ish yaalu vegomer, al teyagga shamma et kol haam", veriggul ze lo yeraggel ella et hair asher yavou shamma, uchesheyyichbeshuha veyaskimu latzur al ir acheret yeraggeluha achat leachat. veriggul sheni hu riggul kelali, ze yore ki rotzim lirot uleshaer im yesh koach bahem lichbosh, vehu hariggul shehiskimu yisrael lishloach leraggel hu lichlalut eretz kenaan kemo shemmeforash bammaase, veze yaggid miut haemuna baAdonai uvikkush toana. velaze amru bammidrash shello ratza moshe ad shennitchakkemu bemirma vaydabberu lo shelletzad hatemanat hammamon hem sholchim, vetaam ze tzodek bechol eretz kenaan, venilkad beyadam veshalach meraggelim letachlit ze, ki en ra baddavar. kemo chen yehoshua shalach meraggelim lesibba hatztzericha kemo shekkatavti, veen ra ella davka betaam riggul shehaya bedaat yisrael bignevat daat moshe.

Velaze ba devar Adonai el moshe veamar shelach lecha, perush, lema sheatta sover hashshelichut shehi bishvil hatemanat hammamon, perush, aval lo letaam shechoshvim hem, veheiru ki lo machshevotam machshevotav. umoshe efshar shello hevin hakkavvana al seder vehevin derech acher kaasher avaer. o nuchal lomar shehevin ella kevan sheraa she lo menao millishloach asa maase velo nitchakkem al devar melech. vahagam she gilla lo, Adonai chafetz legallot laavadav hannistarot, gam ladaat taam lechol hayyotze mehainyan. veim tomar kushya lelohenu lamma lo mana haddavar mihyot ken, letzad sheraa shezzulat ze hayu pokrim yoter veosim behala yoter mimma sheasu bahalichat hameraggelim.

Od yirtze bemaamar "lecha", letzad shehizkiram bilshon chashivut veamar "anashim" sheyyore shehem tzaddikim, laze amar "lecha" – perush, kol od shehem lefanecha etzlecha hem tzaddikim, aval kesheyyachzeru penehem lalechet bishlichut paka mehem kelila, uchemaamar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 13:26) "vayyelchu vayyavou", veamru zichronam livracha (sota la.) makkish halichatam leviatam vechulei, umizze hirgish moshe vehitpallel al yehoshua shello yelech baatzat reshaim. ulederech ze yitbaer divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru (Bamidbar Rabba 16.) veze leshonam: aval meraggelim sheshshalach moshe reshaim hayu, dichtiv "shelach lecha anashim", ad kan. veen yadua kavvanatam zichronam livracha minnayin mochichim haddevarim mimmaamar "shelach lecha" shershaim hayu. ella sheddiyyeku tevat lecha kemo sheddiyyaknuha – lecha hem anashim aval bashshelichut kesheyyatchilu bahalicha reshaim hem. od yesh lomar shepperush lecha hu: lecha hem tzaddikim aval ani yodea shehem reshaim. veim tomar velamma yaskim Adonai lishloach reshaim, uma gam sheamar hakkatuv "al pi Adonai" veamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba sham) shehaya hakkadosh baruch hu omer peloni leshevet peloni, veulay ki bifrat ze shel hariggul kol yisrael shavu bedaat achat leraggel ad asher riggelu, vehu lirot im yecholin lechavsham kefi yecholet shehaya beyisrael, veze yaggid miut haemuna velaze yikkaru reshaim.

O efshar, letzad shekkavvanat hammeshallechim hayta raa, tafil poal hara bashshaliach, veyachzor lihyot shelucho shel adam kemoto, veyivvaled bo techuna raa ma shello hayta bo kodem, kederech shettivvaled bechinat hakkedushsha bishluche mitzva letova ot, velaze hagam shehayu tzaddikim, behatechalatam asot hahalicha leraggel nolad bahem techuna raa mikkoach hammeshallechim veyaatzu lehaddiach.
Od yirtze lomar shelach lecha, sheyyihye hashshelichut mitkanna al shem moshe velo al shemo yitbarach, letzad ma sheyyatza mehaddavar.
Od yirtze lomar lahem shello tihye kavvanat halichatam lema shechoshvim yisrael, ella lema shechoshev moshe bashshelichut, vehu maamar shelach lecha – lema shebbedatecha velo lema shebbedatam.

Od ramaz bemaamar lecha al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 5,23) befasuk "atta tire", aval bemilchemet sheloshim veechad melachim encha roe, ad kan. meatta im hayu yisrael nichnasim laaretz bashshana hashshenit litziat mitzrayim, vehaya mitkayyem maamar Adonai sheamar "atta tire", haya muchrach moshe leshev chutz laaretz kehedyot o yikkanes leeretz yisrael hedyot, uveemtzaut shelichut hameraggelim nitakkevu yisrael arbaim shana velo yarad moshe miggedullato vayhi vishurun melech arbaim shana ad melot yamav, vehu amro shelach lecha ki lecha hanaa baze betachlit haddevarim.

Veyaturu et vegomer. kashe amro veyaturu shehaya lo lomar "latur" vegomer. od kashe amro asher ani noten vegomer achar asher hizkir shem hammakom lo haya tzarich lomar "asher ani" vegomer, ki mi lo yada shehu notnah lahem.

Achen lefi ma shepperashnu shehitna bashshelichut tenay harishon "lecha", perush, lema shehu choshev sheyyihyu sheluche moshe, ushear happerushim shepperashnu bah, vehosif od tenay acher "anashim" shetztzarich sheyyihyu tzaddikim, od ba vehosif tenay acher baddavar, shehariggul hu asher ani noten livne yisrael, perush, lo leshaer im haaretz hahi yesh koach bahem lelachdah velareshet anasheha, ki ze vadday ki en yecholet bahem laamod afillu keneged ir ketanna shebbahem, ella asher ani noten, vechevan shehaddavar hahu ba lahem bemattana, al hannoten lehotzi oshkeha kedin hannoten mattana, vehu yillachem lahem veyaamidenna beyadam been satan veen pega ra. gam yaskilu beriggulam asher yafli Adonai lehashepil ramim am gadol varam rabbim vaatzumim, kede shebbaal hannes yakkir benisso. uvaze nitchakkem Adonai bechasdo veherim millifnehem michshol kesheyyiru amalek vegomer vilide anak vegomer veotzem chozek hearim habbetzurot, leval yifchadu veyiru ki en yerushshatam bechoach yisrael ella bechoach habbore asher hakkol yuchal ki hu hannoten.

Veze hu maamar asher ani noten, uvemetek leshono gilla ki kefi hatteva enam yecholin lahem, kemo sheamru hameraggelim achar kach, uvaze nityashshevu haddikdukim. ella shennishar lachkor zot lamma lo hispik lomar "veyaturu et haaretz asher ani noten" velo haya tzarich lehazekir eretz kenaan. veraiti lerazal (yalkut shemauni) shehirgishu beheara zo veamru shebba lirmoz el zechut haggorem hammattana, vehu zechut yitzchak shennolad leavraham vesara, avraham ben mea shana vesara bat tishim shana shehu bemispar hashshanim shel shenehem 190, veze derech derash. venire lomar ki nitkavven lomar hammaamar atzmo sheamar moshe leyisrael bemishne tora (Devarim 9:5) "lo vetzidkatcha vegomer, ki berishat haggoyim" vegomer, vehu ma shehizkir kan kesheamar "ani noten eretz kenaan" lomar letzad shehi eretz kenaan asher nitmalla seato laze ani noten.
Tishlachu. velo hispik bemaamar "shelach" shebbitchillat hakkatuv. ulay shebba leakkev shello yelchu ella beseder ze "ish echad" vegomer, velo yoter velo pachot.

rashi: Az yedabber elemo. kemo alehem, uma hu haddibbur?
targum: Heden yemalel lehon betukefeh uverugezeh yevahalinun:

ohc: Adonai erech appayim. tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar lefanav kol hashshelosh esre middot hanneemarim befarashat ki tissa. veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha berosh hashshana perek 1 daf 17 veze leshonam: "Adonai Adonai" – ani hu kodem sheyyecheta haadam vaani hu leachar sheyyecheta haadam veyaase teshuva, ad kan. uvefarashat tissa (Shemot 34:6) katavti divre harosh zichrono livracha baze uma sheala beyadi beferush hainyan, ha lamadta shemmiddat rachamim harishona hu kodem sheyyecheta, laze kan shehaya tzarich moshe lammidda sheachar hachet laze lo amar ella "Adonai" paam achat.

Uleharan gaon sheheviu devarav hattosafot (rosh hashshana 17:) veharosh, she" rishon eno mecheshbon hammiddot ella modia mi hu hakkore, kefi ze yesh taam nachon lamma lo amar moshe kan ella paam achat Adonai, ella dekashe ech yachlok haran al divre rabbotenu.

Veefshar lefaresh haddevarim lefi divre haran, ki ma sheamru "kodem sheyyecheta veachar sheyyecheta", perush she rachman afillu achar sheyyecheta haadam kemo shehaya rachman kodem sheyyecheta, veen chiddush larachamim ella achar hachet. uchefi ze en kushyat harosh shehiksha "kodem hachet lamma tzarich lerachamim", ki kefi haemet ken hu. gam dilleg shalosh middot: el, rachum, vechannun, letzad sheshshalosh middot ellu tzerichin lahem mi shechaser hatztzala mitztzara o mi shechaser tov o mi shennatun bemachovim, veatta lo hutzrach battefilla lemiddot ellu. vehitchil meerech appayim lehaarich appo gam larshaim, uchedivrehem zichrono livracha sheamru (sanhedrin ki.) kesheala moshe lammarom metzao lehakkadosh baruch hu shehaya kotev "erech appayim" vegomer, yeuyyan sham divrehem. hare ki leerech appayim kara. gam amar "rav chesed" lehattot mishpatam, keamram zichrono livracha (rosh hashshana 17.) "rav chesed" – matte kelappe chesed. velo hizkir "emet" velo "notzer chesed laalafim" ki eno tzarich lemiddot ellu al ma shellefanenu. vehizkir "nose avon vafesha" ki lahem tzarich, velo hizkir "vechattaa" shello hayu az shoggin ella mezidin. vehizkir kol shear hammiddot letzad shehem middot shennogot lema shellefanav.
Velo shamu bekoli. perush, letzad sheshshama am kol elohim chayyim, panim befanim dibber Adonai immahem, laze yakpid al shello kibbelu velo chashu al kolo yitbarach asher shamu.

Vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat vegomer. perush – vehem motzie dibba metu, al derech amro (Tehillim 9:17) "befoal kappav nokesh rasha". od yirtze latet taam lamma metu bammaggefa, lefi shehem hotziu dibba al haaretz midda keneged midda – hem dibberu davar ra vaAdonai hikkam bedever.

Lifne Adonai. perush, uchevod Adonai omed sham kodem aloto, umeshunna reshut shennittena lammashchit kan mershut shennittena keshechara af Adonai beaharon umiryam shello naga tzaraat bahem ad shehalach, ma sheen ken kan shellefanav nittena reshut lingof oyve Adonai:

Elle shemot haanashim. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar ken, vahalo kevar amar "veelle shemotam" vegomer? veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sota lod:) sheamru veze leshonam: amar rabbi yitzchak, davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu, meraggelim al shem maasehem nikreu vechulei, setur ben michael shessatar devarav shel hakkadosh baruch hu vechulei, ad kan. vehinne letzad sheratza lomar hakkatuv "vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua" shehitpallel alav vechulei, yomar haomer, ma raa moshe lehitpallel al yehoshua? laze hikdim lomar veelle shemot haanashim vegomer, lehaircha ki mishshemotam hiskil moshe maasehem haraim, asher laze hutzrach lehitpallel al yehoshua "vayyikra" vegomer, velaze samach lemaamar "elle shemot" vegomer "vayyikra moshe" vegomer. vahagam shekkatavti lemala shehirgish berisham mimmaamar tevat "lecha", en perush ze muchrach veyesh lefaresh tevat "lecha" beofen acher, umishshemotam hitta vehichria ki yarshiu bishlichutam. od ulay shello hitzdik shekkullan reshaim, ella mishshemotam shekkol shemotam gillu ma sheatidin laasot.

Vayyikra moshe vegomer. razal amru (sota lod:) shehitpallel alav, vetzarich ladaat lamma shinna shemo veyachol haya lehitpallel belo shinnuy hashshem. veulay shennatan koach bishmo betosefet hayyod shemmisparah asara kede sheyyuchal neged haeser meraggelim. od, kede sheyyittol zechut vechelek hattov shel kol haasara kemaamaram zichronam livracha (chagiga 15.) zacha notel chelko vechelek chavero:

Vehaamaleki vehakkenaani vegomer. kavvanat hodaa zo kan, gam tosefet vav, letzad shehechlit Adonai shekkol haddor lo yavou laaretz veyamutu bammidbar, vehu amar shello yemitem keish echad, velaze tzerichin lehitakkev bammidbar zeman aroch kemo shekken gilla haddevarim besamuch, veyesh tzad lomar sheyyeshvu sham kol hazzeman hahu, laze amar vehaamaleki vegomer, perush veenam yecholin lehitakkev bammakom ze sheattem alulim lippol lifnehem, al derech amram (tanchuma, vayyiggash 1) hassatan mekatreg bishat hassakkana, laze machar penu vegomer. vahagam shemmatzinu sheyyashvu achar kach sham yamim rabbim dichtiv (Devarim 1:46) "vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim", veamru zichronam livracha (seder olam) tesha esre shana, ze haya bachazara, sheaz kevar nittzamtzem vehuketan heavon asher lo chen kodem. uvaze matzanu taam lamma lo nitakkevu az sham ma shennitakkevu achar kach. vetaam amro vehaamaleki betosefet vav likshor haddevarim im techillat haddibbur shel "im yiru" vegomer, shemmosif od gezerat hammassaot keamro "machar penu", shehavvav nimshechet im maamar "machar penu".
Dabber vegomer veamarta. letzad sheyyesh baze chiyyuv hammitzva, veyesh gam ken maala vechavod hannimshach mimmenna, laze amar dibbur vaamira.

Veasu lahem vegomer. taam amro vav bitchillat hainyan, lefi ma sheamru zichronam livracha shekkatavti befasuk "vayyomer" sheamar moshe laAdonai: bime hachol lovshin tefillin vezochrim vechulei ad kan. laze keshebba lomar lo sheyyaasu tzitzit, yesh makom litot ki mitzva zo tihye bimkom tefillin – ratza lovesh tefillin, ratza lovesh tzitzit belo tefillin, vaafillu bishar yamim, shebbeechad mehem yaspik lizchirat hammitzvot. laze amar veasu – vav mosif, shemmitzvat tefillin bimkomah omedet umosif mitzvat tzitzit.

Ledorotam venatnu vegomer. hutzrach lomar ledorotam, letzad shello baa mitzva zo ella lezichron hammitzvot kesheyyiru oto, tavo hassevara lomar kesheyyavo dor kadosh vetahor sheen tzerichin lezikkaron ze en tzorech betzitzit, talmud lomar ledorotam.

Od yirtze behair lamma katav ledorotam beemtza perate hammitzva. achen letzad sheyyesh bemitzvat tzitzit shene devarim – hallavan vehattechelet, hallavan yeshno bechol zeman, vehattechelet yesh zeman sheeno matzuy, venitchakkem Adonai veamar ledorotam kodem zichron hattechelet lomar shehallavan ledorotam, aval techelet kesheeno benimtza en chiyyuv bo. vahagam shehattechelet eno meakkev et hallavan velo hallavan et hattechelet (menachot lach.), af al pi chen hallavan hu benimtza ledorot belo hefsek ma sheen ken hattechelet.

rashi: Yatza mechelev enemo. enehem boltot merov shuman, kol adam kachush enav meshukkaot:
Avru maskiyyot levav. yoter mimma shellibbam meyachel umetzappe, baa lahem taavatam. avru bahem behassagat yadam et taavat libbam:
targum: Shena min shumena partzufehon avaru chotvehon chafurat libba:

ohc: Vaydabber Adonai vegomer. shiur haddibbur yaggid ki atta matchil ledabber elav Adonai beinyan ze, velo chen hu, shehalo kevar dibber Adonai devarim rabbim baze kaamur besamuch. achen letzad shehaddevarim sheavru meAdonai lemoshe ad atta hayu devarim beno leven moshe lo bishlichut leyisrael, vehammaskil bema shepperashnu yatzdik haddevarim shello haya ella kemelech shemmedabber im avdo bidvarim shertzono laasot, velaze lo amar sham "lemor" kol ikkar, vechan matchil ledabber elav divre shelichut leyisrael, velaze amar vaydabber Adonai vegomer lomar leyisrael haddevarim kichtavan.

Veshamu mitzrayim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma omer veshamu betosefet vav battechilla, haya lo lomar "yishmeu mitzrayim". od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro ki heelita, im retzono lomar yishmeu sheheela ze en lo shachar, ki halo hemma rau maase Adonai veniflaot asher asa betocham. veod ma yesovev harigatam lishmiat mitzrayim sheheela bechocho vegomer. veim hakkavvana hi letzayyen mi hem mitzrayim asher yishmeu, veamar, otan asher heelita bechochacha vegomer, kashe, vechi yesh mitzrayim acherim litot bahem, velu yehi sheyyesh mitzrayim acherim, im kol ze min hassetam eno chozer ella al mitzrayim hayyadua.

Venire shehakkavvana hi bema shennair al moshe alav hashshalom, lamma lo hizkir teanot shettaan lifne Adonai bemaase haegel. vahagam shepperashti befasuk "ad ana yenaatzuni" vegomer she satar taana zo betaanat "nileti neso", gam letzad sheen leniutz ze kitzba, im kol ze haya lemoshe lehazekir zechut avot betzeruf hatteanot shehizkir kan, shebbahem nitztzach haddin kaasher avaer.

Achen moshe alav hashshalom nitchakkem benoam devarav, sheamar "veshamu" betosefet vav, lomar millevad teanot harishonot sheamar keshehitpallel al maase haegel shechozer hu vetoen umosif alehem lehashiv al maamar Adonai, vehu amro veshamu mitzrayim vegomer. venatan taam lidvarav sheamar haddavar behechlet sheyyishmeu, veim tomar mi amar lecha sheyyishmeu vadday veefshar shello yishmeu, laze amar ki heelita bechochacha haggadol vegomer. vedikdek lomar mikkirbo, lomar shehagam shennisse mitzrayim hayu yeduim lakkol, im kol ze yishtanne haddavar leotam shehayu bekirbam, veumma kazo lo timmana mechakor mehannaase miyyisrael veinyanehem. velaze ani machlit sheyyedu asher yease mehem bedikduk. uchefi ze tevat "ki" hi netinat taam lemaamar "veshamu".

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, shebba litten taam lamma lo chash ella lishmiat mitzrayim ulehannisbav mimmenna velo lishar haammim. laze amar ki heelita bechochacha vegomer, perush, hem sheyyadu umma zo sheen bah yecholet velo yachla alot mimmitzrayim ella bechochacha haggadol. kesheyyishmeu shemmetu keechad, hagam she yekayyem havetachato veyachnis laaretz zaro shel moshe, af al pi chen yitlu ki hammishpacha hahi hayta bat koach hayyachol amod mippene yoshev haaretz. veze hu middevarim hargilim ki umma chazaka timshol bilmatta mimmenna, aval haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim sheen lo ella koach Adonai – lo haya koach baAdonai chas veshalom lahaviam. vehu ma sheddikdek lomar heelita bechochacha et haam hazze, mare baetzba haam hayyotze shello haya bo koach zulat koach elyon, lishlol am habba bimkomo sheen mimmennu mofet listor taanat "mibbilti yecholet Adonai". umechush ze eno ella mitztzad mitzrayim, aval shear haummot im lo haya taam shemmitzrayim yadu haam veechuto lo haya chillul hashshem. nimtzeta omer mittoch divre moshe shene devarim muchrachim: haechad sheyyishmeu mitzrayim hannaase miyyisrael, vehashsheni ki mitzrayim yadu sheyyisrael en bahem koach laamod bemilchamot gedolot zulat kocho yitbarach.

Vayyomer Adonai vegomer. hammaamar kan ba limnoa moshe millehitpallel al yisrael, kederech sheamar lo bemaase haegel (Shemot 32:10) "hannicha li", kemo chen bemaase ze hikdim lomar elav inyan haamur besamuch kede sheyyimmana millehitpallel alehem, velaze lo amar "lemor".

Ad ana yenaatzuni vegomer vead ana lo yaaminu vegomer. kashe, im hem menaatzim, ma makom lehitraem al heder haemuna? veulay shekkeneged hammeraggelim amar "yenaatzuni", ucheneged sheheeminu lahem amar "lo yaaminu vi" shehivtachtim latet lahem et haaretz:

Od letzad shehayu beyisrael kat achat menaatzim shehirshiu ufakru, uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (sota la.) befasuk "lirgom otam baavanim uchevod Adonai" vegomer shehayu zorkim avanim gam keneged mala, uchenegdam amar "yenaatzuni", vechat achat mitpachadim mehaammim uchenegdam amar "lo yaaminu", ucheneged shete bechinot amar "akkennu vaddever veorishennu", keneged shello heeminu amar akkennu vaddever, venitkavven ligmor keneged hammenaatzim veorishennu perush meolam habba, ushete gezerot ellu nitkayyemu bammeraggelim, shehikka otam Adonai baddever dichtiv (Bamidbar 14:37) "vayyamutu haanashim vegomer bammaggefa" veen lahem chelek laolam habba kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kach:).

Veamro veeese otcha, perush – yashpia bo uvaanafav kol nitzotze hakkedushsha harauy lavo, ma shello haya bechocho kodem. veamro mimmennu, perush – shehaggoy atzum yihye mehaam hammuzkar battechilla, sheyyatte Adonai kol neshamot hatteluyot baam veyittaem beshoresh nishmato shel moshe.

Od yitbaaru hakketuvim al ze hadderech, vehu letzad shekkevar kadam maase haegel umaamar Adonai sham (Shemot 32:10) uteshuvat moshe shebbah nitztzach et haddin uvittel et haggezera batteanot haamurim sham, baavur ze ba haelohim ledabber neged teanot harishonot, vehitchil lomar ad ana, perush en kitzva leniutz haanashim haelle lomar haaver lahem zot veafes koach hassabbal. uvaze dacha gam ken letaanat moshe sheyyomru mitzrayim beraa hotziam, ki ze yihye niutz haggoyim paam achat veniutz shel yisrael en lo kitzba. gam baze dacha taanat zechut avot, ki en rauy lemelech gadol veram baruch hu lisbol kol kach niutzin mibbenehem.

Vetimtza sheamru razal (shabbat 89:) sheheshivu haavot lehakkadosh baruch hu kesheamar lahem "benechem chatu", amru lo "yimmachu al devar kevod shemecha", sheggam hem lo yachpetzu behacheasot Adonai baruch hu. ucheneged taanat "asher hotzeta meeretz mitzrayim" sheamar moshe bemaase haegel, shennitkavven lomar shello yishve haggoy asher yetze mimmennu lehavi rosho beol haelohut kaam hayyotze mimmitzrayim asher lahem naasu hammassot haggedolot, laze amar ki lo hoil lahem ma sherau bitziat mitzrayim, vehu amro vead ana lo yaaminu vi bechol haotot vegomer, umeatta en hefresh lahem letzad perat ze, im ken "akkennu" vegomer. veim tomar, uma eese lishvuat haavot? – veeese otcha sheatta mibbenehem legoy gadol vegomer. vaadayin yeshnah lekushya: uvamme tihye batuach mehabbaim tachtehem shello yenaatzu gam hem? laze amar veeese vegomer legoy gadol veatzum, perush sheyyihyu hanneshamot gedolot vaatzumot yoter mimmennu, perush mehaam hannimtzaim, sheyyihyu kerovim lakkedushsha beyoter mehaam hahu sheyyuchal amod bemitzvot Adonai. vetimtza ki beemtzaut nefesh kedosha yistayyea asot maase kodesh veyimas asot ra, veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 49:3) "reuven bechori atta" vegomer. vehaam hayyotze mimmitzrayim, letzad shehayu toch kelippat mitzrayim veshimlat shivyam lo nitharu mimmenna behechlet, veze sibba lenaetz, ma shello yihye chen haam hayyotze mimmoshe.

Vehaanashim asher shalach vegomer. kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shekkevar hishmianu ki moshe shalach haanashim vegomer vechol ma sheamar hakkatuv. veulay ki letzad sheratza lomar hakkatuv hammishpat shennaasa bahem techef umiyyad, veyomar haomer vahalo middat erech appayim yeshnah gam larshaim, velamma lo heerich Adonai appo ketzat leellu, laze sidder hafelagat chetam shemmanu arichut appayim.

Da ki letzad Adonai devarim yechere af Adonai veyitnakkem mehera: 1 haadam gadol vechashuv ki yimrod bekono, lo yove Adonai seloach lo, sheeno dome leadam benoni ki yecheta. 2 adam shechevrato naa vachasuda vehu mitavvet veholech bederech lo tov. 3 kesheyyihye laadam hergesh gadol lehairo leval yecheta, uchemaase oto shettafchu lo tzitziyyotav al panav vechulei (menachot 44.) velo yachush laheara. 4 im chata vehecheti et harabbim. Adonai im yihye chet gadol verachok mitteva haragil, kemaase amon sheamru lo yesh lecha hanaa vechulei (sanhedrin 103:).

Vehodia hakkatuv kan taam shello heerich Adonai appo lahem, shebbahem nitkabbetzu chamishsha devarim hammafligim middat erech appayim. vehitchil lomar keneged harishon: vehaanashim, veamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba kan) kol anashim shebbammikra leshon chashivut, ki rashe alfe yisrael hemma. ucheneged chevrat meshallecham amar asher shalach otam moshe bishlichut mitzva lachpor et haaretz, hare ki hem sheluche chevra umechevrat moshe yechashvu. ucheneged shelishi amar vayyashuvu, perush shennaasa lahem nes atzum sheshshavu velo neevdu bahalichatam, vetze ulemad meamram zichronam livracha (451 deve eliyyahu Rabba 109) mehaover alehem mehaanakim velo naga bahem yad adam. veze haya maspik lahairam leval asot resha veyakkiru ki gadol elohenu asher heram nifleotav. ucheneged revii amar vayyallinu kol haeda, perush chatu hem vehechetiu harabbim. ucheneged hachamishi amar lehotzi dibba al haaretz, mi ze amar vattehi sheyyomar al haaretz kelilat yofi ki raa hi? en lecha rasha rachok measot kaze, ki ech min haenoshi yaez panav kol kach ledabber devarim hafekiyyim betachlit hahafkiyyut, lomar dibba raa al hashshelemut hattov. asher al ken chara af Adonai vaharagam miyyad velo heerich appo lahem.

rashi: Yischak, yilag, yedabber. leshon hove hem meshammeshin:
targum: Deyatev bishmaya yigchach memra dayya yidhach lehon:

ohc: Vayyahas vegomer el moshe. perush, lefi sheen koach beadam hedyot lehashetik hamon shesh meot elef, laze ba bemaamaro ki hu mashtikam el moshe velo ligzerato, veyadua ki moshe melech, dichtiv (Devarim 33:5) "vayhi vishurun melech", uleemato shatku lishmoa asher yomar. veamar alo naale veyarashnu otah, perush, gam lefi divre hammeraggelim nuchal lah:

Ufigrechem attem vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ken achar shekkevar amar "bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem". veefshar shennitkavven lomar shello yachnisu benehem atzmotam laaretz kemo sheheelu atzmot yosef veatzmot hashshevatim laaretz, ella yippelu bammidbar.

Od nire sheyyechavven lomar, shemmillevad sheyyippelu pigrehem kemo sheamar lemala, perush sheyyippelu pegarim metim, amar od shehaggufot gam ken tihye lahem nefila bammidbar, sheyyihyu beyad 100 sar hammidbar, sheen lecha nefila gedola mizzo kayyadua leyode madda. velaze dikdek lomar "ufigrechem attem yippelu", sheachar shekkeraam pegarim amar yippelu, veim al hammita hu omer haya lo lehakedim hannefila shehi hassovevet bahem shem happeger, uchemo sheamar lemala "yippelu figrechem", ella vadday al hashepalat unefilat haggufot achar mita hu omer. vedikdek lomar attem, shello yavinu maamar "pigrechem" shebba lomar al bene venehem, sheggam alehem yomar bechinnuy, ki habben chelek meaviv, laze amar "attem".

Vechachme kastilya hammegorashim shamati mishshemam sheppershu shechozer al moshe veaharon sheggazar Adonai alehem gam ken sheyyamutu bammidbar, velaze amar tevat attem lemoshe veaharon sheimmahem hu medabber, venatan Adonai taam lidvarav bema sheggamar omer "im lo zot eese lechol haeda vegomer yittammu vesham yamutu", al derech amram zichronam livracha (bammidbar Rabba 19,13) befasuk "vayyete rashe am" shettaam shennikbar moshe beever hayyarden lehavi dor hammidbar laolam habba, velaze im lo hayu metim moshe veaharon bammidbar lo hayu chayyim dor hammidbar. veze derech remez, ki vadday shello yomar peger al moshe veaharon sheggufan zach kemalachim, gam lo yomar leshon nefila al shene meore olam.

Ani Adonai dibbarti im lo vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma kavvanat maamar ani Adonai dibbarti, halo yodim anu ki Adonai hu hammedabber? od ma kavvanat amro im lo zot vegomer, uma hu amro vesham yamutu? achen yirtze al ze hadderech: "ani Adonai" shehu middat hachesed veharachamim gam hi hiskima al hammishpat katuv, vehu amro dibbarti devarim kashim ellu. veim tomar ech taskim midda zot al hatztzara leyisrael? laze amar "im lo zot eese", veaarich immahem lehetiv, yodea ani tachlitam sheyyovdu meolam hazze umeolam habba al yede niutzehem asher yosifu lachato, vehu amro bammidbar hazze yittammu, perush, kullam yihyu kalim bishlemut, vesham laolam habba yamutu. laze dibber Adonai mishpat ze sheyyamutu bammidbar velo yittammu ki venehem hekim tachtam, vegam laolam habba lo yamutu keman deamar (sanhedrin kach.) yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, umeatta rachum hu bedin ze.

Vehematta vegomer keish echad vegomer. gilla dato alav hashshalom baze sheeno mevakkesh sheyyislach Adonai al hachet, ella shello yavo lide chillul hashshem, veramaz bidvarav ki hahergesh shemmimmennu yumshach haamur bidvarav hu davka im yemitem keish echad, aval meat meat lo yurgash haddavar, vechen matzinu sheasa Adonai.

Veamru haggoyim vegomer. perush, lo mitzrayim levad ella kol haggoyim sheshshamu shimacha, lemor perush, leshon maala verommut rum yecholet Adonai, atta yomru "mibbilti" vegomer, veyithappech kiddush hashshem lechillul chas veshalom befi chol haammim. velaze dikdek lomar veamru betosefet vav, lomar ki millevad mitzrayim vechulei gam kol haggoyim. od taam amro lemor, letzad sheen yadua mivta haddevarim hanneemarim mehaggoyim vesidran, laze amar "veamru" amira shehakkavvana bah lomar "mibbilti" vegomer. od amro lemor perush, hagam shello yatzdiku hem atzman haddevarim bedatan, af al pi chen yomru hammitchayyev mehammaase, veze hu shiur hainyan "veamru" vegomer, vedavar ze en bo ella amira levad velo hatzedakat haddevarim bedatam.

Vayyillonu vegomer kol bene yisrael vegomer kol haeda. taam kefel zichron hammelinim, gam shinnuy hazzikkaron, letzad shekkelalut yisrael hayu bichlal hammelinim, aval devarim shebbau betaana hayu mippi kelalut haeda haruyim ledabber betaana im moshe. veamru seder bechirat hara: chalukka rishona "lu matnu beeretz mitzrayim", veze nimna mehem shekkevar yatzu, uvacharu baraa yoter mimmenna sheyyamutu bammidbar, veze yeshno bammetziut ki yemitem bammidbar. lamma Adonai meviam lemadrega raa yoter lamut bacherev velishbot neshehem vegomer, vegamru omer "halo tov" – perush, im Adonai lo yemitem bammidbar maskimin lashuv mitzrayma, sheefshar shello yemitum mitzrayim vetihye nafsham lahem leshalal. velo pachadu sheyyigzor Adonai alehem vimitem bammidbar velo yaggiu lemitzrayim, ki ze hu mevukkasham keamro "o bammidbar hazze" vegomer:

rashi: Limnot yamenu ken hoda. kaasher battechilla, hoda baolam et minyan yamenu arukkim, vechevan shennaarich yamim, nuchal liknot lev venavi betocham levav chachma. venavi leshon havaa (bava batra 12.). (veyesh omrim limnot yamenu ken, kimnin 70 – shivim shana, venamut lefi shiur yamenu shehen meat, ken teyasser otanu vechen "vayyodea bahem anshe sukkot" 1 2):
targum: Lemimne yomana ken yitkaven lehoda beram neviya delibbeh mabba chuchemata:

ohc: Lammakom hahu kara vegomer. perush, hakkadosh baruch hu kodem lachen katav "ad nachal eshkol" al shem heatid, ki hu maggid mereshit acharit.

Veamro asher kartu mishsham vegomer, perush, veim tomar vahalo kamma eshkolot nichretu mehammakom, laze amar hafelaat eshkol ze shennikra hammakom al shemo "al odot haeshkol vegomer asher kartu bene yisrael", perush, kelalut yisrael kartu eshkol ze, vahagam shello hayu ella shenem asar anashim, letzad heyotam sheluche kol yisrael, keillu kartu kol yisrael, al derech amro (Shemot 12:6) "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael":

Veamro el yoshev vegomer shamu vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma yomru leyoshev haaretz, veim kavvanato lomar sheyyomru mibbeli yecholet Adonai chas veshalom lahem, haya lo lehasemich haddevarim al ze hadderech: "el yoshev vegomer mibbeli yecholet Adonai", vehaya lo lehakedim maamar "shamu" vegomer o leacharo.

Achen kavvanat hammaamar hu al ze hadderech: veamru vegomer, perush kesheyyishmeu mitzrayim yitlu haddavar letaam yoshev haaretz, perush letziddam haya haddavar. velihyot sheyyesh kan shene derachim: haechad hu shello haya haam rauy lechol kach maala beene Adonai lehaavid lefanav yoshev haaretz goyim gedolim vaatzumim, vahagam sheavda mitzrayim bishvilam en lemedin mimmitzrayim leyoshev haaretz shiva goyim gedolim vaatzumim, velo hayu kol kach ahuvim etzlo am bene yisrael az leabbed mippenehem ammim rabbim. vehashsheni hu she haya chafetz baam veohavam ella shello hissiga yado chas veshalom leyoshev haaretz. laze amar shamu ki atta Adonai bekerev vegomer, perush, lo yomru shehassibba shennolda miyyoshev haaretz hu letzad sheggam hem ahuvim vachavivim etzel habbore baruch hu kannizkar, shehare shamu chavivut yisrael etzlecha ki atta Adonai bekerev haam asher ayin beayin vegomer, hare niflea ahavatam laAdonai ufirsem ki shemo haggadol nikra alehem. veillu haya yachol laasot immahem tovot lo haya nimna mimmechush ummot shello bau lichlal chelek meribbo meahavat yisrael galuy lechol haolam. umeatta keshettamit et haam hazze lo yitlu haddavar letzad miut hassagat ahavatcha bahem, veim taase et haddavar hazze "vehematta vegomer veamru" vegomer.

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe. taam shinnuy parasha zo sheamar vayyomer, ma sheen ken bechol hattora shebbechullan hu omer "vaydabber", yitbaer al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni) sheamru: kesheraa moshe maase hamekoshesh amar lifne Adonai: bime hachol lovshin yisrael tefillin vezochrin hammitzvot, beyom hashshabbat bamme yizkeru? veheshiv hakkadosh baruch hu: hareni noten lahem mitzvat tzitzit shebbah yizkeru vechulei, ad kan. laze amar "vayyomer", perush, amira hammesaedet et hallev bimvukkasho.

rashi: Shatta avonotenu lenegdecha, veet alumenu – et chattot neurenu, samta limor panecha:
Alumenu. neurenu, kemo (Shmuel 1 17:56) "ben mi ze haelem":
Limor panecha. lemulecha lehabbit bahem:
targum: Shavita chovana lekivlach avyat talyutana kavel nehor appach:

ohc: Vetappechem asher vegomer. letzad sheamar "kaasher dibbartem beaznay ken eese lachem", vehem dibberu gam al tappam raa, laze ba Adonai vehotziam mehakkelal veamar "vetappechem vegomer veheveti" vegomer, veamar veheveti betosefet vav, lomar millevad shello yihyu lavaz ella od lahem tova sheyyeviem Adonai el haaretz vegomer:

Al taalu vegomer. natan lahem shene teamim lemanam mehaaliyya: echad hu ki en Adonai bekirbam, vechevan shekken hare ze mehammered baAdonai, vetimtza sheamar hakkatuv bemishne tora (Devarim 1:43) "vaadabber alechem velo shematem vattamru et pi Adonai", vetaam sheni "velo tinnagfu lifne oyvechem" – pachad haoyev.

Vayyapilu vegomer. tau behoraat datam, ki letzad shehem mardu baAdonai keamram sheeno yachol latet beyadam haammim haramim, laze chashvu letakken livtoach baAdonai ulehachlit haemuna ki hatztzel yatztzil vealu hahara. velo nitratztza Adonai ki makkatam teriyya uchevar nigzera gezera. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat devarim (Devarim 1:43).

Emor vegomer kaasher dibbartem beaznay vegomer. kan beer devarav sheal bene yisrael hu omer, shehem otam shehiggiu divrehem ushemaam Adonai beaznav, leelle hu shehigbil zeman mibben esrim vegomer. aval hammeraggelim lo baa lahem hodaat haggezera, ki leene chol yisrael sham sham yinnagfu mita meshunna kemo shekken haya.

Veatta yigdal na vegomer. yesh lehair: 1 amro veatta. 2 amro yigdal mashma sheyyaase eze davar shebbo yigdal od, velo matzinu sheasa davar beinyan ze lehitgaddel. 3 amro na, im hakkavvana hi atta halo amar atta yigdal, veim leshon bakkasha lamma lo hikdimah. 4 amro kaasher dibbarta, ma dibber Adonai vehechan dibber. Adonai tevat lemor, lemi yomru haddevarim.

Achen letzad shennitchakkem moshe betaana hannishmaat ki yesh chillul hashshem gadol bahamitam, hosif ledabber ki atta yesh yitron ligdullato yitbarach im yashuv mecharon appo veyikkansu yisrael laaretz, ma shello haya mikkodem inyan ze, vehu sheachar shessipperu hameraggelim hafelaat tokef haaretz ugevurat haggibborim, veaf al pi chen horisham lifne yisrael, baze yigdal koach Adonai.

Veamro kaasher dibbarta – hu maamar "shelach lecha vegomer asher ani noten livne yisrael" (Bamidbar 13:2), uferashnuhu bimkomo shennitkavven bemaamar ze ki hu meshullal mibbechinat hahassaga kefi bechinat hayyecholet, ella betorat mattana asher hu habbore noten livne yisrael, kemo shekkatavnu sham. uferat ze amar Adonai elav lemor leyisrael, vehu maamar "dibbarta lemor".

Veamro na – perush "atta", vechafal lomar shete peamim "atta", yitbaer al pi divrehem (Bereshit Rabba 101) sheamru en "veatta" ella teshuva, ulefi sheamar moshe lifne Adonai haddevarim sheen keday leamer al haadon, hagam shehaya omer divre haggoyim velo divre atzmo chas veshalom, af al pi chen eno min hammusar. vetimtza kayyotze baddavar shehashshomea birkat Adonai mippi edim, hagam sheenam ella meidim ma sheamar harasha hammevarech, af al pi chen korea hashshomea (sanhedrin 60.), uchemo chen kesheamar moshe maamar haggoyim neged kevodo yitbarach, hitvadda veasa teshuva al shehotzi mippiv divre zilzul keneged habbore baruch hu, vehu maamar "veatta".

Gam ramaz hakkatuv bemaamar veatta sheyyikkach teshuvatam shel yisrael, veamro yigdal na al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot lod:) bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdim en tzaddikim gemurim yecholim laamod. vehattaam sheyyoter mitkaddesh shemo yitbarach keshemmetivim harshaim et darchehem, vehu amro yigdal na perush, yihye yoter gedullat Adonai atta kesheyyachzeru bitshuva achar hammered. gam ramaz betevat "na" al derech amram (avot 4,17) yafa shaa achat bitshuva vechulei:

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: veatta yigdal – perush, ma sheani mevakkesh meAdonai lo lehachelit hammechila lechol hammenaatzim, ella "veatta yigdal na koach Adonai" – perush lehitnakkem mehammenaatzim harshaim shehem hammeraggelim, ki keshe ose mishpat barshaim shemo mitgaddel umitromem. veamro kaasher dibbarta hu ma sheamar (Bamidbar 14:12) "akkennu vaddever", uferashnuhu bimkomo beechad mehadderachim shechozer lamraggelim. vedikdek lomar "na" – perush atta bishat maase haavera velo yitle lahem zeman, uchemo shekken haya, dichtiv (Bamidbar 14:37): "vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa lifne Adonai", veayyen ma shepperashti sham. veamro lemor ulay shebbikkesh moshe meAdonai sheyyomar haddevarim lahem kodem sheyyamutu kede sheyyiru veyechattu. o yirtze lemor leyisrael: reu ellu sheddibberu sheker ma alta beyadam – lehachariram leval yashuvu lehacheis, vechen amar david (Tehillim 9:17) "befoal kappav nokesh rasha higgayon sela". veramaz berashe tevot veatta yigdal na koach shem elohim, veshem "adonay" sherasham hakkatuv gam ken yaggid mishpat, veachar kach chazar leorer harachamim al kelalut haam dichtiv "selach na laavon haam hazze".

Od nitkavven moshe bemaamar veatta vegomer al ma sheamar elav Adonai "veeese otcha legoy gadol veatzum", shehagam sheyyinnachem Adonai meharaa asher amar, lo mippene ze yashuv Adonai middevaro hattov. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (makkot 11.) killat chacham afillu al tenay vechulei, umikkol shekken beracha, umikkol shekken divre elohim chayyim. vehu amro veatta, perush vegam atta yigdal na koach Adonai sheddibber lemor "veeese otcha legoy gadol", lekayyem goy gadol sheyyeshno atta, veyagdil asot lehosif goy gadol mimmoshe. vetimtza shekken haya, dichtiv "uvene rechavya ravu lemala" (divrei hayamim 1 23,17), veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) lemala mishshishshim ribbo. vedikdek lomar "dibbarta lemor", letzad shebbeet asher dibber kashot keneged yisrael heemir et moshe bemidda tova, laze amar "dibbarta" – dibbur kashe leyisrael, "lemor" – amira rakka lemoshe.
Od yirtze kaasher dibbarta sheyyihye legoy gadol, veamro lemor perush keneged ma sheamar "veatzum mimmennu", shettihye bechinatam chazaka yoter mehem:

Veyesh lanu lachkor zot, lamma lo shaal moshe davar ze kesheamar lo chen kesheasu haegel, ki gam sham neemar lo (Shemot 32:10) "veeese otcha legoy gadol"? veefshar ki kan ba betaana lefi sheyyatza haddavar mippi elyon shene peamim, vehu ma sheddikdek bemaamaro kaasher dibbarta lemor, perush, dibbarta bemaase haegel veamarta atta bemaase hammeraggelim.

Od nire shebbemaamar rishon lo amar Adonai ella "veeese otcha legoy gadol" velo amar "veatzum mimmennu", ulefi echad mehadderachim shepperashti bemaamar "veatzum mimmennu" hakkavvana hi shehaggoy gadol sheyyihye mimmoshe hu mehaam atzmo kemo shekkatavti, velaze achar shehitpallel shettaamod haatara bimkomah baam hayyotze mimmitzrayim chash al tovato sheamar elav Adonai "veeese otcha" vegomer shettitbattel, ki Adonai lo amar laasoto goy gadol ella mehaam, laze amar "yigdal na koach Adonai" vegomer. ma sheen ken bemaase haegel lo amar Adonai ella "veeese otcha legoy gadol", min hassetam hagam shechazar bo Adonai venicham al haraa asher dibber al ammo lo mippene ze yitbattel hattov afillu haya al tenay, veyitta Adonai baruch hu nite neshamot chadashot lifrot velirbot. veulay ki zo hayta kavvanat divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (berachot lev.) sheamar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: kisse shel shalosh raglayim lo yachol laamod shel regel achat vechulei, yisrael sheyyesh lahem shelosha ammudim" vechulei ad kan. vekashe, vechi moshe lo mehem hu, sheyyomar al banav shehem shel regel echad? velidvarenu yutzdeku haddevarim, letzad shehaggoy haomed mimmoshe hem nite neshamot shello bau meavraham yitzchak veyaakov, uchefi ze en lahem ella regel echad.

Od nire taam shehitpallel kan, letzad shehuvtach baggoy hayyotze mimmennu sheyyihye atzum bemadregat hakkedushsha vetahara shello yenaetz Adonai, laze hu shehitpallel "yigdal koach Adonai" al perat ze. vedikdek lomar "yigdal na", perush, shemmatzinu (berachot log:) shebbechirat maase hattov enah beyad hakkadosh baruch hu, veatta yigdal na koach Adonai afillu bivchinat davar ze lehametzi nefesh nota lemaase hattov.

Uma haaretz hashshemena vegomer. perush, im notenet shuman beferoteha. im raza – perush, im keshennotenet kochah bapperot im naaset raza mitztzad ze, kederech haaratzot shezzorim otah shana umovirim otam shana kede shello tihye kechusha, o zorim otah shana achar shana veenah mishtannet bechochah veosa sheni karishon, shezze yaggid sheenah nichcheshet mitztzad gidduleha.
Hayesh bah etz. perush shem hammin, im yesh bah kol min etz, im ayin – perush im yesh etz sheeno nimtza bah, vehu maamar hakkatuv (Devarim 8:9) "lo techsar kol bah".

rashi: Yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana. shenotenu elle baavonotenu elle uvaalumenu elle shivim shana hem:
Veim bigvurot. veim harebe gavru yamav, shemonim shana hem:
Verahbam amal vaaven. vechol haggedulla vehasserara sheyyesh lo laadam bayyamim haelle enam ella amal vaaven, velamma? shehare ki gaz chish vannaufa. betoch evra maher anu afim umetim:
Gaz. leshon haavara, kemo "nagozzu veavar" (Nachum 1:12), "vayyagaz salvim min hayyam" (Bamidbar 11:31):
targum: Yome shenotana bealma haden shuvein shenin mitalmin vein bigvureta tamnan shenin vesugeehon leut ushekar lechayavaya arum adu besarhovya vetaysin letzafra:

ohc: Uma haaretz asher vegomer. perush, keneged perat hannaase beemtzaut hazzulat shehem binyene hair vehaddirot vehakkelim, im tova hi bevinyan mefoar im raa bevinyaneha, velaze dikdek lomar asher hiv yoshev bah, ucheneged perat ze timtza sheamar hakkatuv befarashat vaetchannan (Devarim 6:10-11) "vehaya ki yeviacha vegomer latet lach arim gedolot vetovot asher lo vanita". umikkelal noy hair hizkir gam ken "habbemachanim im bemivtzarim", verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (Bamidbar Rabba 96) shessiman masar lahem, veze derech derash, aval peshat hakkatuv kol ikkar hashsheela eno ella al haaretz, aval haam pashut hiv shehu am gadol veram bene anak nefilim veen safek baze leraggel otam. velichshennomar sheramaz lahem gam al gevurat haanashim tihye hakkavvana lomar lahem lirot otzem gevuratam lehakkir benisse el asher yemaggen otam beyadam.

Ureitem vegomer ma hi. perush, lefi sheyyesh eretz shehevlah vaavirah zach uvari umemuzzag hattiviyyut, veyesh sheavirah achur umeuppash umitnagged lemezeg hattiviyyut, gam yesh eretz shehi melea mayanot umemeha nekiyyim umolidim mezeg tov baadam vichonen hakkochot, veyesh lehefech, veellu hem devarim sheyyeshnam baaretz mitztzad atzmah belo sibba emtzai. ucheneged devarim ellu amar "ureitem et haaretz ma hi" mitztzad beriyyatah, im hi begeder haratzon o lehefko. uletzad ki chakira zo yesh bah bechinot sheyyeshnam behavechana lahem bederech avaratam bah, veyesh devarim shetztzerichin nissayon, kemo shettomar im machzeket teva haenoshi, im memeha mafrim umarbim, devarim ellu enam nikkarim bederech haavara. velaze tzivva lahem veet haam vegomer, perush, mehappeullot yivvadu hakkochot, mehaam hayyoshev bah yitgalle koach haaretz im haam chazak o rafe. uletzad sheyyesh makom lomar sheen mivchan mechozek haam ki yesh bamme litlot, vehu ki hem godrin atzman mehattashmish, laze amar hameat hiv im rav, gam baze yiggale ki memeha mafrim umarbim.

Od yirtze behair lamma shinna seder shellakach hakkatuv bechol hahadragot shehikdim bahem chelek hattov veachar kach hizkir chelek hara, "hechazak hiv" veachar kach "harafe", "hattova hi" "im raa" hikdim hattova, vegam mivchan "hechazak hiv" chelek hattov ladaat tovat haaretz shemmegaddelet chazakim, vechen bammaamar haacharon hikdim lomar "hashshemena hi" veachar kach "im raza", uchemo chen "hayesh bah etz" veachar kach amar "im ayin", velamma keshehizkir hammiut veharibbuy hikdim lomar "hameat hiv im rav". vehaya nire lomar ki gam bemivchan ze hikdim chelek hattov, vehu sheim hem muatim hiv yoter tov leyisrael, veze eno, ki lo yistappek betova sheyyodea hechlet shelilatah?

Achen hakkavvana hi al ze hadderech: hameat hiv vegomer, perush, chozer lemaamar "hechazak hiv" vegomer, im chozek haam hiv davar gadol shemmeattim hem kayyotze vahem im rabbim kayyotze vahem baolam, uchefi ze hikdim chelek hameulle leshevach haaretz sheen kemotah megaddelim chazakim bechol haaratzot, o letzad hakkarat hannes gam ken kemo shekkatavti. ulederech ze lo takshe lamma hifsik bainyan bemaamar "veet haam" vegomer beemtza inyene haaretz, shehare achar kach hiv omer "uma haaretz" vegomer, velidvarenu beinyan haaretz hakkatuv medabber.

rashi: Yamiku. et reehem:
Vidabberu vera oshek. laashok evyonim:

Mimmarom yedabberu. kegon paro vesancheriv unevuchadnetztzar: "mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo" (Shemot 5:2), "mi bechol elohe haaratzot" (Melachim 2 18:35), "eele al bomote av" (Yeshayahu 14:14). vezehu shatu vashshamayim pihem:
targum: Yitmakmekun min pitma vimallun leavasha velitluma min rum libbehon yemallun:

ohc: Vihoshua ben nun vegomer chayu vegomer. lo haya tzarich lomar, achar shepperat hakkatuv veamar "haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa", ha lamadta shello metu ella otam shehotziu dibba raa. od, lamma hutzrach lomar "min haanashim"?

Veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru bemassechet bava batra (4 121:): tanya yair ben menashshe nolad bime yaakov, vehikshu mimma shemmatzinu shennichnas laaretz, dichtiv "vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish" (Yehoshua 7:5) vegomer, ze yair ben menashshe sheshshakul kerubbah shel sanhedrin, veteretz rav acha shello nigzera gezera lo al pachut miesrim velo al yater mishshishshim, ad kan. vehinne mimma shello teretz haggemara sheyyair haya tzaddik gamur hareta ladaat ki tzidkat hatztzaddik lo hitztzilatto mehaggezera hahi, vehu maamar hakkatuv vihoshua vegomer chayu vegomer, perush taam shechayu hu lihyotam min haanashim haholchim latur hi sheamda lahem, aval im lo hayu mehattarim vehayu nisharim bichlal yisrael hayta baa haggezera gam alehem hagam shehem tzaddikim gemurim letzad shehayu lemala meesrim kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim ulematta mishshishshim.

Od ramaz al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 15.) zacha notel chelko vechelek chavero began eden, kemo chen yehoshua vechalev hosifu chelkam bachayyim min haanashim haholchim latur, ki lahem mishpat littol chelek hameraggelim, gam amru zichronam livracha (bava batra 117:) shehem natlu chelkam baaretz:

rashi: Nenatteka et mosrotemo. dishronferoymsh loykorangelsh belaaz, ellu retzuot shekkoshrin haol bahem:
Avotemo. loyikordosh belaaz:
targum: Nitra yat esaratehon venitlok minana shalshelavatehon:

ohc: Vehikriv vegomer. taam shehigbil Adonai bannesachim uvashshemen hammincha reviit shemen leissaron shehem shelosha login, uchemo chen reviit yayin lenesech, uvishne esronim yetzav Adonai shelishit hahin shemen ushelishit hahin yayin shehem arbaa login, uvishlosha esronim chatzi hahin shemen vachatzi hahin yayin shehu shishsha login, sheole kefi hacheshbon shene login leissaron ben beminchat shene esronim ben beminchat shelosha esronim, velamma beminchat issaron hitzrich Adonai shelosha login? al derech ma shekkatuv bammishna bimnachot (107.) uchetavo rambam beferek 17 mehilchot maase hakkarbanot veze leshono: mitnaddev o noder adam yayin bifne atzmo veen mitnaddevin log yayin velo shene login, sheen bannesachim lo log velo shenayim, ad kan. vehu taam hakkatuv shello natan leissaron shene login hagam shehispik bishne esronim shelishit hahin shehem arbaa login, lehaircha sheen karban mehayyayin mishshene login.

Veim tomar, yutzdeku haddevarim legabbe hayyayin, aval hashshemen sheggam hu matzinu shebba levaddo bindava, sheamar rabbi tarfon (zevachim tze.) mitnaddev adam shemen, venechleku rabbotenu bimnachot (sham) mehem amru shello yifchot mishshelosha login umehem amru mitnaddev afillu log mittaam dun minah veoke beatrah, im ken bishlama leman deamar lo yifchot mishshelosha login hu hattaam shehitzrich Adonai shelosha login beissaron, ella leman deamar afillu log lamma lo asa kefi hacheshbon? yesh lomar shehishva Adonai middot shemen umiddot yayin bekarbenehem kedin shenayim ushelosha esronim.

rashi: Tishtochachi. leshon "ki shacha leafar nafshenu" (tehillim 44:26). veshach, keshehu medabber al mitpael hattav choleket et otiyyot sharshe hatteva, kederech kol teva sheyyesodah shin bitchillatah:
Hochili. hametini vetzappi laggeulla:
targum: Ma titmakkechin nafshi vetirgeshi alay orichi lelaha arum tuv ashabbechineh befurekana demin kodamoy:

rashi: Ezkarcha meeretz yarden. mimma sheasita lanu bayyarden vahare chermon, achar kol hakkaas shehichasnucha beshittim (Bamidbar 25:1-2), hovashta lanu et hayyarden (Yehoshua 3:16):

Mehar mitzar. mehar sinay shehu tzair lishar heharim. achar shehichasnucha bo bemaase haegel, salachta laavonenu vehalachta immanu (Shemot 32-33). kol elle ani zocher shemmanata millehetiv li, ugezerotecha mitchaddeshot alay zo achar zo:
targum: Elahi alay nafshi titmakkach begin ken yidkerunach yatve lehalea baara yardena veyatve ture chermoni veama dekabbilu orayyta betura desinay demakkich uzeir:

rashi: Tehom el tehom kore. tzara kora lachavertah:

Lekol tzinnorecha. tishkenalsh belaaz, hammekallechim alay puranut kemayim shotfim, ad ki kol mishbarecha vegallecha alay avaru. mishbarecha leshon galle yam, al shehaya gallav olim lemala umishtabberim venoflim:
targum: Tehoma ilaa lithoma araa kare lekal zilche marzevayich hechna kulehon mitberayich vegallayich alay avaru:

ohc: Vihoshua vegomer min hattarim et haaretz. hutzrach lomar shehayu min hattarim, latet taam likriat bigdehem, ki haomer: "mi attem yehoshua vechalev laasot maase ze ma shello asu kol gedole yisrael?" veamar hattaam ki lo haya letzad shehechshivu atzman yoter mikkol gedole yisrael, ella letzad heyotam min hattarim shettaru otah verau maalatah veasu hahargasha. gam nitkavven baze lomar ki nitkavvenu bikriatam zo kede lehareisham, lomar: ellu taru otah vekaru bigdehem al meisatah beene yisrael, veyachchishu divre hammemaanim.

Ad matay laeda vegomer. hem hammeraggelim, vechen amru bammishna desanhedrin (108.), veamro et telunnot bene yisrael hem shear haeda, veamro ad matay, nitkavven lomar sheadayin hayu mafchidim yisrael lasur meachare Adonai, velaze keraam eda raa lomar sheodenna berishah omedet. veamro asher hemma mallinim alay perush millevad raat atzman od mallinim yisrael alay.

Et telunot bene yisrael vegomer shamati. hutzrach lehodia sheshshama, lomar ki lo shama ella telunot bene yisrael velo divre resha hammeraggelim, veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: et telunot bene yisrael asher hammeraggelim mallinim alay shamati, perush telunot bene yisrael lo halanat hameraggelim, ki divre hameraggelim atzman nimasu umenaam mibbo leaznav.

rashi: Vayyadrichem. vaynahagem, lefichach yodu laAdonai chasdo:
targum: Vedabberinun beorach teritzta lemezal lirushelem karta dimyatva:

rashi: Lachen yashuv ammo halom. lefi sheammo roim "derech reshaim tzalecha" (yirmeya 12:1), yashuvu al derech harshaim lalechet bedarchehem:
Halom. kemo "mi haviacha halom" (Shoftim 18:3) – po:
Ume male yimmatzu lamo. umayim shel peleg hammale, hem divre tora, nechshavim lamo tamtzit umezulzalim beenehem:
targum: Bechen tavu al amaya dayya lealkayutehon veyimchonun bemarzofin vedimin sagiin machatin lehon:

ohc: Efes ki az vegomer. perush, lefi shebbishlichut moshe shaal "hechazak hu vegomer habbemachanim" vegomer, laze amru ki haam chazak uvemivtzarim yoshev, vegamru omer vegam yelide haanak vegomer, perush shello lachshov ki bitztzeru arehem letzad chulshatam, hare gam yelide haanak rainu sham, veellu en lahem pachad vadday, im ken en lilmod mimmivtzerehem shechallashim hem.

Od yirtze beamro haam hayyoshev baaretz, ki haam hayu yoshvim nefutzim chutz learim vehayu somchin al gevuratam, vechen timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 16,13) befasuk "amalek yoshev vegomer vehakkenaani" vegomer shehayu yoshvim badderech chutz lair. gam ramzu bemaamar hayyoshev baaretz shehaaretz tzericha gibbore choach laamod bah.

Vaydabber vegomer lemor. tzarich ladaat lamma amar lemor kevan shehaddibbur eno ella el moshe. veulay shebba lehareshoto lomar shehaddevarim neemru lo mippi hashshechina, shezzulat ze hare hu beval tomar (yoma 4.). gam shello yachsheduhu yisrael ki moshe chafetz baddavar veyomru ki dato kedatam, laze yetzavve sheyyomar lahem ki ken tzivva lo hammelech. gam kede sheyyishmeu lo lishloach keseder hannidbar elav meAdonai, velo yeakkevu al yado kesheyyedu ki devar melech hu. gam lefi divre razal sheppershu tevat "lecha" – ledatecha, sheen Adonai metzavve al haddavar, chafetz Adonai sheyyomar leyisrael haddevarim kemot shehem mippi elyon, ulay yargishu ki lo tov asot veyivtechu baAdonai veyaaminu bo.

Vayyomer Adonai salachti kidvarecha. perush, lo salachti al heavon behechlet, ella kidvarecha shello ehergem keachat, mehatteamim sherasham bemaamaro shello yomru mibbilti yecholet vegomer, aval al kol panim yaase bahem mishpat baarichut appayim, vehu maamar hassamuch kol haanashim vegomer im yiru et haaretz vegomer, veamro chay ani perush nishba bechayye hammelech kivyachol, gam nishba veamar "veyimmale chevod" vegomer, perush, ken yimmale chevod Adonai et haaretz ad shennaase ze, vehu gam ken shevua al haddavar.

Od nire lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech: salachti kidvarecha – perush, letzad devarecha shechillita panay, uletzad shenneemar bedivre moshe mechush maamar haggoyim "mibbilti yecholet Adonai" vegomer, uferashnu bimkomo shene derachim: haechad – ki en elohim chas veshalom od, vehashsheni – sheen bo koach neged yoshve haaretz, laze amar veulam chay ani – perush, keneged ma sheyyomru sheen bannimtza hammatztzil chas veshalom veamar "chay ani", ucheneged ma sheyyomru sheen bo koach chas veshalom laamod bifne yoshve haaretz amar veyimmale chevod Adonai et kol haaretz – perush, bammaase asher yafli levassof beechad usheloshim melachim, hagam sheyyaase ze lezaro shel moshe. vehakkavvana baddevarim ellu lomar shello asa ella lichvod moshe shebbikkesh mimmennu selicha velo lemechush maamar haggoyim.

rashi: Yityatztzevu malche eretz veroznim nosdu yachad vegomer. veroznim. shinyorsh belaaz:
Nosdu. leshon sod, 1003 belaaz. uma hi haetza?
targum: Kaymin malche ara veshiltonaya yitchabberun kachada lemarada kodam Adonai ulemintze al meshicheh:

rashi: Yoshve choshech vetzalmavet. af haasurim bevet hassohar tzerichim lehodot, kesheyyotzin mibbet asurehem:
targum: Al tzidkiyahu veravrevane yisrael itnabbe vaamar tzidkiyahu veravrevane yisrael diglu bevavel vitivu vachashocha vetula demota vahavo asirin besiguf shere parzela:

ohc: Im yiru vegomer vechol menaatzay vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lefaresh hammenaatzim, minnayin yaale al haddaat shello yihyu bichlal haggezera shehutzrach lefartam? veefshar ki lefi she amar "vaynassu oti ze eser peamim", shezze yaggid ki kol shello nissa eser peamim, vehem otam sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim pachot meesrim, enam bichlal haggezera. laze hotzi hammenaatzim mehakkelal, shehagam sheyyihye bahem shello nissu eser peamim, nechtemu bigzera zo. umenaatzav hem hammeraggelim o otam shehayu zorkin avanim baanan Adonai kedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota la.).

Gam nitkavven hakkatuv lirshom perat chadash bammeraggelim, shello yihyu reuyim laaretz, perush shello yittelu chelek bah. uchemo sheamru bemassechet bava batra (117.) shebbenehem shel meraggelim lo natlu chelek hammeraggelim baaretz, ella chelek avi avihem, ad kan. ma sheen ken kol haddor hahu shennatlu chelkam benehem, uferush "yiruha" perush shello yihyu reuyim lah. velaze gamar omer veavdi chalev vegomer vezaro yorishenna, vidiat hahafachim muskelet mehanneemar.
Vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama vegomer. perush, shehaoved avoda zara bemezid maale alav hakkatuv keillu giddef et Adonai chas vechalila, velaze ansho "venichreta hannefesh hahi mikkerev ammah".

Veamar od ki devar Adonai baza vegomer, perush, uletaam sheshshekula keneged kol hattora, hare ze bittel kol mitzvot ase, vehu amro "devar Adonai baza", veavar gam ken al kol mitzvot lo taase, vehu amro veet mitzvato hefar. velaze "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi" – hikkaret keneged gide hanneshama, tikkaret keneged evareha, lefi shehanneshamot yesh lahem 248 evarim veshs gidim, shekkenegdam natan Adonai 248 mitzvot ase veshs mitzvot lo taase, uchesheavar al kullan lo nishar lah anaf shemmimmennu tichye veen lah tekuma od, venikba bah heavon leolam vaed, vehu maamar "avona vah". verazal darshu (sifre, sanhedrin 90:) hakkatuv beinyan acher, veshivim panim lattora.

rashi: Elle ezkera ki eevor bassach. pashvivyya belaaz, et zot ani zocheret venafshi mishtappechet bezachri aliyyat hargalim, shehayiti overet bigdude bene adam umedadda immahem ad bet elohim. sach leshon cheshbon, sach bene adam, davar acher: sach leshon sechach vesukka, kelomar beeglat tzav shehayu mechuppot kemin sukka usheman bilshon aggada sekappestaot veiskofiti:

Eddaddem. eddadde immahem, kemo medaddim agalim useyachim, vehaishsha medadda et benah (shabbat 128:). veteva zo meshammeshet kishte tevot, eddadde immahem, atevaveyyamevatz 383 belaaz. umenachem chibbero leshon yedidut kemo "natatti et yedidut nafshi bechaf oyveha" (yirmeya 12:7). vedonash patar eddaddem leshon demama, vechen "dom laAdonai vehitcholel lo" (tehillim 37:7). ufitron eddaddem ealem veacharish ad avo bet elohim berinna, kemo "eshmera lefi machsom beod rasha lenegdi" (tehillim 39:2), uchemo "vaani checheresh lo eshma ucheillem lo yiftach piv" (tehillim 38:14). vedam hu shoresh batteva:
Eddaddem. edde immahem, kemo "velo yachlu dabbero leshalom" (Bereshit 37:4) – dabber immo beshalom:

Hamon chogeg. shehayu holchim lachog, veal kacha yissed happayyat (beshacharit parashat shekalim beyotzer shel elle azkara ayyen sham) "otzem hamon chogeg veshotef kannahar", umidrash aggada leshon yevani, shekkorin livrechat mayim choggin:
targum: Ilen nisaya ana dechir veeshod al raayone nafshi kad aavar telala bilchodi etchayel vemashreyan detzadike ad bet mukedsha dayya bekal bauta vetushebachta itregushet ammin deatyan lemechag lirushelem:

ohc: Vayyelchu vayyavou vegomer. kashe lamma hutzrach lomar vayyelchu achar shekkevar hishmianu hahalicha, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota la.) shennichteva lehakkishah levia – ma bia beetza raa vechulei, vetzarich ladaat leeze inyan yashmienu hakkatuv davar ze shehalchu beetza raa?

Achen yitbaer hainyan al pi ma sheamru bemassechet kiddushin daf 39 veze leshonam: tanya rabbi yaakov omer en lecha mitzva vechulei, hare sheamar lo aviv ale labbira vehave li gozalot, veala velakach haggozalot veshillach et haem, uvachazarato nafal vamet, hechan arichut yamav shel ze? ella leolam shekkullo tov vechulei. veheela bashshas sherabbi yaakov maase chaza, umakshe: vedilma mehareher baavoda zara hava, umeshanne: ihu namme hache kaamar, i salka datach sechar mitzva behay alma ikka, ammay la agin mitzva aleh dela ate lide hirhur, ad kan. mashma dilman deamar sechar mitzva behay alma ikka, tagen mitzva mehayyissurin umehachet. vekashe, divmassechet sota daf 21 omer bemaskanat haddevarim lerava: mitzva aggone maggena aval atztzole la matztzela, vaafillu bazzeman atzmo shehu asuk bah. uchefi ze, bamme mochiach rabbi yaakov mimma shello hegena alav hammitzva shello lavo lide hirhur avoda zara? vahagam shellisvarat rav yosef shemmevi hashshas besota, mitzva bizman shehu asuk bah tagen alav gam mehaaverot, halo nidchet sevarat rav yosef mikkoach kushyat doeg vaachitofel shello hegena alehem toratam shello yetzu letarbut raa, vechevan shennidchu divre rav yosef, bamme matzdik hashshas dechiyyat rabbi yaakov bekiddushin?

Veyesh sheratzu lechallek ben maase mitzva lemaase mitzva, ma sheamru besota demitzva la matztzela mehachet afillu beiddana daasik bah medabber beose shello lishmah, vesham sheamru ammay la aggenat alehem shello lavo lide chet medabber bemitzva lishmah, ad kan divrehem. veze hevel sheim ken haya lo lattalmud lidchot maase hassullam beshello asa hammitzva lishmah, shehi dechiyya yoter kerova middechiyyat dilma mehareher baavoda zara. gam haya marviach bidchiyya zo sheen lehakeshot lamma lo hegena alav miyyetzer hara kevan sheen koach beotah mitzva lehagen miyyetzer hara.

Vehannachon letaretz hu, demaskanat hattalmud hi kisvarat rav yosef, demitzva beiddana deasik bah maggena umatztzela, velaze hu shemmochiach Rabbi yaakov mimma shello hegena vehitztzila hammitzva al haole bassullam lehavi gozalot leaviv, shehare gam bachazara haya sheat maase mitzva shehevi gozalot leaviv. uma sheddacha hashshas besota sevarat rav yosef mimma shello hegena tora ledoeg vaachitofel enah dechiyya, lefi ma sheamru bachagiga (chagiga 15:): bematnita tana: doeg vaachitofel tina hayta belibbam, perush shettoratam hayta shello lishmah, umeatta en hochacha mimma shello hitztzilatam toratam, shehare lo hayta tora lishmah, o lema sheppershu sham hattosafot shehayu baale averot kodem sheasku battora vekadma toratam leyirat chetam, shebbichgon ze en tora matztzilatam miyyetzer hara.

Veod, afillu lisvarat haddoche sevarat rav yosef bemassechet sota middoeg vaachitofel, lo dacha ella chalukkat toelet hattora deenah matztzelet (afillu) bizman sheeno osek bah, aval ma sheamar mitzva beiddana deasik bah maggena umatztzela lo dacha hashshas. vahagam derava mikkoach kushyat doeg vaachitofel huchrach leyashshev habbarayta sheamra tala hakkatuv hammitzva bener vehattora beor vechulei, yomar sheen toelet bammitzva ella lehagen mehatztzarot, en hechreach lidvarav. vicholin lomar al ze hadderech: mitzva beiddana deasik bah maggena umatztzela, uveiddana dela asik bah velo kelum. tora beiddana deasik bah maggena umatztzela, uveiddana dela asik bah maggena velo matztzela. uma sheamru im yesh lah zechut tola – zechut tora shemmatztzelet mehappuranut afillu shello bizman sheoseket bah, vahagam sheen ishsha metzuvva al hattora, bischar torat balehen uvenehem uchedivre ravina sham (sota ka.). ulederech ze mochiach Rabbi yaakov mehaole bassullam lehavi gozalot leaviv shello hitztzilattu mitzvato beet shehaya asuk bah.

Veod keshennaamik baddavar naamid sugeyat kiddushin afillu allibba derava, behair ma sheamar hashshas dilma mehareher baavoda zara, kashe lo – yihye shemmeharher baavoda zara, hayta hammitzva matztzilato mehayyissurin kemo shemmuchach missota sheamru im yesh lah zechut tola, vesham besota zo vadday kilkela vekaamar shehazzechut yimna yissureha vaafillu allibba derava, vesham zechutah meruchak uma shellefanenu shehalach lehavi gozalot zechuto lefanav. uletaretz ze muchrach lomar letzad shehaya mehareher baavoda zara hare hu kechofer bechol hattora vahare hu kegoy lechol devarav veen lo mitzva shettagen alav, o efshar ki letzad shebbishat maase hammitzva hirher baavera en toelet bammitzva sheose lehagen kol ikkar. umetaretz desover Rabbi yaakov i amrinan dischar mitzva behay alma hayta meginna alav mibbo leyado davar hassovev pureanut, sheim lo tomar ken im ken gam mehappureanut enah meginna. vegam lisvarat rava sheamar mitzva aggone maggena mippureanut, mikkelal haddavar hahu shello yavo leyado avon sheyyesovev happureanut, shezzulat ze gam mehappureanut eno muvtach.

Nimtzenu omrim shellisvarat rav yosef mitzva bishat maase matztzelet miyyetzer hara, vegam lisvarat rava leterutz sheni im heavon yesovev pureaniyyot baolam hazze tagen alav hammitzva mimmennu, velaze ba hakkatuv kan letaretz hakkusheya hannirgeshet lamma lo hegena alehem hammitzva shehalchu bishlichut mitzva dichtiv "vayyishlach otam moshe al pi Adonai" lehatztzilam mehappureaniyyot asher sovev lahem, veamar vayyelchu vayyavou perush lehakkish halichatam leviatam, ma biatam beetza raa af keshehalchu beetza raa, im ken en kan mitzva kol ikkar veadrabba sheluche avera hem.

Od nire hattaam shehutzrach hakkatuv lehashemienu ze, hu al pi ma sheamru sham bekiddushin (kiddushin lat:), achar shetteretz lisvarat Rabbi yaakov shehaya lo lehagen alav millavo lide avera, chazar hattalmud lehakeshot: vehaamar Rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin? umetaretz: sullam raua hava, ad kan. vekashe, ma kushya hi zot achar sheamar hashshas mehareher baavoda zara hu, lamma lo yoil davar ze gam leterutz kushyat "sheluche mitzva enan nizzokin"? ella vadday sheshsheluche mitzva yesh lahem toelet bishlichut hammitzva shello yimmashech lahem peulla raa mehashshelichut atzmo, umashma mehashshas shezze davar muskam hu. umeatta nitchayyev hakkatuv lomar vayyelchu vayyavou, laakor mehem shem shelichut mitzva, shello halchu ella beetza raa, velaze huzzeku bishlichutam.

Uvederech remez yitbaer amro vayyelchu vayyavou, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota 3.) baale hassod, ki adam gadol kesheyyizdammen lefanav avera veyiggash laasot, porachat mimmennu nafsho harama venichneset bo ruach shetut veaz yikrav laasotah. uletzad shehakketuvim meidim shehaanashim hahemma nesie yisrael ugedole hannefesh, laze heid hakkatuv ki bishat maase hara keshebbau lemoshe ledabber divre resha halchu, perush parchu mehem orot hakkedoshot minnishmatam veaz vayyavou.

Od yirmoz bemaamar vayyelchu sheasu halicha muchletet beeretz kenaan shello yavou lah od, kaasher gillu bedivrehem asher dibberu laam. gam hattora hechlita alehem shehalichatam halichat olam velo yashuvu lirotah od. veamro vayyavou el moshe vegomer ba latet taam lamma bau velo neevdu bishlichutam, el moshe vegomer perush chash Adonai al devar kevod moshe asher al ken hishlimu hashshelichut uvau. od kede sheyyiru moshe veaharon vehaeda maase Adonai ki anashim meat alu ben kamma ummot gedolim vaatzumim venimletu, umizze yatzdiku ki kemo chen yaase Adonai immahem lehatil ematam al kol haammim, visharim darche Adonai vegomer (Hoshea 14:10).

El midbar paran kadesha. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir hakkatuv "kadesha" ella bachazara velo bahalicha. veulay sheramaz bemaamar kadesha ma shennitakkevu bekadesh besibbat hameraggelim, dichtiv (Devarim 1:46) "vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim kayyamim asher yeshavtem", veamru zichronam livracha (Rashi sham) tesha esre shana asu bekadesh utesha esre shana bachazara mikkadesh ad shehiggiu lah paam sheniyya hare sheloshim ushemone shana, meatta bekadesha uvesibbuvah nitakkevu kol hazzeman sheggarmu hammeraggelim lehitakkev bammidbar, vehu maamar "vayyavou el moshe vegomer el kol adat yisrael kadesha".

Vayyashivu otam davar. helim hakkatuv teshuvatam haraa veamar davar setam, sheen derech hakkatuv lichtov maasehem shel reshaim ella letzad hahechreach, kemo shettimtza shello katav harigat chur beyom maase haegel, vegam maase haegel amru baggemara (avoda zara 4:) shello nichtav ella lelammed yisrael sheim chata tzibbur omrim lahem kallech etzel tzibbur, uchemo chen bema shellefanenu helim haddevarim ad shehutzrach lomar sheyyisrael ratzu lashuv lemitzrayim vayyamru baAdonai chas veshalom, chal alav lomar sibbat haddavar vegilla davar shehotziu dibbat haaretz. vetaam shehutzrach hakkatuv lomar hameraat yisrael, hu lehodia taam akkavatam bammidbar arbaim shana shehaya lesibbat hameraatam.
Veomer veet kol haeda, perush sheheshivuhu keshehaya et kol haeda, velo yichaduhu ledabber elav devarim haraim bifne atzmo, shennitkavvenu lehaveisho beene kol yisrael:
O yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyashivu otam davar haamur besamuch, uva hakkatuv lehodia shechalku kavod lemoshe leyached lo hatteshuva kechok hammelucha, veachar kach heshivu gam lechol haeda.

O yirtze al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha bammaamar shekkatavnu befasuk rishon, shennilkad moshe beyadam betaanat "veyachperu lanu et haaretz" vegomer ad kan. emor meatta shettaam shelichut yisrael haya taam bifne atzmo, vetaam shelichut moshe haya taam bifne atzmo. laze amar hakkatuv vayyashivu otam davar – lemoshe veaharon laddevarim sheamar lahem bishlichuto, veet kol haeda laddevarim sheamru lahem bishlichutam.
Vaysapperu lo vegomer. dikdek lomar lo, shehayu meyachadim haddibbur beyichud elav, aval hammaamar lo haya lemoshe levad ella lechol haeda hashshomim, vehu amro vayyomru velo amar lo.

Banu el haaretz vegomer. perush shehigganu shamma leshalom velo era lahem takkala, vegamru omer hattaam asher shelachtanu, perush, letzad sheasinu mitzvat shelichutecha nishmarnu. o yirtzu lomar letzad sheasa lahem levaya sheshshelacham hi sheamda lahem lavo el haaretz beshalom. veulay ki laze dikdek lomar vaysapperu lo, lomar shessipperu davar hannogea lemaalat moshe ki zechuto amda lahem. veamro vayyomru hiv teshuvat haaretz ma shennogea lichlalut yisrael laze lo amar lo.
Vegam zavat chalav udevash vegomer. amro "vegam" – letzad shekkadma hodaa bemidda tova shennaasa lahem nes bahalicha, mosifin lehodot gam betovat haaretz ki zavat chalav vegomer:

Mibben esrim vegomer asher halinotem. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro asher halinotem, veim ratza lomar "al asher halinotem" chaser tevat "al", gam lo haya tzarich lomar, shekkevar amar "et telunnot vegomer shamati" vegomer (bammidbar 14:27).

Venire shekkavvanat haddevarim hi, letzad sheamar Adonai mibben esrim shana, chash sheyyavinu shekkavvanat haddevarim hi kol mi shehayyom ben esrim, uchefi ze nichlalim bichlal haggezera gam mi sheyyatza mimmitzrayim pachot meesrim kevan shebbeshana sheniyya bau lichlal esrim, laze amar asher halinotem perush mizzeman shehitchilu lehalin, veshiur hakkatuv hu otam shehelinu alay mibben esrim. uchefi ze chozer lahalana rishona kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim, sheim al halanatam az lo haya tzarich ledayyek devarav velomar ben esrim bizman hahalana kevan shehu medabber beoto zeman shehu zeman shehelinu, vehu ma sheamar lemala "vaynassu oti ze eser peamim" (bammidbar 14:22), ha lamadta kol shehaya bichlal esrim bechet rishon hu shennichlal bichlal haggezera.

Veulay ki diyyuk ze lo hirgishu bo haddor hahu, vechashvu haddevarim kifshatan shebbaa haggezera al otan shehayu az ben esrim, velaze shenat haarbaim kesheyyatzu lachpor belel tisha beav velo met mehem echad, uvadku bey vey veyv veyg veyd veasu yom 15 simcha (Eicha Rabba, Petichta), vekashe lamma chashvu sheyyamutu od achar shehayu yeduim otam shehayu ben esrim kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim, uma mechush od lahem laggezera. ella shehem chashvu shehaggezera hayta al otan shehayu az ben esrim.

Veulay ki gam Adonai amar devarav shekulim keminhago sheomer devarim sovlim shene derachim, im zachu yihye letova lo zachu vechulei, vechen timtza kesheamar leadam (Bereshit 2:17) "beyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut" hizkir yom setam, tuchal lomar yomo shel adam vetuchal lomar yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu elef shana, uchesheasa adam teshuva hitta Adonai hakkavvana lizchut shehu yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. kemo chen bema shellefanenu nitkavven bemaamar asher halinotem shene derachim: echad al asher halinotem, veechad hu hevdel lehatechalat hahalana kidvarenu, im zachu yitparesh haddavar lizman yetzia kidvarenu, veim lo zachu titkayyem haggezera gam al otam shehayu kesheyyatzu pachot meesrim. uma sheamar "vaynassu oti ze eser peamim" yedabber al rov hammallinim, velaze kesherau bishnat haarbaim shello met echad mehem asauhu yom tov al shennitbattela haggezera meal otam sheyyatzu pachot meesrim vehayu bishat haggezera ben esrim.

Veattem al vegomer. perush, kol hafelagot hammora yeshno beerech zulatchem, aval lo attem. vedikdek lomar vav shel "veattem" lirmoz afilu achar shehitzdiku divre hammeraggelim vedibberu devarim bilti hagunim.

Ki lachmenu hem. taam shehotziu haddavar bilshon lechem, yitbaer al pi divre anshe emet shechakru bemaase Adonai asher asa beharekavat habbaale chayyim shekkol chay ochel veshote, shehaya Adonai yachol asot sheyyitkayyemu baale chayyim belo maachol, vehinne lefanecha min beriyya sheshshoefet ruach vehaya lah lemazon, veim kacha haya Adonai ose hayu yisrael nifnim leesek hattora ulammitzvot, gam hayu nimnaim mikkamma maasim bilti hagunim asher yesubbevu mitztzarche hammichya vehakkalkala.

Velaze hayiti metaretz meatzmi, ki ratza Adonai lezakkot yisrael betaryag mitzvot asher rubbam teluyim bemine hammaachol vehammishte: hatterumot, maasrot, challa, mitzvat shemitta, veshebbazzeria, veshebbacharisha, veshebbakketzira, vechaddome.

Aval chachme haemet (sear haggilgulim 84) hosifu baze taam lishvach bederech kelal, ki chol ikkare hannivraim maalin bakkodesh besod habberurin shel nitzotze hakkedushsha, hen henna hammitbarrim beemtzaut hammaachalim, umeatta nitzotze hakkedushsha yikkaru lechem am Adonai. gam amru zichronam livracha ki chol nivra yesh bo nitzotz kadosh, vaafillu benivraim bilti tehorim, vehaanashim harshaim, vegam besm harasha, en mehem sheen bo chelek hachiyyuni shehu bechinat hattov shehu davar hammaamid shezzulato lo yitkayyem kol davar, uvehippared nitzotz hachiyyuni mimmekomo yitbattel veyovad kol habbinyan. gam amru (sham 98) ki bechinat hakkedushsha betivah lehameshich minah keeven hashshoevet, uvaze taskil lehavin maamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat lod.) sheamru yahiv beh eneh venaasa gal shel atzamot, vehaven. veal pi haddevarim yechuvvan amro "al tiru vegomer ki lachmenu hem", vechazru ufershu, min hallechem sheanu omrim hu "sar tzillam mealehem", vehu nitzotz hammechayye otam kevar husar mealehem, veod vaAdonai ittanu shehu bechinat kelalut hakkedushsha, uvaze naase keeven hashshoevet lechol nitzotzin hammechayyim otam veneevadim kullam yachad, umeatta en makom liro mehem, keamro "al tiraum".

rashi: Lamma ragshu goyim. rabbotenu (berachot 7:) darshu et hainyan al melech hammashiach, ulefi mashmao ulitshuvat hamminim yihye nachon lefotro al david atzmo, keen shenneemar "vayyishmeu felishtim ki mashchu yisrael et david lemelech alehem vayyikkavtzu felishtim et machanehem" (Shmuel 2 5:17), venaflu veyado, vaalehem amar lamma ragshu goyim venitkabbetzu kullam:
Uleummim yehgu. belibbam rik:
Uleummim. menachem patar leummim veummim vegoyim kullam kerove inyan:
targum: Lema mitragshin ammaya veumaya merannin serikuta:

ohc: Ki haamaleki vegomer ki al ken shavtem vegomer. perush, kevan shehammered haya al ma sheamru hammeraggelim "amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev vegomer vehakkenaani" vegomer veamru "velamma Adonai mevi otanu linpol bacherev", veim ken ech tivtechu sheyyaase Adonai lachem nes bimkom haresha atzmo, velaze amar unefaltem bacherev bevadday, "ki al ken", perush, al heyot amalek yoshev vegomer, valachashashat nefila bacherev ze haya sibba shealeha shavtem meachare Adonai, uvevadday shello yihye Adonai immachem.

Vechi tishgu velo taasu vegomer. razal amru (horayot 8.) shekkatuv ze medabber beoved avoda zara, veyesh bo kefel amro et kol hammitzvot vegomer et kol asher tzivva vegomer, shebba lomar shekkofer baaseret haddibberot uvechol shear mitzvot shennitztauu al yede moshe. vechutz middivrehem nire shebba lomar shehaoved avoda zara hare hu keover al kol mitzvot lo taase umevattel kol mitzvot ase. keneged bittul mitzvot ase amar "velo taasu et kol hammitzvot" – hare bittul kol mitzvot ase, ucheneged averat al kol mitzvot lo taase amar "et kol asher tzivva Adonai alechem". vechiddush hishmianu hakkatuv bemitzvot ase uvemitzvot lo taase, ki yesh bemitzvot ase sheshshekula keneged kol hattora, af al pi chen haoved avoda zara hare hu kechofer gam bah. uchemo chen yesh bemitzvot lo taase chamurot, hare hu gam ken kechofer bechullan veansho shakul lakkol.

Vehaya lachem letzitzit. en yadua mechuvvan maamar ze sheyyihye letzitzit. uledivre hattosafot shekkatvu bemassechet menachot daf 43 bedivre rabbi meir sheamar sham veze leshono: gadol ansho shel lavan meansho shel techelet, mashal lemelech sheamar lishne avadav, leechad amar have li chotam shel tit uleechad amar have li chotam shel zahav, ufashu shenehem velo heviu, eze mehem ansho merubbe vechulei, katvu hattosafot ma shemmedamme chotam shel tit letzitzit shekkach osim laavadim, vehatztzitzit meid al yisrael shehem avde Adonai kidita bemassechet shabbat (57:) kavla deavda tenan, ad kan, yirtze bemaamar "vehaya lachem letzitzit" letzad shehem avadim laAdonai vehaeved ose kavla yihye lachem siman ze lechavla deavda.
