Veamar ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai – perush, kesheyyabbitu besiman avdutam yittenu lev sheenam bene chorin laasot kecheftzam bemaachalam, bemalbusham, bedibburam uvechol maasehem, keeved sheemat rabbo alav, velaamod beshaa shehaadon metzavve laamod, velaasot kol melachot asher tzivva Adonai laasot.

Veamar velo taturu vegomer, perush, letzad shehannigle hu davar shehaayin chafetza vechosheket bo, umitzvat hammelech hi tziuuy asot hefech haratzon hattivi vesanu hearev hammurgash, umin hannimna sheyyaamod baddavar ella behearat siman avduto hu yichpehu lehefech asher eno velibbo sham yachpotz.

Veamar "lemaan tizkeru vaasitem", yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (menachot 44.) maase beadam echad vechulei kevan sheala vechulei tafchu lo tzitziyyotav al panav vechulei, vehu amro "lemaan tizkeru", perush, shehatztzitzit hu yazkir etchem veyimna etchem mechet mikkol min chet. velaze dikdek lomar vaasitem, al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) yashav adam velo avar avera notnin lo sachar keose mitzva, veheemiduha bevaa leyado avera uferash mimmenna. veamar vihyitem kedoshim al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 24) en nikra kadosh ella happoresh min haarayot. veamro ani Adonai elohechem vegomer perush, chiyyuv haavdut sheani mechayyev etchem laasot alav siman letzad shehotzeti etchem vegomer, vechafal lomar paam sheniyya ani Adonai elohechem hu chiyyuv muskol. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Vayikra 25:55) "ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem" vegomer:

Umeatta banu lehasekil al devar emet asher tzivva Adonai bemitzva zo, sheen laasot tzitzit ella bichsut bat arba kenafot velo bat shalosh uvat chamesh, ki letzad shehatztzitzit hu siman haavdut yetzav Adonai sheyyihye hassiman gam ken yaggid mi lanu adon, ki yimmatze gam ken davar ze bemalche eretz shekkol echad yaase min siman echad laavadav venikkar hassiman shel kol echad, uchemo chen gazar Adonai shello naase siman avdutenu laAdonai ella betallit bat arba kenafot lirmoz ki malkenu hu habbore arba katzvot haolam veshallit aleha, velaze bihyot hattallit bat shalosh uvat chamesh avda hakkavvana veen laasot bah tzitzit.

Vetzivva sheyyihyu hachutin lavan lirshom simanav yitbarach, ki middotav hem middat harachamim vehattov haramuz bemin hallavan. gam hattechelet lirmoz al shelitato bashshamayim, ki hattechelet doma larakia. gam bemispar hachutin arbaa shehem shemona yirmoz lishmo yitbarach shehu shem ben arba veyichudo behechalo hu ben shemone besod hashshilluv shel havaya veadnut. gam rasham bedat hael (menachot lat.) laasot kesher hattechelet im hallavan lehair bemusekol nelam, ki hallavan hu sod hachesed vehattechelet hu sod harachamim, vehu sod bechinat shamayim. umidda zo mityacheset leyaakov avinu shehu sod hattiferet, veamru mevine nistere hattora ki middat hattiferet titav lemiddat hachesed shehi mityacheset leavraham, velaze yakkif hattechelet lehallavan kaasher yakkif ruach lanneshama kayyadua leyode chen:

Veraiti lehair, lamma lo hichshir Adonai tzeva hattechelet ella middag ole mehayyam, velo mishshear devarim sheyyesh lahem tzeva ze atzmo? veulay shehu mittaam atzmo shezze hu sodo, keamram zichronam livracha (chullin 89.) yam dome larakia, vehaven. gam lehair sheharachamim yimmashchu mehattora hannirmezet bayyam, gam lirmoz ki harachamim nimshachim mibbechina hannirmezet baddag besod ena pekicha, kayyadua laroim beor hachayyim:
Chassalat parashat shalach lecha

Vayyomru lemor. amro tevat lemor achar sheamar el kol bene yisrael. ulay ki letzad sheggam hameraggelim gam hem amru "eretz zavat chalav" vegomer shehu shevach haaretz, vechavvanatam hayta lehara lehatzedik maamar haddofi, laze heid hakkatuv ki yehoshua vechalev nitkavvenu leromem ulefaer haaretz, vetevat lemor kan leshon rommut al derech amro (Devarim 26:17) "heemarta veheemircha".

Tova haaretz vegomer. nitkavvenu listor divre hammeraggelim sheamru "eretz ochelet" vegomer, veamru "tova meod meod" ben beinyan peroteha ben beyishshuvah. ucheneged hafelagat hammenia amru "im chafetz" vegomer "unetanah" betorat mattana lo bechoach yigbar ish, vegamru omer "lachmenu hem".

targum: Ushemana veitmese libbana vela ishtearat od rucha beenash min kodamechon are Adonai elahachon hu elaha dishchinteh bishmaya milela veshalit al ara milra:
Vetechun yat abba veyat ima veyat achay veyat achate veyat kol dilhon uteshezvun yat nafshatana mimota:
Vahava misof telata yomin vaavaru sarchaya bego mashrita:
Veakdem yehoshua betzafra unetalu mishitin vaato ad yardena hu vechol bene yisrael uvatu taman kodam yaabberun:
Yehodun kodam Adonai metul chasdeh umishtaan perishvateh livne nesha:
Arum asba nefesh sereka venafsha kefina mele tuva:
Udevirat itteta yat teren guvraya veatmaratnun vaamarat bekusheta ato levati guvraya vela yidet e minan inun:
Vaamaru lah guvraya zakkain anachna mimomatech hada dekayemta alana:
Vaazalu vealu letora vitavu taman telata yomin ad detavu radfaya uveo radfaya bechol archa vela ashkachu:
Vaamarat lehon letura ezilu dilma yearun bechon radfaya vetitamrun taman telata yomin ad dituvun radfaya uvatar ken tehachun leorchatchon:
Veinun ad la shechivu vehi selekat levathon leigra:
Veitamar lemalka diricho lememar ha guveraya ato hacha belelya mibbene yisrael lealala yat ara:
Vehi askatnun leigra veatmaratnun bitune chittana disdirin lah al igra:
Ha anachna alin beara yat tora dechut zehorita haden tikteri bacharakka deshalshaltana beh veyat avuch veyat imech veyat achaychi veyat kol bet avuch tichneshin levatech leveta:
Vaamaru lihoshua are mesar Adonai bidana yat kol ara veaf ittebaru kol yatve ara min kodamana:
Vihe kol deyippok bar midashe betech levara chovat ketoleh beresheh vaanachna zakkain vechol di yehe imach beveta chovat ketoleh bereshana im yad enash tehe veh:
Ushelach yehoshua bar nun min shitin teren guverin meallin beraz lememar azilu chazu yat ara veyat yericho vaazalu vealu levet itteta punedkita ushema rachav ushechivu taman:
Vaamarat leguvraya yedana are yehav Adonai lechon yat ara vaare nefalat ematchon alana vaare ittebaru kol yatve ara min kodamechon:
Uchean kayymu chean li bememra dayya are avadit imchon tivu vetabedun af attun im bet abba tivu vetittenun li at dikshot:
Veguvraya redafu batrehon orach yardena ad megizata vetara achadu batar dinfaku radfaya batrehon:
Ushelach malka diricho levat rachav lememar afiki guvraya daato levatich daalu levetech are lealala yat kol ara ato:
Vaamaru lah guvraya nafshana mesiran chalaf nafshatechon lememat im la techavun yat pitgamana den vihe kad yitten Adonai lana yat ara venaaved imach tevu ukeshot:
Vaamarat kefitgamechon kan hu ushelachatnun vaazalu vekitrat yat tora dizhorita bacharakka:
Veim techavin yat pitgamana den unehe zakkain mimomatich dekayemt alana:
Veshalshelatnun beatuna min charakka are vetah bechotel shura uveshura hi yatva:
Vetavu teren guvrayn unechitu min tura vaavaru vaato levat yehoshua bar nun veishteiu leh yat kol dearaa yathon:
Are shemana yat deyabbesh Adonai yat me yama desuf min kodamechon bemippakchon mimitzrayim vedi avadtun litren malche emoraa di beavra deyardena lesichon uleog di gemartun yathon:
Vetzalu kodam Adonai kad ayak lehon mimikathon petza yathon:
Vahava idan lemechad tara bekivla veguvraya nefaku la yadet lean azalu guvraya ridfu bifria batrehon are tadbekunun:
Shaviu vekadishe shemaya pumehon velishanhon metzalhava bekadishe ara:

bart: Chamishsha devarim. en lecha vetzibbur karban neechol ella ellu, vekarban tzibbur doche et hattuma, deyalfinan mippesach dichtiv beh bemoado, vedoche et hattuma kesherov hakkahal temeim, dehachi amrinan ish ki yihye tame vechulei, yachid nidche veen tzibbur nidchin, uvekarbenot tzibbur ketiv (Bamidbar 29) elle taasu laAdonai‏ bemoadechem, kemo shenneemar bappesach bemoado, veashmeinan matnitin deaf al gav dikrevin betuma leappoke tzibbur yede chovatan, en neechalim betuma. veha detane chamishsha devarim velo tane karbenot tzibbur vechulei, minyana lemaote chagigat hargalim kullam, dedamu lekarban tzibbur mishshum deatu vichnufeya baasefat chaverim laregel, veenam dochim et hattuma kederech sheen dochim et hashshabbat:
Zivche shalme tzibbur. kivse atzeret, sheen shelamim acherim latztzibbur:

Useire rashe chodashim. velo tane seire regalim, dechevan deashmeinan zivche shalme tzibbur shehen mine damim veen neechalin betuma, hu haddin lechol shear mine damim, velo itzterich lemitne seire rashe chodashim ella mishshum dela chetiv behu moed, vesalka datach amena lo lidchu et hattuma, deha kol karbenot tzibbur mimmoed nafka lan, dichtiv bechullehu elle taasu laAdonai‏ bemoadechem:

Shello va mittechillato ella laachila. shekkeshennitztavva ikkar mitzvat pesach laachila nitztavva, dichtiv (Shemot 12) lefi achlo, vechi sharye rachamana laatoye vetuma meish nidche veen tzibbur nidchin, addata lemechleh sharye:
Amar lashshoel vechulei‏ patur. shehare af keshennishba lashsheker chiyyev et atzmo vetashlumin veen bishvua zo kefirat mamon:
Ematay meviim immo chagiga. im happesach bearbaa asar benisan:
Bizman shehu va bechol uvetohora. deaf al gav defesach dache shabbat vetuma, chagiga lo dachya shabbat:
Uvemuat. shehaya fesach muat laachilat bene chavura, veochlin hachagiga techilla kede sheyyihye happesach gemar seviatan:
Bimrubbe. shehayta hachavura muetet veday lahen bappesach levaddo:
Uvetuma. sherov tzibbur temein:
En meviin immo chagiga. shechagigat yom arbaa asar reshut hi velo chova:
Hammamne acherim al chelko. echad mibbene chavura shehimna acherim al chelko, belo daat chavura:

Rashshain bene chavura lomar lo. tol et shellecha vetze veechol atta vachaverecha, sheen bene chavura mitratztzim lihyot kol ellu haddeot bachavuratan. veit leh lehay tanna pesach neechol bishte chavurot:
Arbaa shomrim hem. vedinehen shelosha:
Nose sachar. shomer besachar:
Nishba al hakkol. shello fasha:

Meshallem et hakkol. kol hanach ditninan bematnitin, shevuya ushevura umeta ugeneva vaaveda. aval meta mechamat melacha, eno meshallem, delav leokma bechilleta shealah. vehammishna hazzot meforeshet behassocher et happoalim:

Veamar amen patur. sheillu hoda lo haya meshallem kelum, nimtza sheen kan kefirat mamon. veaf al pi shennishba lashsheker, lo chiyyeva tora karban shevua ella hecha shekkefaro mamon. vechen haddayyan eno yachol lehashebia ella al davar sheim hoda haya chayyav leshallem mamon:
Tefi. pach katan sheppiv tzar vehammayim hayyordim mimmennu yordim tif tif:
Af al pi sheppiv tzar. pachot mishshefoferet hannod:
Hammayim shebbetocho mekuddashim. uchesherim lehazzot af al pi shello nichnas sham meefer happara kelal, dahavu keillu mechubbarim lammayim shebbashshoket:
Haya sefog. im bishat milluy haya sefog bashshoket, hammayim habbeluim bassefog pesulim, demayim chayyim el keli bainan, veen hassefog keli:

Yezallef ad shehu maggia lassefog. keshebba littol hammayim velittenem batztzelochit, shofech kol hammayim ad shemmaggia lassefog, aval lo yishpoch min hammayim shebbassefog kelal, kede shello yitarvu hammayim shebbassefog shehem pesulim im hammayim shebbashshoket shehem kesherim veyippaslu chullam:
Naga bassefog. nischatim me hassefog letoch hashshoket venitarvu happesulim bakkesherim, venifselu chullam:
Hamemalle lo ulechattat. hamemalle mayim, ketzatan rotze letzarko uviktzatan rotze litten efer chattat:
Baesel. bammot. vederech shoave mayim shennotnim mot al ketefam vechad male taluy berosh hammot millefanav vechad echad meachorav:
Veachar kach mille et shello pasul. mishshum melacha:
Veet shel chattat lefanav. kede laasot bahen shemira meulla:
Veim natan shel chattat laachorav pesula. dichtiv lemishmeret leme nidda, bizman shehen shemurin hen me nidda, bizman sheenan shemurin enan me nidda:
Hayu shenehen shel chattat vechulei. dehoil umassik addateh beshellefanav nizkar nammi veshel achorav. vehayenu mippene sheefshar, kelomar efshar lishmor shellaachorav aggav shellefanav:

Ketzad tzolin. shappud shel rimmon. velo shear etzim, demappeki mayya vahava leh bashel mevushshal bammayim, verimmon lo mappik mayya. uveshappud shel mattechet lo, kedilkamman, decham miktzato cham kullo venitzle mechamat shappud, verachamana amar tzeli esh velo tzeli davar acher:
Kemin bishshul hu ze. shemmitbashshelin bene meav letocho kivtoch hakkedera:
Tolin chutza lo. tochavan bashshappud lemala mippiv shel tale. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Amar rabbi tzadok kulei. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, veim askala menukkevet hi keshera, veamar rabbi tzadok vechulei, vahalacha kerabbi tzadok:
Naga happesach becharso shel tannur yikllof. min happesach makom hannogea battannur, shennitzla sham mechom cheres hattannur velo tzeli esh hu:
Nataf meratbo al hacheres vechazar elav. shechazar shumman shennitchammem min hacheres venivla bappesach:
Yittol et mekomo. velo saggi viklifa ella vintila koovi etzba, deshumman nivla betocho harebe, veoto shumman tzali min hacheres hu:

Nataf meratbo al hassolet. vehassolet rotachat, demitzlle rotev mechamat solet, vehahu rotev shebbetoch hassolet asur lemechleh, dahava leh tzali mechamat davar acher, hilkach yikmotz et mekomo veyisrof oto kometz kishar kadashim happesulim:

Hare ze nishba venotel. vedavka shehachavala bemakom sheefshar shechaval beatzmo, mishshum hachi tzarich shevua. aval bemakom sheeno yachol lachavol beatzmo venikkar sheacherim asu lo, kegon shealta lo neshicha vegabbo, veen sham acher, sheyyuchal lomar shemma acher asa, notel belo shevua:
Nitma vasar vehachelev kayyam eno zorek et haddam. deikkar pesach laachilat adam ate:
Uvammukdashim eno chen. sheafillu nitma vasar vechelev kayyam, zorek et haddam:
Vehora horaa. lehattir o leesor, letamme o letaher, liftor o lechayyev:
Vedavar sheeno mishshum melacha. kegon horaa umare et hadderech:
Im amad. shennitakkev sham bishvil ze:
Pasul. mishshum hessach haddaat. vechen halacha:

Hammalve et chavero al hammashkon. naase alav shomer sachar, lo shena mishkeno vishat halevaato, lo shena mishkeno shello bishat halevaato. veim avad o nignav vehaya hammashkon keneged hachov, yatza mashkono vechovo veen lahem ze al ze kelum. veim hachov yater al hammashkon, meshallem love lammalve ma shehaya hachov yoter. veim hammashkon yoter al hachov, meshallem malve lallove. veim neevad beones, sheshshomer sachar patur, gam hammalve fatur, venishba shebbeones neevad vegove chovo chullo:
Shekel. chatzi sela:
Lo chi. lo chen haya:

Ella sela hilvitani alav ushelosha dinarim haya shave chayyav. shehare hu hoda vemiktzat hattaana, shehassela shave arbaa dinarin. vechevan shehallove chayyav lishshava kamma haya shave hammashkon shello, vehammalve chayyav lishshava al hammashkon sheeno virshuto, veaf al pi shemmeshallem damav, mishshum dechayshinan shemma enav natan bo, bet din mashbiin et hammalve techilla sheen hammashkon birshuto, veachar kach mashbiin et hallove kamma haya shave. shemma yishshava hallove techilla velo dikdek bashshuma veyotzi hammalve et hammashkon veyifselennu leedut velishvua. veha ditninan bassefa mi nishba, mi nishba techilla kaamar:
Mi shehappikkadon etzlo. hammalve shehaya hammashkon etzlo nishba sheen hammashkon birshuto:

Shammay omer kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. kol hannashim haroot dam, dayyan sheatan letamme tohorot shennagu bahen mishsheat reiyyatan veelach. velo amrinan mikkamme hachi nammi hava dam vechatle bet harechem heemiduhu vehayta temea mikkodem shekkol hannashim metammeot babbayit hachitzon veaf al pi shello yatza haddam lachutz. vetaama deshammay dela chayesh dilma mikkamme hachi hava dam, sheim atta omer ken, libbo shel adam nokfo tamid bishat bia uforesh meishto venimtzeta mevattel benot yisrael mipperiyya ureviyya:

Mippekida lifkida. badka hayyom umatza tehora uvadka lesof shavua umatza temea, choshshim lemaggaah mibbedika rishona veelach, shemma im silluk yadeha raata vechatle bet harechem heemiduhu. ulevittul periyya ureviyya lo chayshinan, dedavka lattohorot hu dimtammeinan lehu mippekida lifkida, velo levalah. veshammay omer, i metammet lah lattohorot, libbo nokfo uforesh nammi mittashmish:

Lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze. lo kedivre shammay demekel tefe veeno ose seyag lidvarav, velo kedivre hillel shehifriz al middotav umachmir yoter midday, devadday chulle hay yamim rabbim lo mokme katle bet harechem dam:

Meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida. shene zemannim huzkeru baishsha letamme tohorot lemafrea, vehallech achar hakkal shebbishnehen. im mippekida lifkida yoter al meet leet, hallech achar meet leet velo tetamme ella tohorot shennaga meetmol bashshaa hazzot. veim meet leet yoter al mippekida lifkida, kegon shebbadka atzmah shacharit umatza tehora vearvit matza temea, lo metammeinan ella hanach tohorot demibbedikat shacharit veelach. vahalacha kachachamim:
Al yad. achar. kemo veal yado hechezik, besefer ezra 2‏ [nechemya 3], shehu kemo veacharav hechezik [sham 16]:
Veset. kavua, shennikba lah zeman haorach shalosh peamim, uvadka bishat vestah umatza temea, dayyah sheatah, velo chayshinan dilma mikkamme hachi hava, devadday orach bizmanno ba:

Vehameshammeshet beiddim hare zo chifkida. tarte katane, vehachi kaamar, umeshammeshet baiddim, kelomar mitzva al kol ishsha leshammesh bishne iddim shebbodeket bahen, echad lifne tashmish veechad leachar tashmish:
Hare zo chifkida. haed shelachar tashmish hare hu kifkida:

Memaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida. demahu detema shemma tire tippat dam kechardal utechappennah shichvat zera velo leheve kifkida, ka mashma lan matnitin deed shelachar tashmish hava chifkida. aval haed shellifne tashmish eno kifkida, shemmittoch shehi mehuma levetah, kelomar behula leshammesh, enah machneset oto lachorin velassedakin:

Shello vetaana. shello betaanat bari ella vetaanat shemma, shettoano shemma ikkavta mishshelli. umishshum dechol hane moru hetter leatzmam lefi shettarchu vannechasim, mishshum hachi ramu rabbanan shevua alayhu:
Veappotroppim. shennitasseku vemamon adam lehachenis ulehotzi velissa velitten. aval beappotroppos shel yetomim, im minnahu vet din yishshava, veim avi yetomim minnahu lo yishshava:
Vehaishsha hannoset venotenet betoch habbayit. shehoshivah balah chenvanit o appotroppa al nechasav:
Uven habbayit. echad min haachin shennitassek bannechasim mishshemmet avihen:
Chalku. velo hishbiuhu vishat hachaluka:
Nitgalgela lo shevua. etzlam achare chen, megalgelin gam et zo alav. uchederech shemmegalgelin bishvuat hattora uvishvua shehi cheen shel tora, kach megalgelin bishvuat hesset:
Vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua. lav ahanach shevuot deshuttafin kae, deha en sheviit meshammetet shuttafut velo shevuatah. ella milva ushevuatah hi meshammetet:
Rova atzamot. rova kav shel atzmot hammet metammeim beohel. ufachot [merova] en metammein ella bemagga uvemassa aval lo beohel. vesavre bet shammay derova kav metammeim vaafillu hen mimmetim harebe:

Uvet hillel omrim rova atzamot min haggeviyya. kelomar, migguf echad shel met echad, velo mimmetim harebe. vaafillu shel met echad en metammein ad sheyyihye berova hakkav rov binyan dehaynu rov godel hagguf, o rov minyan atzmotav shel adam, veyihyu mea esrim vechamesh atzamot, shemminyan atzmotav shel adam matayim arbaim ushemone:
Afillu meetzem echad. im etzem echad shel met memalle rova kav, metamme beohel. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Kol happosel et hatteruma. kegon yadayim sheniyyot osot mashkim techilla letamme chullin, veyadayim atzman shennagu veachle chullin, tehorim, sheen sheni ose shelishi vechullin:

Chutz mittevul yom. shello heeriv shimsho. af al pi shehu fosel et hatteruma, eno metamme hammashkin lihyot techilla. vaafillu mashkin shel teruma im naga bahen tevul yom enan ella fesulim bilvad lo temeim:
Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot. pesach echad:

Ellu hofchim penehem helach veellu hofchim penehem helach. vaafillu nirim kishte chavurot al pesach echad lo ichpat lan, derachamana amar (sham 12) al habbattim asher yochlu oto, demashma shene vene adam ochlin pesach echad bishne battim, dichtiv yochlu [shenayim], oto chad pesach, [battim] shenayim. aval adam echad eno ochel bishne mekomot, ulehachi moke bevayit echad yeachel, sheen echad ochel bishne battim. ushete chavurot hahofchot penehem kishne vattim dame:
Vehammecham. shemmechammemin bo et hachammin shemmozgim bo hayyayin, rashshay litten baemtza kede sheyyehe noach lishtehen limzog lechan ulechan. veaf al pi shemmafsik ben hachavurot, lo ichpat lan:
Ucheshehashshammash. hameshammesh lishtehen, omed mechavura achat shehitchil leechol happesach immah umozeg lachavura haacheret:
Kofetz et piv. soger uvolem et piv umachzir et panav letzad chavurato, shello yachsheduhu shehu ochel im hachavura haacheret, deen adam echad ochel bishte chavurot kidamran:
Vehakkalla. shehi vosha, rashshaa lahafoch paneha letzad acher veleechol, defesach neechol bishte chavurot:
Lemashkeno shello virshut. uchegon sherauhu edim shennichnas levet chavero veen beyado kelum veyatza mishsham vechelim techuvim lo tachat kenafav:

Hare ze nishba venotel. shehare haddevarim mochichim, shehaedim meidim shemmishkeno shello virshut. vehu detaen leh haich bemide deamed beh, aval im taen leh bechasa dechaspa vechi hay gavna bemide dela amed beh, lav kol kemineh lishshava velittol, ella yishshava hannitba veyippater:

Hammolich et hachevel beyado ledarko. leachar shemmille et haddeli bechevel hechezir et hachevel labbealim. ledarko, shello hutzrach leakkem o leharechiv et darko ella lefi hillucho matza vaal hachevel vehechezir lo et shello, en zo melacha vechasher hammilluy:
Shello ledarko. sheikkem et darko kede lehachazir hachevel, melacha hi ufasul:
Ze halach. kelomar al davar ze halach chacham echad lishol mechachme yavne, hen sanhedri gedola sheggalu sham:
Horaat shaa. sheat haddechak haya. ha lav hachi lo:
Mikkav lechalla. issa sheyyesh bah kav chayyevet bechalla:

Kav umechetza chayyavim bechalla. shehen shiva luggin uvetza vechomesh betza, lemidda midbarit. vehu omer laggulgolet asirit haefa shechayyav bechalla, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 15) reshit arisotechem, kede issat midbar. vehosifu shetut bayrushalmiyyot, venimtzeu shesh midbariyyot nichnasim bechamesh yerushalmiyyot, velog hannishar uvetza vechomesh betza olim lelog yerushalmi. shehallog midbari shishsha betzim, tittenem bechamesh betzim gedolot, nimtza hallog chaser betza gedola, ten betza vechomesh betza tachat habbetza gedola, shehachomesh betza shehu shetut millevar nosaf al habbetza, nimtzeu shesh betzim gedolim shehen log gadol, hare hen shishsha luggim gedolim shehen kav umechetza:
Mishshehigdilu hammiddot. zo hi midda tzipporit, shehosifu shetut al shel yerushalmit, nimtzeu hashshishsha luggin chamishsha, shehen chameshet rive kav, shehakkav arbaa luggin:

Chamishsha vaod chayyavim. dekasavar rabbi yose, midda midbarit hayu betzim gedolot mishshellanu echad meesrim bevetza lechol betza. vahalacha kachachamim, dekav umechetza yerushalmi dehaynu shishsha luggin yerushalmiyyot shehen shiva luggin uvetza vechomesh betza midbariyyot, hen shiur challa. vehen arbaim veshalosh betzim vechomesh betza. verambam izzen vechakar vetikken uvadak umatza shemmishkal chamesh meot veesrim deraham mikkemach chittim hu shiur hakkemach hachayyav bechalla. umishkal hadderaham yadua bemitzrayim hayyom uvechol eretz yisrael, shehu mishkal shishshim veechad gargire seorot bekeruv:
Happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo. bearbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, vesavur keshem shemmuttar lishmo kach muttar shello lishmo:
Chayyav chattat. shechillel shabbat beshogeg:

Im enan reuyin. lefesach, kegon egel o ayil ben shete shanim o nekeva, chayyav alav chattat im nitallema mimmennu shabbat o savur shemmuttar lishchot zevachim acherim leshem pesach beshabbat, dehay lav toe vidvar mitzva, dehakkol yodim sheen ze kasher lefesach:
Veim reuyin hen. kegon se ben shana shel shelamim sheshshechato leshem pesach, demittoch shehu tarud uvahul lishchot pischo taa vedavar ze velo nizkar shehikdisho lezevach acher:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat. af al pi shettaa vidvar mitzva:

Verabbi yehoshua poter. dekasavar taa vidvar mitzva veasa mitzva kol dehu patur mechiyyuv chattat shebbah, veze asa mitzva shehikriv karban, dechol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim, veaf hannishchatim leshem pesach machshir lehu rabbi yehuda beferek tamid nishchat:
Ma im happesach. shemmuttar leshachto veshabbat lishmo, shinna et shemo odet miha dechayyav chattat kidkatane leel:
Sheshshinnahu ledavar haasur. sheshshechato leshem karbanot acherim sheasurim leshachtan beshabbat:
Sheshshinnahu ledavar hammuttar. sheshshochato leshem davar hammuttar leshachto beshabbat:
Emure tzibbur. karbanot haamurim betzibbur beshabbat kegon temidim umusafim yochichu, shemmuttarim leshachtan lishman, vehashshochet shear zevachim lishman beshabbat chayyav:
Sheyyesh lahen kitzba. sheeno roe acherim asukin bishchitato, vechevan shennishchat hattamid yodea hu sheen tzarich lishchot od, hilkach en ze toe ella shogeg, delo haya lo litot baddavar:

Tomar bafesach sheen lo kitzba. dehakkol tzerichin lechach, vahare hu roe acherim harebe asukim bechach vetarud hu lehitassek bammitzva, vaafillu shachat hu fesach kevar umatza zevach ze omed baazara uchesavur shehu fesach ushechato leshem mi shehu, toe vidvar mitzva hu:
Rabbi meir omer. hashshochet beshabbat zevachim acherim kol yemot hashshana leshem emure tzibbur patur. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Veachar kach noda shehu tame. happesach o haddam:
Hatztzitz meratztze. ufatur mippesach sheni:
Nitma. bealav tumat hagguf bemet:
En hatztzitz meratztze. vechayyav befesach sheni, deha bishat zerika lav bar mebad pesach hu, derachamana dachye:
Hannazir. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) vechi yamut met alav [vegomer] vehayyamim harishonim yippelu, deim nitma vemet kodem havaat karbenotav soter:
Hatztzitz meratztze al tumat haddam. vetiglachto cheshera umuttar lishtot yayin velittame lammetim:
Veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf. veim [tame] bishat havaat karbenotav soter hakkol:
Nitma. gufo:
Betumat hattehom. kol tumat met shello yada bah adam kodem lachen nikret tumat hattehom:

Hatztzitz meratztze. dahalacha lemoshe missinay shehuttar tumat hattehom lahem, kevan shello hikkir bah adam betuma zo meolam. veim noda lo vetuma zo achar shehikriv pischo en tzarich laasot pesach sheni. vechen nazir shennoda lo vetumat hattehom leachar shehevi karbenotav en tzarich lehavi karban tuma. velo amru tumat hattehom ella betumat met bilvad:
Leochlav veshello leochlav patur vechulei. deha pesach kasher hu, deamrinan perek tamid nishchat dehashshochet lappesulim velakkesherim lo fasal:
Shechato venimtza vaal mum chayyav. deshogeg hu velo anus, shehaya lo [levakkero]:
Shemmashchu habbealim et yadam. mimmennu kodem shechita venimnu al acher:
O shemmetu o shennitmeu. deachshav lo nittena shabbat liddachot etzlam:
Patur. sheanus hu, delo haya yodea shekkach hu velo haya lo livdok al kach:
Happesach sheyyatza. chutz lachoma:

Yissaref miyyad. bearbaa asar, velo tzarich leashhoye ad habboker shel chamishsha asar kede shetteubbar tzurato dehaynu sheyyavo lide notar. umihu beyom tov lo matze saref leh, deen sorfin kadashim beyom tov:
Nitmeu vealim o shemmetu. en pesulo vegufo ella mechamat davar acher:
Teubbar tzurato. yamtin ad sheyyavo lide notar, veachar kach yisrefennu:

Af ze yissaref miyyad. rabbi yochanan ben beroka lo faleg attanna kamma ella keshennitmeu habbealim o metu kodem zerikat haddam, delo ichaze basar baachila vahava leh kifsulo vegufo. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka:
Shachat gedi yochal. rabbo mimmennu. veaf al gav divchol shear pesachim ragil tadir betale, kevan delo feresh lo aleh samech:

Yochal min harishon. vehashsheni yissaref. uvaggemara moke la davka vemelech umalka, it deamre mishshum shelom malchut, veit deamre mippene shessomchin al avdehem veen makpidim al seudatan im gedayim im telaim, hilkach yochal min harishon kevan delekka kefida, devarishon yatzu yede chovatan. aval enashe dealma dekafde, lo yochal lo min harishon velo min hashsheni, dekayma lan en nimnin al shene fesachim keechad leechol eze mehem sheyyirtze, deen berera, vechi vae lemechal meha, dilma bishat shechita lo hava dateh aleh:
Shachach ma sheamar. shepperesh lo gedi o tale, veze shachach:

Vetale shelli. baggemara moke la kegon shehalach haeved etzel roe haragil etzel rabbo verotze vetakkanato, veamar lo, im gedi amar lecha rabbecha, gedi shello vetale shellecha al menat sheen lerabbecha reshut bo, dichhay gavna kana haeved. dei lav hachi ma shekkana eved kana rabbo, venimtzeu shenehem shel rabbo:

Ufeturim millaasot pesach sheni. deaf al gav dishnehem yotzim levet hasserefa veenan neechalin mippene sheen hammenuyin nikkarim, mihu shechita uzerika mealyata hi, chada ahay vachada ahay, dekamme shemayya galya:
Evar. min happesach:

Sheyyatza miktzato. chutz limchitztzato, vetzarich lachtoch et hayyotze dichtiv (Shemot 22) uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu, vedarshinan beh kol basar sheyyatza vassade kelomar sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato, kegon kadshe kadashim sheyyatzu chutz laazara vekadashim kallim sheyyatzu chutz lirushalayim, oto vasar hayyotze terefa hu velo tochelu:
Chotech. et habbasar hayyotze saviv ad shemmaggia laetzem:

Vekolef. et habbasar shello yatza lachutz ad shemmaggia lapperek shemmitchabberim sham shene atzamot, veochel et habbasar shekkalaf, shehare lo yatza, vechotech et happerek umashlich kol haetzem sheyyatza miktzato:
Uvammukdashim. bishar kadashim chutz mehappesach:
Kotzetz bakkofitz. oto miktzat haevar sheyyatza. uvappesach eno yachol laasot ken, mippene shehu muzhar al shevirat etzem:

Min haagaf velifnim kelifnim. agaf keri kol makom hagafat haddelatot shehu chofef venokesh sham keshessogro, dehaynu [missefat happenimi shel ovi happetach ad mekom hannekisha. min haagaf velifnim, dehaynu] toch hair mammash:
Kelifnim. veochlim sham kadashim kallim:
Min haagaf velachutz. dehaynu mimmekom hannekisha velachutz, kelachutz:
Hachallonot. shebbechomat yerushalayim, veovi rosh hachoma vegaggah, kelifnim:
En nishbain al taanat cheresh. kegon shettoano cheresh birmiza. decheresh sheamru chachamim bechol makom, eno shomea veeno medabber:

Vetaanat katan. kegon shettoano katan. deamar kera (Shemot 22) ki yitten ish el reehu, veen bintinat katan kelum. [vehacheresh] vehashshote kekatan hu. vedavka shevua deorayta hu sheen nishbain al taanat katan, aval shevuat hesset chayyavin lishshava al taanato:

Aval nishbain lakkatan velahekdesh. habba lippara minnichse katan, lo yippara ella vishvua. vechen hammakdish nechasav veyatza alav shetar chov uva vaal chov lippara min hannechasim shel hekdesh, tzarich shevua:

Lamma mazkirin divre hayyachid ben hamerubbin. kede levattelan. yachid shello asa shum bet din kidvarav vehen dechuyim uvetelin, lamma mazkirin otan kelal. umeshane, sheim yomar adam kach ani mekubbal veyitma kesheroe sheen osin kekabbalato, yomru lo kedivre ish peloni shamata venidchu devarav:
Hin. shenem asar luggin:
Poslin et hammikve. im naflu betocho kodem shennishlam shiuro. aval leachar shennishlam, afillu hishlich letocho kol mayim sheuvim shebbaolam shuv enan poslim:

Shechayyav adam lomar bilshon rabbo. kelomar, hin eno leshon mishna ella leshon tora, ella kach shama merabbotav shemaya veavtalyon. verambam kibbel meaviv zichrono livracha shemmippene shehayu shemaya veavtalyon gere tzedek lo hayu yecholin lehotzi mippihen millat hin, vehayu omrim in bimkom hin, kederech bene adam ad hayyom sheenam yecholim lachtoch beotiyyot [84], vehaya hillel gam hu omer in, kemo shehayu rabbotav shemaya veavtalyon gere tzedek omrim:
Gardiyyim. orgim:

Mishshaar haashpot. hizkir hattanna shem ummanutan veshem shechunatan, lomar lach shello yimna adam atzmo mibbet hammidrash. sheen lecha ummanut pechuta min haggardi, sheen maamidim hemennu lo melech velo kohen gadol, veen shaar birushalayim pechuta mishshaar haashpot, vehichriu beedutan lechol chachme yisrael:

Rabbi meir omer yesh devarim shehem kakkarka. anavim haomdot libbatzer hu deikka ben chachamim lerabbi meir, derabbi meir savar anavim haomdot libbatzer kivtzurot damyan, vachachamim savre lav kivtzurot damyan. vahalacha kachachamim. vedavka bedin shomrim, aval gabbe mikkach umimkar veonaa umode vemiktzat hattaana, bechol hane kayma lan dedavar haomed libbatzer kevatzur dami. vechen halacha:

Ad hazziz. kora shel aliyya habboletet mittoch habbayit. uchelala demilleta, leolam eno chayyav shevua deorayta ad sheyyitanennu davar shebbammidda o shebbammishkal o shebbamminyan, veyode lo vemiktzat hammidda o vemiktzat hammishkal o miktzat minyan:
Ella litra chasef patur. sheen kan hodaa mimmin hattaana:
Letech. chatzi chor. chamesh esre sein:
Kadde shemen. kaddim meleim shemen:
Vehoda lo vakkankannim. kaddim rekim belo shemen:
Hoil vehoda vemiktzat hattaana. dahava leh kemo teano chittin useorin vehoda lo beechad mehen. vahalacha keadmon, aval en halacha kerabban gamliel dimchayyev bitano chittin vehoda lo visorim:
Patur. mishshevua deorayta, lo al hakkarkaot velo al hakkelim. sheen hodaat karkaot meviattu lide shevua, sheen din shevua bekarkaot:
Hoda vemiktzat kelim. deikka hodaa uchefira belav karkaot:
Chayyav. lishshava af al hakkarkaot al yede gilgul shevua:
Zokkin. gorrin:

Haonen. kol zeman shello nikbar hammet karuy onen, uleachar shennikbar kol yom hammita hu karuy onen, velayla shelleacharav hu onen midderabbanan. velo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet gabbe fesach, hilkach shochatin alav, dilureta chazi:
Vehammefakkeach baggal. shennafal al adam veen yadua im yimtzaennu chay o met, shochatin alav, divchezkat tohora omed ad sheyyivvada shennitma:
Shochatin alehem. bachavurat acherim:

Shemma yeviuhu lide fesul. shemma yittame onen lemeto mittoch tirdo. umefakkeach gal shemma yimtzaennu met venimtza sheheehil al hattuma. vehechavush shemma lo yetze. uvechavush bevet haasurim shel ovde chochavim mayre, sheaf al pi shehivtichuhu, shemma lo yotziuhu, asher pihem dibber shav. aval chavush al yede yisrael, kegon lechufo lehotzi ishsha fesula o leshallem mamon, shochatin alehem afillu bifne atzman im hivtichuhu lehotzio, disherit yisrael lo yedabberu chazav. veim bet haasurim betoch yerushalayim, afillu vide ovde kochavim shochatin alehem bifne atzman, deefshar dimayyele lappesach levet haasurim veachle leh hatam. vechole vezaken en shochatin alehen bifne atzman, shemma yichbad alehem hacholi velo yuchelu leechol kazzayit:
Lefichach. hoil uvishat shechita reuyin hayu venizrak haddam alehem, im era bahem pesul kemo sheamarnu, peturim millaasot pesach sheni:

Chutz min hamefakkeach baggal. venimtza met tachtav, shetztzarich laasot pesach sheni, shehaya tame mittechillato kodem shechita, shehare heehil al hattuma mishshaa shehitchil lefakkeach. vehu shehaya haggal agol, devadday heehil alav mittechilla. aval im haya haggal aroch, shemma vishat shechita adayin lo heehil al hattuma, ufatur millaasot pesach sheni:
Happoretz al menat ligdor. kelomar afillu al menat ligdor, la chashiv melacha vechasher hammilluy:

Haochel al menat liktzot. leachar shemmille hammayim kodem sheyyekaddesh haya melakket latteenim al menat leyabbeshan laasot mehen gerogarot, uleachar lekitatan achalan, en hammachashava shehaya rotze laasotan ketziot poselet bammayim, ella hare hu cheillu lakat leechol, sheeno fosel, dumeya deforetz al menat ligdor sheen hammachashava shehu choshev ligdor poselet ad sheyyigdor, hacha nammi:
Im katza. im hinniach otan bemakom shemmannichin hatteenim leyabbesh, pasul:
Bishvil shello yovad pasul. shehammatznia ochalim kede shello yovdu, chashiva melacha:
Hamefanne et hammayan letoch haggat. sheasa charitz min hammayan ad haggat kede sheyyifnu sham me hammayan, veachar kach hifsikan:
Gat. bor sheosin lifne haggat kede lekabbel et hayyayin, karuy gat:
Gevim. leshon aso hannachal hazze gevim haamur besefer melachim [2 3]. vehu rekak shel mayim:
Pesulim. lazzavim litvila, delav mayim chayyim ninhu:
Velamtzoraim. devainan mayim chayyim lehazzot alav im dam hatztzippor:

Ulekaddesh bahen me chattat. bainan mayim chayyim, vehane kevan dehifsikan lav mayim chayyim ninhu. veha dekatane mippene shello nitmalleu vichli, kede lefaslan lekiddush bechol inyan afillu va lekaddesh betoch haggat o vetoch haggevim atzman:
Min habbakar. ma sheen ken bappesach, sheeno va lo min habbakar velo min hannekevot:
Shello yehe adam omed al devarav. shello yehe sarvan laamod kayyam bisvarato:
Avot haolam. hillel veshammay:
Chamishsha. lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin. kol chavit vechavit bifne atzmah:
Venimlechu lekaddeshan kiddush echad. learot chamishtan betoch keli gadol ulekaddesh hakkol bevat achat:
Hare chullan kesherim. dehoil vechol echad memalle hakkeli shello en kan melacha foselet bammayim ben milluy lehattalat haefer bammayim:

Hayyachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot kulei‏ en kasher ella acharon. shehammilluy harishon nifsal bammelacha sheasa keshemmille et hashsheni kodem shennatan et haefer barishon, vechen hashsheni nifsal keshemmille et hashshelishi, vechen kullam. veim mittechilla haya memalle chamesh chaviyyot zo achar zo o afillu mea chaviyyot kede lekaddeshan kiddush echad, kegon shetztzarich lehazzot al kelim harebe, lo hayu foslim ze al ze vechullan kesherim, dehakkol nechshavim milluy echad. aval keshemmille mittechilla leshem chamishsha kiddushin, kullan poslin ze al ze mittaam melacha, shehi foselet bammayim ad sheyyattil haefer, hilkach en kasher ella acharon:
Venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin. shekkiddesh zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah:
En kasher ella zo shekkiddesh rishon. lefi shekkiddush rishon chashiv melacha laacherim shehayu memullaim velo natan letochan efer, dead sheyyitten et haefer, melacha poselet bammayim:

Amar leechad kaddesh lecha et ellu. hayyachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddeshan kiddush echad, veamar leacher kaddesh lach et ellu vekiddeshan haacher chamishsha kiddushim, en kasher ella rishon. dechevan sheamar lo kaddesh lach unetanan lo, naasu shello ucheillu millean hu, vehakkiddush shekkiddesh rishon naasa melacha lifsol et acherim:
Aval im amar kaddesh li et ellu, kullan kesherim. shehamemalle lo asa melacha, vehamekaddesh eno shello kede sheyyippaslu al yado:
Amar leechad min hashshuk vechulei. hacha lo garsinan mashbiacha ani, deha velo shevua michayyav kefel. shezze gannav mammash hu, uvegannav ketiv yeshallem shenayim, veen tzarich shevua:

Edim shemmemashmeshin uvain. revuta ashmeinan, deaf al gav demechamat biatuta deedim mode, afillu hachi mahanya hodaa veniftar min hakkefel. vechevan deen kefel, patur af min hattevicha shekkafar bah uvau edim shegganav vetavach umachar, dechol hecha delekka chefel lekka chiyyuv tevicha, detashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana, velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa, vechevan dechefel lekka, betzir leh chad:

Hamechannen et hachevel. derech meshalshele haddeli lemalleot mayim, keshemmaale et haddeli mesabbev et hachevel beyado kemin tabbaat shello yehe nigrar laaretz. umechannen leshon hadra dechanta [chullin 83]. veim bederech haalaat haddeli mechannen al yad al yad, tzorech haalaa hi, veen zo melacha vechasher hammilluy. veim baacharona leachar sheheelahu kinneno, chashuv melacha ufasul:
Laze hichshiru horaat shaa. ma shehichshiru veyavne horaat shaa, lo lammolich et hachevel shello chedarko, ella laze shekkinnen et hachevel baacharona hichshiru lo al yede haddechak:
Lifne habbira. kol hammikdash kullo karuy bira. vesorfim oto sham kede lavayyeshan, sheyyizzaharu shello yavou od lide tuma:
Meatze hammaaracha. shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo etzim:
Nitma miuto. vechen notar shel pesach tahor:
Hatztzaykanin. haatzranin. tzare ayin, sorfin oto miut shennitma vehannotar mippesach tahor, lifne habbira:

Ellu devarim bappesach dochin et hashshabbat. pesach doche et hashshabbat, deneemar moado bappesach (Bamidbar 9) veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado, veneemar moado battamid (sham 28) tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado, ma moado haamur battamid doche et hashshabbat, shenneemar (sham) al olat hattamid, af moado haamur bappesach doche et hashshabbat:
Shechitato uzerikat damo. i efshar laasotan ballayla, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) beyom tzavvoto lehakeriv, bayyom velo vallayla:
Michuy. kinnuach, kemo achla umachata piha (Mishlei 30). michuy keravav doche et hashshabbat, shello yasrichu:
Tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin. deefshar mishshettechshach:

Harekavato. al ketefo lahavio derech reshut harabbim laazara, af al pi sheen bo ella issur shevut, shehachay nose et atzmo, en doche, dahava leh lemebeda meetmol. vechen havaato michutz lattechum vachatichat yabbalto shel karban pesach lehasir mumo, af al pi sheen bo ella issur shevut, shechotchah beshinnav o veyado, enan dochim. veha ditnan beshilhe eruvin chotchin yabbelet bammikdash, hahi bivesha demifrach parcha, umatnitin dehacha belacha. veaf al pi dichshechotchah beshinnav o veyado kilachar yad hu, afillu hachi asur belacha, dahava leh lemebeda meetmol:
Rabbi eliezer omer dochin. desavar machshire mitzva dochim et hashshabbat, bemassechet shabbat:
Zav sheraa shete reiyyot. shettame tumat shiva veen taun karban:

Shochatin alav. veaf al pi shello heeriv shimsho. vehu shettaval bishat hashshechita, deha chazi lemechal leureta. dedavka teme met shechal shevii shello bearbaa asar nidche lefesach sheni af al gav dachazi lemechal leureta, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 9) vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu, bayyom hahu lo hayu yecholim, ha laerev hayu yecholim leechol bappesach, venidchu lefesach sheni. aval shear tumot i chazi lemechal leureta shochatim alav, veaf al pi shello heeriv shimsho:
Raa shalosh. la chazi lemechal ad demayte chappara:
Shochatin alav. im chal shemini shello beerev pesach, afillu lo hevi chapparato. vehu shennatan karbenotav levet din:

Shomeret yom keneged yom. haroa toch achad asar yom shebben nidda lenidda devaya lispor yom hammochorat, shochatin aleha beyom hassefira. dechevan shessafra miktzat hayyom mutteret litbol. veaf al pi shemmechusseret heerev shemesh shochatin aleha:
Vehazzava. sheraata shelosha yamim retzufim betoch achad asar yom utzericha lispor shiva nekiyyim ulehavi karban, shochatin aleha bashshemini:
Hassoref para. adumma:

Ufarim. hannisrafim, kegon par yom hakkippurim ufar kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibbur, metammeim begadim, divchullehu chetiv yechabbes begadav, velo shena vegadim shehu lavush velo shena vegadim shehu nogea, vehu haddin lechol shear kelim. delo memaatinan ella adam, uchele cheres bilvad hu sheen mittammein im nogim bahen:
Ufara ufarim vesair hammishtalleach atzman. im nagu vabbegadim hare hen tehorim. vehayenu deamri leh begadim laadam, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
Hammoser memav letame. leshamran:

Pesulim. ben asu habbealim harishonim melacha, ben lo asu habbealim harishonim melacha, divchezkat hashshomer kaymu vehu eno makpid leshamran mippene shehu tame, vehattora amra lemishmeret leme nidda:
Uletahor kesherim. vaafillu asu habbealim harishonim melacha, shekkevar yatzu mershut bealim vekaymu virshut shomer. umihu im hashshomer asa melacha, pesulim:
Af letame kesherim. desavar rabbi eliezer hammoser memav letame, bechezkat habbealim harishonim kaymu, hilkach im lo asu habbealim melacha kesherim. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Venatan lo. vehapperot tzevurin umunnachim birshut harabbim veen muchzak bahen lo chenvani velo baal habbayit:
Unetatto vaonpali. tik heasuy lemaot:
Yishshava baal habbayit. shevua cheen shel tora, veyittol. dechevan dechenvani mode shemmachar, vehapperot hem chutz lachanuto, baal habbayit nishba venotel:

Amar lo netattim lecha. veholachtan letoch betecha. veillu happerot hatztzevurin umunnachim shelli hem shennatatti chan lemachran, vehalla toen ellu hem happerot shemmacharta li vedinar. hoil vehallokeach mode vammikkach vehachenvani chofer shello machar et ellu, yishshava hachenvani shevua cheen shel tora veyittol:

Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. rabbi yehuda assefa faleg, veamar deven bezo ben bezo baal habbayit nishba venotel. dechevan shehapperot hem chutz lachanut have cheillu happerot hem beyad baal habbayit, vechol shehapperot beyado, yado al haelyona vehu nishba venotel:

Amar lashshulchani vechulei. ashmeinan tanna pelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan ben bemaot shel shulchani ben beferot shel chenvani. dei ashmeinan pelugetayhu vechenvani, hava amena beferot amru rabbanan dechi amar lo netattim lecha veholachtan letoch betecha yishshava hachenvani veyittol, lefi shehachenvani asuy litten perot kodem sheyyikkach haddinar, aval beshulchani sheeno asuy litten haissarin kodem sheyyikkach haddinar, ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda dilolam baal habbayit nishba venotel. vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yehuda dilolam baal habbayit nishba venotel, mippene sheen hashshulchani asuy litten haissarin ad sheyyikkach haddinar, aval bechenvani shehu asuy litten happerot kodem sheyyikkach hammaot ema mode lehu lerabbanan, tzericha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Vaafillu shevuat shav. lo mibbaya shevuat edut ushevuat happikkadon deit behu kefirat mamon, dahave ra lashshamayim velabberiyyot, ella afillu shevuat shav, deeno ella ra lashshamayim, shekkenegdo nishba venotel. ushevuat bittuy lo katane, dishvuat bittuy dilhabba kegon ochal velo ochal, ikka lememar ki ishtava bekusheta ishtava, shebbedato haya lekayyemo, veaf al pi shekkefao yitzro veavar aleha eno chashud bechach al hashshevua. aval bittuy dilsheavar, achalti velo achalti, dame lishvuat shav, shehare hotzi shevuat sheker mippiv:
Haya echad mehen mesachek bekuvya. tana fesula deorayta vekatane pesula derabbanan:

Mafriche yonim. it dimfarshe im takdim yonatcha leyonati etten lecha kach vechach, vehayenu sechok. veit dimfarshe shemmegaddel yona melummedet lehavi yonim levet bealeha, veyesh bahen gazel mippene darche shalom:
Vesochare sheviit. osim sechora mipperot sheviit, vehattora amra leachla velo lischora:

Chazra shevua limkomah. it dimfarshe vaggemara, chazra lesinay, lishvuat har sinay shehishbia hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael lo tigzol, vehu yippara min hakkofer mamon lachavero, aval bet din en nizkakin lo lishvua velo leferaon. veit dimfarshe chazra shevua lamchuyyav lah, al ze shehoda vemiktzat, vechevan sheeno yachol lishshava shehare chashud hu, yeshallem:

[Shenehen nishbain venotlin. mibbaal habbayit. deamar leh chenvani, poalim lo mehemnu li bishvua], at heemantinhu, delo amart li besahade hav lehu. vechen poalim amre leh, chenvani lo meheman lan bishvua. uchesheshshenehem nishbain venotlim mibbaal habbayit, nishbaim ze bifne ze, ki hechi delichsuf chenvani mippoalim o poalim mechenvani:
Ellu veellu vain lide shevuat shav. shehare al karchacha echad mehen nishba lashshav venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel. ella ellu vaellu notlin belo shevua. veen halacha keven nannas:
Haya kiddush tzaf al pene hammayim. shennatan al hammayim efer harebe. velaefer atzmo kare kiddush:
Notel. meoto efer:
Umekaddesh. bo mayim acherim, vaafillu veoto shennaga bammayim mekaddesh vechozer umekaddesh kamma feamim, ella shemmenaggevo:
Zalaf et hammayim. hizza min hammayim hamekuddashim al haadam veal hakkelim ad shekkalu chol hammayim, vehaefer nishar beshule hakkeli:
Vachachamim omrim vechulei. vahalacha chachachamim betarvayhu:

Kaddesh li vaakaddesh lach. kegon shekkol echad mille mayim leatzmo, uva ze vekiddesh memav shel ze, veze kiddesh memav shel ze, oto shekkiddesh rishon kasher ma shekkiddesh lachavero, dachavero lo asa melacha ella ad achar shennitkaddeshu memav, umishshennitkaddeshu en melacha foselet. aval ma shekkiddesh hashsheni larishon pasul, sheharishon pesalah bema shekkiddesh meme hashsheni kodem shennitkaddeshu memav:
Malle li vaamalle lach. hammilluy haacharon kasher. aval milluy rishon pasul, hayenu hammayim shennitmalleu rishona, denifselu vammelacha bammilluy shemmille lachavero:
Kaddesh li vaamalle lach. shehayu lo mayim memullaim veamar lachavero kaddesh li memay veachar kach amalle lach:
Shenehem kesherim. deen hammelacha foselet achar kiddush. veze nammi shennitmalleu lo hammayim memav kesherim, demishshennitmalleu lo hammayim lo asa melacha:
Malle li vaakaddesh lach. shehaacher hayu lo mayim memullaim veamar lo ze malle li techilla veachar kach akaddesh lach:
Shenehem pesulim. ze, shemmille ad shello nitkaddeshu memav. veze, shekkiddesh lachavero mishshennitmalleu memav:
Hechan shori amar lo avad. amar leshomer chinnam hechan shori, amar leh avad:

Mashbiacha ani veamar amen vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo meshallem et hakkeren. velo chefel. veim hoda lo meatzmo ad shello vau edim, meshallem keren vechomesh veasham, kedin shevuat happikkadon deenah baa ad shemmode veshav merishato uva lehitkapper:

Amar lo nignav mashbiacha ani vechulei. deshomer chinnam happoter atzmo betaanat gannav venishba uvau edim, meshallem kefel, dichtiv (Shemot 22) im lo yimmatze haggannav, im lo yimmatze kemo sheamar ella shehu atzmo genavo, yeshallem shenayim. aval im ba liftor atzmo betaanat avad, eno meshallem kefel:
Hoda meatzmo meshallem keren vechomesh veasham. aval kefel lo, demode viknas patur:

Nitma vetimmeahu. nitma hassandal vetimme et haadam lechattat. shekkelim shennitmeu vemashkim metammeim et haadam lechattat, sheen monin rishon vesheni bechattat, keditnan lekamman perek kol harauy (mishna 6). af al pi sheim naflu hammashkim hallalu al besaro, tahor, shehattahor lappara im nagu mashkin temeim bivsaro, hu tahor kemo shehaya. levad im nagu veyadav, lefi shehammashkin temeim metammeim et hayyadayim, vegabbe tohorat chattat kayma lan deim nitmeu yadav nitma gufo:
Metammeecha lo timmeuni. mashkim shettimmeu et hassandal lo hayu yecholim letamme hattahor lechattat im nagu vivsaro kedaamaran, vehassandal habba mikkocham metammeo:
Shechita shehi. asura vechullin beshabbat mishshum issur melacha gemura, af al pi chen docha et hashshabbat bappesach:
Ellu shehem mishshum shevut lo yidchu. bitmiha:

Yom tov yochiach. shehittiru vo shechita uvishshul shehu av melacha, umuttarin lehedyot, veasru vo lehavi davar michutz lattechum uleachlo, hoil vehaya efshar lo meetmol, veaf al gav ditchumim midderabbanan:

Ma reaya reshut lemitzva. achilat hedyot reshut hi, vetzorech gavoah mitzva hi, veim heemidu chachamim issur shevut shellahen bimkom reshut, yaamiduhu af bimkom mitzva. verabbi yehoshua savar kol simchat yom tov mitzva hi, vaafillu hachi enah docha shevut:

Hazzaa tochiach shehi mitzva. bitme met shechal shevii shello lihyot beshabbat erev happesach, sheim lo yazze lo yaase fischo, vaafillu hachi eno doche, dehachi kim leh lerabbi akiva delo dachya. vehazzaa shevut hi, demechaze keman dimtakken gavra:
Vealeha ani dan. vegam al hahazzaa ani cholek veomar shettidche velo yeakkevehu mippesach, mikkal vachomer ze beatzmo:
Amar lo rabbi akiva o chilluf. o ani achalif et haddin. difshita leh dehazzaa meakkeva, veyalfinan bekal vachomer minna lishchita [shetteakkev]:
Bemoado. veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado (Bamidbar 9):

Have li moed laellu. sheyyehe lahem zeman kavua, kemo shekkeva lashshechita, hilkach kevan shello kava lahem zeman umatze lemeevad meetmol, lo dachya, vehazzaa nammi lav miggufeh defesach hi, velo chetiv beh bemoado. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vechulei. dichtiv (Shemot 22) al kol devar pesha, kelal. al shor al chamor al se al salma, perat. al kol aveda, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella cheen happerat, ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin, yatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot, yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shehem mittaltelin en gufan mamon. shekkol ellu en nishbain alehen. vehekdesh en nishbain alav dichtiv (sham) ki yitten ish el reehu, velo shel hekdesh:
En bahen tashlume chefel. divhane davka dimrabbinan keen happerat dichtiv beotah happarasha yeshallem shenayim:

Velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. dechol hecha delekka chefel eno meshallem arbaa vachamishsha dechevan delekka chefel havu lehu tashlume shelosha vearbaa, vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa:

Shomer chinnam eno nishba. shomer chinnam en lo alav ella shevua, dichtiv (sham) venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim im lo shalach yado, veotah happarasha beshomer chinnam neemra. veal haavadim veal hakkarkaot veal hashshetarot eno nishba, deyalfinan la middichtiv ki yitten ish el reehu, kelal. kesef o chelim, perat. lishmor, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol vechulei, yatzu karkaot delav mittaltelim vechulei. vechol hane deamrinan behu eno nishba, davka shevua deorayta, aval shevuat hesset leolam chayyavin lishshava:

Nose sachar eno meshallem. geneva vaaveda hakkatuv bo lechiyyuv, dichtiv (sham) im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav. vaavadim vekarkaot ushetarot eno meshallem, dichtiv beshomer sachar (sham) ki yitten ish el reehu, kelal. chamor o shor o se vechol behema, perat. lishmor, chazar vechalal vechulei, kidamrinan leel. reehu chetiv beshomer chinnam uveshomer sachar, demashma reehu velo hekdesh. veshoel vesocher lo huzkeru chan limute vehu avadim vekarkaot ushetarot vehekdeshot, delo shayyach sheela bekarkaot, velo vishtarot al harov, vechol shekken sechirut sheeno shayyach bishtarot, vechen lo shayyach sheela usechirut behekdesh, sheasur lehasheil ulehaskir hahekdeshot:
Haishsha. tochal mishshel balah. kol zeman shello fersha sheddatah beshel aviha, demissetama datah limmanot al shel balah:
Regel harishon. shelleachar nissueha, shekkach derech hannesuot lalechet levet avihen:
Tochal bimkom shehi rotza. uchegon sheenah redufa ad henna lelech levet aviha tadir, hilkach mesappeka lan behe nicha la:
Appitroppesim. yatom shehayu lo shene appitroppesin vehimnuhu ze al pischo veze al pischo:
Lo yochal mishshel shenehem. lo mippischo shel ze velo mippischo shel ze, demi natan reshut lachelek haechad lehimmanot im ze. veen lo takkana ella im ken ratzu shenehem sheyyimmane im haechad:

Lo yochal mishshel rabbo. aval mishshel atzmo ochel, dechevan dedina have dechofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur, af al pi sheadayin lo nishtachrer hare hu cheven chorin, hilkach ochel mishshel atzmo:

Haochel minnivlat of tahor. nivlat of tahor en lah tuma im naga veadam o vivgadim, ella bevet habbelia metamma adam letamme vegadim, keditnan bemassechet tohorot, vehayenu deamre leh begadim laadam metammeecha lo timmeuni vechulei:
Nitma kahal. betumat met, sheen pesach nidche mippene hattuma ella mittumat met:

Yaasu vetuma. vaafillu temeim yechidim, deha [fesach] dithorim gufayhu betuma atu mishshum kohanim, sheen karban tzibbur habba vetuma chaluk, meachar shekkarban rubbam ba vetuma af hayechidim osim betuma:

Natan yado o raglo. hare shehaya killuach yored mehar meukkam veeno yored letoch hechavit sherotze lemalleotah lekiddush, venatan yado lemala verosh hahar laasotah keen tzinnor kede sheyyaavru hammayim derech yado lechavit shel kiddush, vechen ale yerakot haruyin laachila umekabbelin tuma:

Pesulim. hammayim. kidyalfinan beferek 2‏ dizvachim (daf ko) middichtiv [vayyikra 11] mikve mayim yihye tahor, havayatan al yede tohora tehe. veaf al gav dehay kera bemikve hu dichtiv, yalfinan minneh kol havayot. vehachi have mashmaut dikra, havayatan shel kol mayim hametaharim, al yede tohora tehe, ben sheatta mehavve otan lihyot mikve o milluy have mehavve otan al yede davar sheeno mekabbel tuma:

Kol hannishbain. nishbain velo meshallemin. lo tikkena tora lattovea lishshava velittol, ella lannitba sheyyishshava velo yeshallem, dichtiv (Shemot 22) velakach bealav velo yeshallem, mi shealav leshallem hu nishba:
Veellu nishbain venotlin. shettikkenu lahem chachamim lishshava velittol. vechullehu mefaresh lehu lekamman bematnitin:

Hassachir. tikkenu lo chachamim lishshava velittol, mippene shebbaal habbayit tarud befoalav veeno nizkar. vehane mille keshettovo vizmanno, sechir yom zemanno chol hallayla sheacharav, usechir layla zemanno chol hayyom shelleacharav. aval tevao leachar zemanno, baal habbayit nishba hesset shepperao veniftar. veim secharo shello veedim, nammi en hassachir nishba venotel, demittoch sheyyachol lomar lo lo secharticha meolam, yachol lomar lo nammi secharticha venatatti lecha secharcha:
Hu omer natatti. aval amar lo shenayim katzatzta li vehu omer lo katzatzti lecha ella echad, nishba baal habbayit shevuat hattora shehu chidvarav veeno noten lo ella echad:
Rabbi yehuda omer. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda lo vesachir velo venigzal velo venechbal:
Vehigbihu ze al ze. shessiyyeu ze et ze lehagebiah:
Venatal ze laze kotzo. o shennatal ze laze kotz shennitchav lo veyado:
Bekiddush echad. shehayu shenehem memalleim letzorech kiddush echad, kasher. sheyyachol kol echad lesayyea lachavero, unetilat hakkotz shebbeyado nammi tzorech milluy hi:
Bishne kiddushin pasul. sheppasal kol echad memav bema shessiyyea lachavero o shennatal lo kotz, mishshum melacha:

Im hitnu venehen. sheamar kol echad lachavero kesheagbiah lecha yehe shelli veshellecha birshutecha (uchemo ken amar 36 haacher), veachar shehigbiho lokeach kol echad mehen achat mehen birshuto. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Haatzamot. sheeno yachol leshavran, mippene shenneesra shevirat etzem, venotar bahen moach vetaun serefa:

Vehaggidin. shehen asurin baachila veen chayyavin alehen min hattora, kegon shummano shel gid hannashe, shehu muttar, ella sheyyisrael kedoshim nahagu vo issur. i nammi haggid hachitzon hassamuch labbasar, shehu asur, veen chayyavin alav, umin hattora have notar, uleachlo i efshar derabbanan asaruhu:
Vehannotar. besar pesach shennitatztzelu vaachilato venittotar:
Beshishsha asar. shehu chullo shel moed. af al pi shennifsal bevoker rishon en rashshay lesarfo beyom tov, disrefat kadashim ase, veyom tov ase velo taase, veen ase doche et lo taase vaase:
Happogemet ketubbatah. shemmotzia shetar ketubbatah umoda shennitkabbela miktzatah:
Lo tippara ella vishvua. im toen habbaal nitkabbela chullah:

Ed echad omer vechulei. uminnechasim meshubadim uminnichse yetomim kulei. venifraat shello vefanav. kullehu akkeshem kayme, keshem sheen echad meellu nifra ella vishvua, kach hayetomim enam nifraim ella vishvua. yetomim hannifraim min hayetomim lo yipparu ella vishvua. umayre matnitin kegon sheellu hayetomim shebbaim lehippara mehen omrim en anu yodim im para avinu ze hachov im lav, aval im taanu amar lanu avinu shello lava maot hallalu velo nitchayyev bechov ze meolam, hare hayetomim shemmotziim shetar chov al hayetomim hallalu nifraim mehem shello vishvua, shekkol haomer lo laviti keomer lo farati dame, vehem enam yecholim lehachechish haedim shemmeidim sheavihem lava hammaot hallalu. velo shanu devishvua mihat shakle yetomim min hayetomim, ella shemmet malve bechayye love, aval met love bechayye malve, kevar nitchayyev malve shevua livne love shello nitkabbel kelum, shehannifra min hayetomim afillu vishtar tzarich shevua, veen adam morish mamon shehu chayyav alav shevua levanav, lefi sheen habbanim yecholim lishshava shevua shennitchayyev avihem. veaf al pi shekken haddin, im dayyan echad dan sheyyishshavu hayetomim shevua shello fekadanu abba veyipparu mimmamon hayetomim haacherim bishvua zo, ma sheasuy asuy:
Shello fekadanu abba. bishat mita:
Veshello amar lanu. kodem lachen, sheshshetar ze farua:
Hare ze nishba. shello matza ven shetarotav shel aviv sheshshetar ze parua. vechen halacha:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Shenayim shehayu shomrim et hashshoket. shennitmalla lechattat:
Tahar. oto shennitma tahar mittumato:
Venitma sheni. hayenu chavero shehaya tahor:
Kesherim. hammayim shebbashshoket:
Amad veasa hashsheni melacha. amad harishon mimmelachto, uva hashsheni veasa melacha tachtav:

Hammatznia et hechavit. shehu dole vah hammayim lasum bashshoket, uleachar sheera mimmenna hitzniah kodem sheyyekaddesh hammayim bashshoket, en hatzenaa zo chashuva melacha, lefi shetztzarich lah adayin lemalleot bah, vetzorech milluy hu. vechen kefaah al piha nammi lenaggevah lefi sherotze lemalleot bah adayin, la chashiv melacha vechasher hammilluy. aval im asa chen leholich bah et hakkiddush dehaynu mayim hamekuddashin, hoil velav tzorech milluy hu, chashuv melacha ufasul hammilluy:
Bishvil shettachazik mayim harebe. lo chashuv pinnuy ze melacha:
Beshaa shehu zolef. shehu mazze:
Pasul. definnuy ze chashuv melacha:

Kol hayyammim kemikve. lechol hane mille dekatane vesofo. (vegam) en metaharin bezochalin, deen mikve metaher bezochalin ella vimchunnasin, dichtiv [vayyikra 11] ach mayan, mayan metaher bezochalin veen mikve metaheret bezochalin:

Ufesulin lazzavin. dezav bae mayim chayyim, dichtiv [sham 15] verachatz besaro bemayim chayyim. velammetzora dichtiv [sham yad] el keli cheres al mayim chayyim. uleme chattat, dichtiv [bemidbar 19] mayim chayyim el keli:

Hayyam haggadol kemikve. lo kara hakkatuv mikve ella layyam haggadol, deveh mishtae kera bemaase vereshit, sheshsham nikvu chol meme vereshit. velo neemar yammim bilshon rabbim, ella mippene shemmeoravim bo mine yammim harebe, shekkol hannechalim holchim elav:

Rabbi yose omer. kol hayyammim veyam haggadol, torat mayan alehen leinyan shehen metaharin bezochalin, mippene shehannechalim holchin vezochalin alehen. aval pesulin hen letorat mayim chayyim, shehakkatuv koran mikve. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Chayyav. shehare chafar mamon, sheillu hoda haya mitchayyev:
Met vehu nishbar vechulei‏ patur. sheim hoda lo haya meshallem. vechen nignav vehu sheavad, o avad vehu shennignav, patur, shehare shinna mechova lechova velo chafar mamon bishvua zo:
Amar lo avad o nignav vehu shemmet o nishba vechulei‏ patur. shehare shinna mippetor lechova vehifsid bishvuato:
Emurav. hachalavim hakkerevim al gabbe hammizbeach:
Bemagis. bikara. targum kaarotav magisohi:
Yashva lah behar habbayit. beshabbat kaamar, sheen yecholin leholich pischehen:
Bachel. ben hassoreg lechomat haazara shel nashim bitchillat aliyyat habbayit:
Chashecha yatzu vetzalu et pischehen. sheen tzeliyyat happesach docha et hashshabbat:
Me karmeyon ume fuga. neharot shebbeeretz yisrael hen:
Me vitztzim. leshon hayige gome belo vitztza (Iyov 8). kelomar, mayim shechomer vetit meorav bahen. verachamana amar mayim chayyim el keli, vehacha ikka chatzitza ben mayim lakkeli:
Me taarovot. shemmayim pesulim mitarvim bahem:
Echad pasul veechad kasher. venitarvu, asur lekaddesh mimmekom hattaarovot ulematta:
Rabbi yehuda fosel. afillu vishnehem kesherim posel rabbi yehuda littol mimmekom hattaarovot, gezera attu echad pasul. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Im lo pasul. im hakkiddush shello, pasul. deshemma hammelacha kadma lakkiddush venifselu hammayim:
Veim leacher. hu hakkiddush:
Kasher. shehare vaal hammayim lo asa melacha:
Hamekaddesh lo uleacher. shenehem keechat. i nammi kiddesh lachavero kodem shello:
Shello pasul. dekiddush shel chavero nechshav melacha lifsol memav:
Shenehem kesherim. sheen hammayim shello sheyyippaslu al yado:
Mayim hammukkin. hammazzikin. kegon shehen meluchin ufoshrin:
Pesulin. leme chattat:
Mayim hamechazzevin. happoskin. kemo asher lo yechazzevu memav (yeshaya noach):
Pesulin. demayim chayyim bainan:
Echad bashshavua. aval echad bayyovel, shappir mikkeru mayim chayyim:
Befulmesayot. chayalot shel geyasot sheshshotin umekalkelim bahen:
Bishne vitztzaron. shanim shel atzirat geshamim:
Rabbi yehuda fosel. afillu otan sheen mechazzevin ella befulmesayot uvishne vitztzaron. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hanneechol beshor haggadol. shekkevar huksha kol heatid lehikkashot bo:
Yeachel bigdi harach. rauy laachila befesach ben shemona yamim. aval ma sheen neechol beshor haggadol en nimnin alav befesach af al pi sheachshav hu rach, hoil vesofo lehikkashot:

Verashe chenafayim vehassechusim. hachi kaamar, umahu hanneechol beshor haggadol, rashe chenafayim, hassechus shekkorin 325 belaaz shebberosh kaf hakkatef, ushear sechusim kegon tenuch haozen usechuse hechaze vehatztzelaot hakketannot shebbesof hashshidra, hoil uveshor haggadol neechalim al yede shelika, yeachlu vigdi harach tzali:

Aval hammotir battahor kulei. dichtiv (Shemot 12) velo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu, ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar im avarta al lav, kayyem ase shebbo veencha loke. i nammi dahave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav:
Vehashshover battame kulei. dichtiv (sham) veetzem lo tishberu vo, bakkasher muzhar al shevirat etzem, veeno muzhar al shevirat etzem bappasul:
Veyismoch alav. kelomar sheasa kedivre hayyachid vehinniach daat harabbim:
En bet din. acher sheyyaamod acharav yachol levattel divre bet din harishon sheasa kedivre hayyachid:

Ad sheyyihye gadol mimmennu bechachma uveminyan. bechachma, hayenu sherosh hayeshiva shel bet din haacharon yihye gadol bechachma merosh hayeshiva shel rishon. uveminyan, sheyyihyu minyan hattalmidim shebbayshiva shel acharon merubbim mimminyan hattalmidim shebbayshiva shel rishon:
En keli cheres metamme chavero. sheen keli cheres naase av hattuma leolam, veen keli cheres mekabbel tuma ella meav hattuma, alma sheen keli cheres metamme chavero:
Ella mashkin. aval metamme hu mashkin vehammashkim chozrim umetammeim chavero, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava kedaamaran:

Kol velad hattuma. kegon rishon vesheni, en metamme chelim. ella av hattuma. umashke shennitma verishon vesheni metamme chelim, gezera mishshum mashke zav vezava, kegon rukko vezovo umeme raglav shehen av hattuma:
Sacho veshemen teruma. shemmuttar lasuch happesach beme ferot:
Im chay yedichennu. delo vala:
Veim tzali hu. bae kelifa mishshum devala:
Sheen podim. mochrim:
Maaser sheni virushalayim. vaafillu leachlo vetohora, dichtiv (Devarim 14) venatatta bakkasef vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha vehalachta el hammakom:
Veasa melacha beyado achat. pasul hammilluy mittaam melacha:
Lo uleacher kulei‏ keachat:
Shenehem pesulim. dechevan delitre gavre ka memalle, nechshav haechad melacha lachavero:
Ben lo ben leacher. deaf al pi sheen hammayim shello, poslan bammelacha shebbishat milluy:

Al mi sheyyaale rishon lirushalayim. kede lezarzan kaamar, sheyyizdarez kol echad lihyot rishon. umihu kol banav himna al happesach, ella sheoto sheyyaale rishon yizke rishon vechol echav yizku acharav al yado:
Ad sheyyizrok haddam. leolam yachol limmashech, afillu achar shechita, ad sheyyizrok haddam. umode rabbi shimon deen nimnin ella ad sheyyishchat. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
